## Overview

    

Every feature in OpenBMC exposes its data and actions through D-Bus interfaces. When you add new hardware support, implement a custom management feature, or integrate a vendor-specific capability, you create a D-Bus service that other components (Redfish, IPMI, web UI) consume automatically.

This guide walks you through the complete lifecycle of building a custom D-Bus service: defining the interface in YAML, generating C++ bindings with sdbus++, implementing the service logic, and packaging it for the OpenBMC build system. You follow along with a concrete example – a “Hello World” service that exposes a greeting property and a SayHello method.

By the end of this guide, you have a fully functional D-Bus service running in QEMU that you can introspect with busctl and extend for your own use case.

**Key concepts covered:**

* YAML interface definitions for sdbusplus (properties, methods, signals, enumerations)
* sdbus++ code generation and meson integration
* Async service implementation with sdbusplus::asio
* systemd unit files with D-Bus activation
* Yocto .bb recipes using obmc-phosphor-dbus-service.bbclass

---

## Architecture

    

A custom D-Bus service in OpenBMC consists of several interconnected pieces. The YAML interface definition serves as the contract, sdbus++ generates the C++ bindings, your implementation provides the business logic, and systemd manages the service lifecycle.

### Component Diagram

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Custom D-Bus Service Lifecycle                 │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                  │
│   ┌──────────────┐    sdbus++     ┌──────────────────────┐      │
│   │  YAML         │──────────────▶│  Generated C++        │      │
│   │  Interface    │   codegen     │  Server Bindings     │      │
│   │  Definition   │               │  (headers + sources) │      │
│   └──────────────┘               └──────────┬───────────┘      │
│                                              │                   │
│                                              ▼                   │
│   ┌──────────────┐               ┌──────────────────────┐      │
│   │  systemd      │    starts     │  Service             │      │
│   │  Unit File   │──────────────▶│  Implementation      │      │
│   └──────────────┘               │  (your C++ code)     │      │
│                                  └──────────┬───────────┘      │
│                                              │                   │
│                                              ▼                   │
│                                  ┌──────────────────────┐      │
│                                  │  D-Bus System Bus    │      │
│                                  └──────────┬───────────┘      │
│                                              │                   │
│                            ┌─────────────────┼──────────────┐   │
│                            ▼                 ▼              ▼   │
│                     ┌──────────┐      ┌──────────┐   ┌────────┐│
│                     │  bmcweb  │      │  ipmid   │   │ busctl ││
│                     │ (Redfish)│      │ (IPMI)   │   │ (CLI)  ││
│                     └──────────┘      └──────────┘   └────────┘│
│                                                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### D-Bus Interfaces

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Interface | Object Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter` | `/xyz/openbmc_project/example/greeter` | Example greeter service |

</div>

### Key Dependencies

    

* **sdbusplus**: C++ D-Bus library and sdbus++ code generator
* **phosphor-dbus-interfaces**: Standard OpenBMC interface definitions (reference patterns)
* **boost**: Provides Boost.Asio for the async event loop
* **systemd**: Service management and D-Bus activation
* **meson**: Build system with sdbus++ integration

---

## YAML Interface Definition

    

The sdbusplus YAML format defines D-Bus interfaces declaratively. Each YAML file maps to one D-Bus interface and describes its properties, methods, signals, and enumerations.

### File Organization

    

Interface YAML files follow a directory structure that mirrors the D-Bus interface name. For an interface named `xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter`, you place the file at:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter.interface.yaml
```

</div></div>

Enumeration types go in separate files:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter/Status.interface.yaml
```

</div></div>

> The `phosphor-dbus-interfaces` repository at github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces contains all standard OpenBMC interface definitions. Study its structure when designing your own interfaces.

### Complete YAML Example

    

Create the interface definition file for the Greeter service:

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1"># yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter.interface.yaml</span>
<span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="pi">></span>
    <span class="s">Interface for a greeting service that demonstrates custom D-Bus</span>
    <span class="s">service development in OpenBMC.</span>

<span class="na">properties</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Greeting</span>
      <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
      <span class="na">default</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">Hello,</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">OpenBMC!"</span>
      <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="pi">></span>
          <span class="s">The current greeting message. Clients can read and modify</span>
          <span class="s">this property.</span>

    <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">GreetCount</span>
      <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">uint32</span>
      <span class="na">default</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">0</span>
      <span class="na">flags</span><span class="pi">:</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="s">readonly</span>
      <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="pi">></span>
          <span class="s">Number of times the SayHello method has been called.</span>
          <span class="s">This property is read-only and increments automatically.</span>

    <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Status</span>
      <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">enum[self.Status]</span>
      <span class="na">default</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="s">Ready"</span>
      <span class="na">flags</span><span class="pi">:</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="s">readonly</span>
      <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="pi">></span>
          <span class="s">Current status of the greeter service.</span>

<span class="na">methods</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">SayHello</span>
      <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="pi">></span>
          <span class="s">Generate a personalized greeting using the current Greeting</span>
          <span class="s">template and the provided name.</span>
      <span class="na">parameters</span><span class="pi">:</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Name</span>
            <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
            <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">The name to greet.</span>
      <span class="na">returns</span><span class="pi">:</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Response</span>
            <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
            <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">The formatted greeting message.</span>
      <span class="na">errors</span><span class="pi">:</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="s">xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument</span>

    <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Reset</span>
      <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="pi">></span>
          <span class="s">Reset the GreetCount to zero and restore the default greeting.</span>

<span class="na">signals</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">GreetingChanged</span>
      <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="pi">></span>
          <span class="s">Emitted when the greeting message changes.</span>
      <span class="na">properties</span><span class="pi">:</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">OldGreeting</span>
            <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
            <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">The previous greeting message.</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">NewGreeting</span>
            <span class="na">type</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">string</span>
            <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">The new greeting message.</span>

<span class="na">enumerations</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Status</span>
      <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="pi">></span>
          <span class="s">Possible states of the greeter service.</span>
      <span class="na">values</span><span class="pi">:</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Ready</span>
            <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Service is ready to accept requests.</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Busy</span>
            <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Service is processing a request.</span>
          <span class="pi">-</span> <span class="na">name</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Error</span>
            <span class="na">description</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s">Service encountered an error.</span>
```

</div></div>

### YAML Type Mappings

    

The YAML `type` field maps to D-Bus type signatures and C++ types:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| YAML Type | D-Bus Signature | C++ Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `boolean` | `b` | `bool` |
| `byte` | `y` | `uint8_t` |
| `int16` | `n` | `int16_t` |
| `uint16` | `q` | `uint16_t` |
| `int32` | `i` | `int32_t` |
| `uint32` | `u` | `uint32_t` |
| `int64` | `x` | `int64_t` |
| `uint64` | `t` | `uint64_t` |
| `double` | `d` | `double` |
| `string` | `s` | `std::string` |
| `object_path` | `o` | `sdbusplus::message::object_path` |
| `array[T]` | `aT` | `std::vector` |
| `dict[K, V]` | `a{KV}` | `std::map` |
| `enum[self.Name]` | `s` | Generated enum class |

</div>

### Property Flags

    

Use the `flags` field to control property behavior:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Flag | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `readonly` | Property can only be set by the service implementation, not by D-Bus clients |
| `const` | Property value is set at construction and never changes |

</div>

> Design your interfaces before writing code. A well-designed YAML interface acts as an API contract that other teams can review and depend on.

---

## sdbus++ Code Generation

    

The `sdbus++` tool reads your YAML interface definitions and generates C++ server bindings. These generated files include abstract base classes with virtual methods for your service implementation to override.

### What sdbus++ Generates

    

For the `xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter` interface, sdbus++ produces:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Generated File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter/server.hpp` | Server-side abstract base class |
| `xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter/server.cpp` | Server-side vtable registration |
| `xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter/client.hpp` | Client-side proxy class |
| `xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter/common.hpp` | Shared type definitions |
| `xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter/error.hpp` | Error type definitions |

</div>

### Running sdbus++ Manually

    

You can run sdbus++ directly to inspect the generated output:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Generate server header</span>
sdbus++ <span class="nt">-r</span> yaml <span class="nt">-t</span> interface server-header <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter <span class="o">></span> server.hpp

<span class="c"># Generate server implementation</span>
sdbus++ <span class="nt">-r</span> yaml <span class="nt">-t</span> interface server-cpp <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter <span class="o">></span> server.cpp

<span class="c"># Generate common types (enums, errors)</span>
sdbus++ <span class="nt">-r</span> yaml <span class="nt">-t</span> interface common-header <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter <span class="o">></span> common.hpp
```

</div></div>

> In practice, you rarely run sdbus++ manually. The meson build system handles code generation automatically. The commands above are useful for debugging or understanding the generated code.

### Meson Integration for Code Generation

    

The sdbusplus project provides meson helper functions that automate code generation. Add this to your `meson.build`:

<div class="language-meson highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="n">sdbusplus_dep</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">dependency</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'sdbusplus'</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">sdbusplus_prog</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">find_program</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'sdbus++'</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Define the interface to generate
</span><span class="n">generated_sources</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
<span class="n">generated_headers</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

<span class="c1"># Use sdbusplus meson module for code generation
</span><span class="n">sdbusplus_project</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">subproject</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'sdbusplus'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">required</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">sdbusplus_generate</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sdbusplus_project</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nb">get_variable</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'sdbusplus_generate'</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Generate server bindings from YAML
</span><span class="n">generated</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sdbusplus_generate</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">process</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter.interface.yaml'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">install_header</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">generated_sources</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">generated</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>  <span class="c1"># .cpp files
</span><span class="n">generated_headers</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">generated</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span>  <span class="c1"># .hpp files
</span>
```

</div></div>

For projects that prefer a simpler approach without the meson subproject, you can use custom_target:

<div class="language-meson highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="n">sdbusplus_prog</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">find_program</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'sdbus++'</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">greeter_server_hpp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">custom_target</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'greeter-server-hpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">input</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[],</span>
    <span class="n">output</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'server.hpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">command</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="n">sdbusplus_prog</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'-r'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">meson</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">project_source_root</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="s">'yaml'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'-t'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'interface'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'server-header'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">capture</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">greeter_server_cpp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">custom_target</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'greeter-server-cpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">input</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[],</span>
    <span class="n">output</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'server.cpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">command</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="n">sdbusplus_prog</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'-r'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">meson</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">project_source_root</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="s">'yaml'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'-t'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'interface'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'server-cpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">capture</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
```

</div></div>
---

## Service Implementation

    

With the YAML interface defined and code generation configured, you now implement the service itself. OpenBMC services use the sdbusplus::asio integration with Boost.Asio for async event handling.

### Approach 1: Using Generated Server Bindings (Recommended)

    

This approach inherits from the sdbus++-generated server base class. The generated class provides property storage, vtable registration, and signal emission. You override virtual methods to implement business logic.

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// greeter_service.hpp</span>
<span class="cp">#pragma once
</span>
<span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf"><xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter/server.hpp></span><span class="cp">
#include</span> <span class="cpf"><sdbusplus/bus.hpp></span><span class="cp">
#include</span> <span class="cpf"><sdbusplus/server.hpp></span><span class="cp">
</span>
<span class="k">namespace</span> <span class="n">greeter</span>
<span class="p">{</span>

<span class="c1">// Create a convenient type alias for the generated server binding</span>
<span class="k">using</span> <span class="n">GreeterInherit</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">server</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">object_t</span><span class="o"><</span>
    <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">xyz</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">openbmc_project</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Example</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">server</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Greeter</span><span class="o">></span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="k">class</span> <span class="nc">GreeterService</span> <span class="o">:</span> <span class="k">public</span> <span class="n">GreeterInherit</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="nl">public:</span>
    <span class="n">GreeterService</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">bus_t</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">bus</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">const</span> <span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">path</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">:</span>
        <span class="n">GreeterInherit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">bus</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">path</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="c1">// Set initial property values</span>
        <span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Hello, OpenBMC!"</span><span class="p">);</span>
        <span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">);</span>
        <span class="n">status</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">Status</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Ready</span><span class="p">);</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>

    <span class="c1">// Implement the SayHello method (generated as pure virtual)</span>
    <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="nf">sayHello</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="n">name</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">override</span>
    <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">name</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">empty</span><span class="p">())</span>
        <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">throw</span> <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">xyz</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">openbmc_project</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Common</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Error</span><span class="o">::</span>
                <span class="n">InvalidArgument</span><span class="p">();</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>

        <span class="c1">// Update the greet count</span>
        <span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">);</span>

        <span class="c1">// Build the response using the current greeting</span>
        <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="n">response</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="s">" "</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">name</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="s">"!"</span><span class="p">;</span>

        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">response</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>

    <span class="c1">// Implement the Reset method</span>
    <span class="kt">void</span> <span class="nf">reset</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="k">override</span>
    <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="n">oldGreeting</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">();</span>

        <span class="c1">// Restore defaults</span>
        <span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Hello, OpenBMC!"</span><span class="p">);</span>
        <span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">);</span>

        <span class="c1">// Emit the GreetingChanged signal</span>
        <span class="n">greeterChanged</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">oldGreeting</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">());</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="p">}</span> <span class="c1">// namespace greeter</span>
```

</div></div>

The main function creates the bus connection and instantiates the service:

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// main.cpp</span>
<span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf">"greeter_service.hpp"</span><span class="cp">
</span>
<span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf"><sdbusplus/bus.hpp></span><span class="cp">
#include</span> <span class="cpf"><sdbusplus/server/manager.hpp></span><span class="cp">
</span>
<span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf"><iostream></span><span class="cp">
</span>
<span class="kt">int</span> <span class="nf">main</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">constexpr</span> <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">serviceName</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter"</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="k">constexpr</span> <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">objectPath</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"/xyz/openbmc_project/example/greeter"</span><span class="p">;</span>

    <span class="c1">// Connect to the system bus</span>
    <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">bus</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">bus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">new_default</span><span class="p">();</span>

    <span class="c1">// Create an ObjectManager for introspection support</span>
    <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">server</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">manager_t</span> <span class="n">objManager</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">bus</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">objectPath</span><span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// Request the well-known service name</span>
    <span class="n">bus</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">request_name</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">serviceName</span><span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// Create the greeter service object</span>
    <span class="n">greeter</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">GreeterService</span> <span class="n">greeterObj</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">bus</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">objectPath</span><span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"Greeter service running at "</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="n">objectPath</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">"</span><span class="p">;</span>

    <span class="c1">// Enter the event loop</span>
    <span class="k">while</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">true</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="n">bus</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">process_discard</span><span class="p">();</span>
        <span class="n">bus</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">wait</span><span class="p">();</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
```

</div></div>

### Approach 2: Using sdbusplus::asio (Async Event Loop)

    

Many OpenBMC services use the Boost.Asio integration for timers, file descriptor monitoring, and concurrent I/O. This approach registers properties and methods programmatically instead of inheriting from generated bindings.

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// main_async.cpp</span>
<span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf"><sdbusplus/asio/connection.hpp></span><span class="cp">
#include</span> <span class="cpf"><sdbusplus/asio/object_server.hpp></span><span class="cp">
#include</span> <span class="cpf"><boost/asio.hpp></span><span class="cp">
</span>
<span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf"><iostream></span><span class="cp">
#include</span> <span class="cpf"><string></span><span class="cp">
</span>
<span class="kt">int</span> <span class="nf">main</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">constexpr</span> <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">serviceName</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter"</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="k">constexpr</span> <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">objectPath</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"/xyz/openbmc_project/example/greeter"</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="k">constexpr</span> <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">interfaceName</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter"</span><span class="p">;</span>

    <span class="c1">// Create the Boost.Asio IO context</span>
    <span class="n">boost</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">asio</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">io_context</span> <span class="n">io</span><span class="p">;</span>

    <span class="c1">// Connect to the system D-Bus</span>
    <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">conn</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">make_shared</span><span class="o"><</span><span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">asio</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">connection</span><span class="o">></span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">io</span><span class="p">);</span>
    <span class="n">conn</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">request_name</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">serviceName</span><span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// Create the object server</span>
    <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">asio</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">object_server</span> <span class="n">server</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">conn</span><span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// Add the interface to the object path</span>
    <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">iface</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">server</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">add_interface</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">objectPath</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">interfaceName</span><span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// ── Properties ──────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

    <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="n">greeting</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"Hello, OpenBMC!"</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="kt">uint32_t</span> <span class="n">greetCount</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="n">status</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.Status.Ready"</span><span class="p">;</span>

    <span class="c1">// Read-write property: Greeting</span>
    <span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_property</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s">"Greeting"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="c1">// Setter with validation</span>
        <span class="p">[</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">newValue</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">value</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">newValue</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">empty</span><span class="p">())</span>
            <span class="p">{</span>
                <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">cerr</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"Rejected empty greeting</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">"</span><span class="p">;</span>
                <span class="k">return</span> <span class="nb">false</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="p">}</span>
            <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"Greeting changed: "</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="n">value</span>
                      <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">" -> "</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="n">newValue</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="n">value</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">newValue</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="n">greeting</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">newValue</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="nb">true</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">},</span>
        <span class="c1">// Getter</span>
        <span class="p">[</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="cm">/*value*/</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// Read-only property: GreetCount</span>
    <span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_property_r</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s">"GreetCount"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">vtable</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">property_</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">emits_change</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">[</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="kt">uint32_t</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// Read-only property: Status</span>
    <span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_property_r</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s">"Status"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">status</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">vtable</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">property_</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">emits_change</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">[</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">status</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">status</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// ── Methods ─────────────────────────────────────────────────</span>

    <span class="c1">// Method: SayHello(string Name) -> string Response</span>
    <span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_method</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s">"SayHello"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">[</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">&</span><span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">&</span><span class="n">iface</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="n">name</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">name</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">empty</span><span class="p">())</span>
            <span class="p">{</span>
                <span class="k">throw</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">invalid_argument</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Name must not be empty"</span><span class="p">);</span>
            <span class="p">}</span>

            <span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="o">++</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">signal_property</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"GreetCount"</span><span class="p">);</span>

            <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="n">response</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">greeting</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="s">" "</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">name</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="s">"!"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"SayHello(</span><span class="se">\"</span><span class="s">"</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="n">name</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"</span><span class="se">\"</span><span class="s">) -> </span><span class="se">\"</span><span class="s">"</span>
                      <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="n">response</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"</span><span class="se">\"</span><span class="s"> (count: "</span>
                      <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="n">greetCount</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">")</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">response</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// Method: Reset()</span>
    <span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_method</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="s">"Reset"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="p">[</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">greeting</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">&</span><span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">&</span><span class="n">iface</span><span class="p">]()</span> <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="n">greeting</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"Hello, OpenBMC!"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="n">greetCount</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">signal_property</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"Greeting"</span><span class="p">);</span>
            <span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">signal_property</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"GreetCount"</span><span class="p">);</span>
            <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"Service reset to defaults</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">"</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// Initialize the interface (make it visible on D-Bus)</span>
    <span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">initialize</span><span class="p">();</span>

    <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"Greeter service running at "</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="n">objectPath</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">"</span><span class="p">;</span>

    <span class="c1">// ── Optional: periodic timer example ────────────────────────</span>

    <span class="n">boost</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">asio</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">steady_timer</span> <span class="nf">timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">io</span><span class="p">);</span>
    <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">function</span><span class="o"><</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">boost</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">system</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">error_code</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">></span> <span class="n">timerHandler</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="n">timerHandler</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">timer</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">&</span><span class="n">greetCount</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="o">&</span><span class="n">iface</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="o">&</span><span class="n">timerHandler</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">boost</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">system</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">error_code</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">ec</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ec</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>
        <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">cout</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"Heartbeat: greetCount="</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="n">greetCount</span> <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="s">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">"</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="n">timer</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">expires_after</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">chrono</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">seconds</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">60</span><span class="p">));</span>
        <span class="n">timer</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">async_wait</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">timerHandler</span><span class="p">);</span>
    <span class="p">};</span>
    <span class="n">timer</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">expires_after</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">chrono</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">seconds</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">60</span><span class="p">));</span>
    <span class="n">timer</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">async_wait</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">timerHandler</span><span class="p">);</span>

    <span class="c1">// Run the event loop (blocks until io.stop() is called)</span>
    <span class="n">io</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">();</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
```

</div></div>

> Use Approach 1 (generated bindings) when you want strict interface enforcement – the compiler verifies that you implement every method. Use Approach 2 (sdbusplus::asio) when you need Boost.Asio features like timers, socket monitoring, or concurrent I/O operations.

### Property Getters and Setters

    

Properties in sdbusplus support validation and change notification:

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// Read-write property with validation</span>
<span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_property</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">"PropertyName"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">initialValue</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="c1">// Setter: return true to accept, false to reject</span>
    <span class="p">[](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">newValue</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">storedValue</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">newValue</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">length</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">></span> <span class="mi">256</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="nb">false</span><span class="p">;</span>  <span class="c1">// Reject values that are too long</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>
        <span class="n">storedValue</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">newValue</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="nb">true</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">);</span>

<span class="c1">// Read-only property (updates via signal_property)</span>
<span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_property_r</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">"ReadOnlyProp"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">value</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">vtable</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">property_</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">emits_change</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">[</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">value</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="k">auto</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">value</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">);</span>
```

</div></div>

### Method Handlers

    

Methods can accept parameters, return values, and throw errors:

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// Method with parameters and return value</span>
<span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_method</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"MethodName"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">[](</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="n">param1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kt">int32_t</span> <span class="n">param2</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">-></span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="c1">// Process the request</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="s">"result"</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">);</span>

<span class="c1">// Method with no parameters or return value</span>
<span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_method</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"SimpleMethod"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]()</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="c1">// Perform action</span>
<span class="p">});</span>

<span class="c1">// Method that throws a D-Bus error</span>
<span class="n">iface</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">register_method</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">"ValidatedMethod"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">[](</span><span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span> <span class="n">input</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">input</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">empty</span><span class="p">())</span>
        <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">throw</span> <span class="n">sdbusplus</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">exception</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">SdBusError</span><span class="p">(</span>
                <span class="o">-</span><span class="n">EINVAL</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument"</span><span class="p">);</span>
        <span class="p">}</span>
    <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">);</span>
```

</div></div>
---

## Build Configuration (meson.build)

    

The meson.build file ties together code generation, compilation, and installation. Below is a complete build file for the greeter service.

### Complete meson.build

    

<div class="language-meson highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="nb">project</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'phosphor-greeter'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s">'cpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">version</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'1.0.0'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">meson_version</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'>=0.63.0'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">default_options</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="s">'cpp_std=c++23'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'warning_level=3'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'werror=true'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'buildtype=debugoptimized'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">],</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># ── Dependencies ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
</span>
<span class="n">sdbusplus_dep</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">dependency</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'sdbusplus'</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">boost_dep</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">dependency</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'boost'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">modules</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="s">'coroutine'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'context'</span><span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">required</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">systemd_dep</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">dependency</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'systemd'</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">phosphor_logging_dep</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">dependency</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'phosphor-logging'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">required</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">false</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># ── sdbus++ code generation ──────────────────────────────────────
</span>
<span class="n">sdbusplus_prog</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">find_program</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'sdbus++'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">required</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">sdbusplus_gen_meson_prog</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">find_program</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'sdbus++-gen-meson'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">required</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Generate server bindings from YAML interface definitions.
# The YAML files are under yaml/ in the source tree.
</span><span class="n">greeter_server_hpp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">custom_target</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'greeter-server-hpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">output</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'server.hpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">command</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="n">sdbusplus_prog</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'-r'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">meson</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">project_source_root</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="s">'yaml'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'-t'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'interface'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'server-header'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">capture</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">greeter_server_cpp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">custom_target</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'greeter-server-cpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">output</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'server.cpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">command</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="n">sdbusplus_prog</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'-r'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">meson</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">project_source_root</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="s">'yaml'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'-t'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'interface'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'server-cpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">capture</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">greeter_common_hpp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">custom_target</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'greeter-common-hpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">output</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'common.hpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">command</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="n">sdbusplus_prog</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'-r'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">meson</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">project_source_root</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="s">'yaml'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'-t'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">'interface'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'common-header'</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">'xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">capture</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">generated_sources</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">greeter_server_cpp</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">greeter_server_hpp</span><span class="p">,</span>
                     <span class="n">greeter_common_hpp</span><span class="p">]</span>

<span class="c1"># ── Service executable ───────────────────────────────────────────
</span>
<span class="nb">executable</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'phosphor-greeter'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s">'src/main.cpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s">'src/greeter_service.cpp'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">generated_sources</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">dependencies</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="n">sdbusplus_dep</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">phosphor_logging_dep</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">include_directories</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">include_directories</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'src'</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="n">install</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">install_dir</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">get_option</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'bindir'</span><span class="p">),</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># ── systemd unit installation ────────────────────────────────────
</span>
<span class="n">systemd_system_unit_dir</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">systemd_dep</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nb">get_variable</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'systemdsystemunitdir'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">pkgconfig_define</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="s">'prefix'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">get_option</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'prefix'</span><span class="p">)],</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="nb">configure_file</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">input</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'service_files/xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.service'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">output</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.service'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">install_dir</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">systemd_system_unit_dir</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># ── D-Bus service activation file ────────────────────────────────
</span>
<span class="n">dbus_system_services_dir</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">dependency</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'dbus-1'</span><span class="p">).</span><span class="nb">get_variable</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s">'system_bus_services_dir'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">pkgconfig_define</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="s">'prefix'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">get_option</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">'prefix'</span><span class="p">)],</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="nb">configure_file</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">input</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'service_files/xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.dbus.service'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">output</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s">'xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.service'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">install_dir</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">dbus_system_services_dir</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
```

</div></div>

> Use `cpp_std=c++23` (or at least `c++20`) for OpenBMC services. The sdbusplus library and OpenBMC coding standards require modern C++ features like `std::expected`, structured bindings, and concepts.

---

## systemd Service File

    

systemd manages the lifecycle of your D-Bus service. You need two files: a systemd unit file and a D-Bus activation file.

### systemd Unit File

    

Create `service_files/xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.service`:

<div class="language-ini highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="nn">[Unit]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="py">Description</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">OpenBMC Example Greeter D-Bus Service</span>
<span class="py">After</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">dbus.service</span>
<span class="py">After</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">phosphor-dbus-interfaces-mapper.service</span>
<span class="py">Wants</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">phosphor-dbus-interfaces-mapper.service</span>
<span class="w">
</span><span class="c"># Start after the BMC is ready
</span><span class="py">After</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">mapper-wait@-xyz-openbmc_project-example.service</span>
<span class="py">Wants</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">mapper-wait@-xyz-openbmc_project-example.service</span>
<span class="w">
</span><span class="c"># Integrate into OpenBMC boot ordering
</span><span class="py">After</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">obmc-standby.target</span>
<span class="py">Before</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">obmc-host-start-pre@0.target</span>
<span class="w">
</span><span class="nn">[Service]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="py">Type</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">dbus</span>
<span class="py">BusName</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter</span>
<span class="py">ExecStart</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">/usr/bin/phosphor-greeter</span>
<span class="py">SyslogIdentifier</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">phosphor-greeter</span>
<span class="py">Restart</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">on-failure</span>
<span class="py">RestartSec</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">5</span>
<span class="w">
</span><span class="c"># Security hardening
</span><span class="py">ProtectSystem</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">full</span>
<span class="py">ProtectHome</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">true</span>
<span class="py">PrivateTmp</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">true</span>
<span class="w">
</span><span class="nn">[Install]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="py">WantedBy</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">multi-user.target</span>
```

</div></div>

### D-Bus Activation File

    

Create `service_files/xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.dbus.service`:

<div class="language-ini highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="nn">[D-BUS Service]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="py">Name</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter</span>
<span class="py">Exec</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">/usr/bin/phosphor-greeter</span>
<span class="py">User</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">root</span>
<span class="py">SystemdService</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.service</span>
```

</div></div>

### OpenBMC Target Ordering

    

OpenBMC defines a target hierarchy that controls the boot sequence. Place your service in the correct position based on when it needs to run:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Target | When It Runs | Use When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `obmc-standby.target` | BMC is ready, before host power-on | Service needed at BMC idle |
| `obmc-host-startmin@.target` | Minimum services for host start | Service required for host boot |
| `obmc-host-start-pre@.target` | Before host power-on GPIO | Pre-power-on initialization |
| `obmc-host-started@.target` | After host is running | Post-boot monitoring |
| `obmc-host-stop-pre@.target` | Before host power-off | Graceful shutdown tasks |

</div>

> The `Type=dbus` setting tells systemd to consider the service started once it has acquired its D-Bus bus name. This ensures dependent services do not start until the interface is ready.

---

## Yocto BitBake Recipe

    

Package your service for the OpenBMC build system with a BitBake recipe. The `obmc-phosphor-dbus-service` bbclass simplifies service packaging.

### Complete .bb Recipe

    

Create `meta-phosphor/recipes-phosphor/example/phosphor-greeter_1.0.bb`:

```bitbake
SUMMARY = "OpenBMC Example Greeter D-Bus Service"
DESCRIPTION = "Demonstrates how to build a custom D-Bus service for OpenBMC"
HOMEPAGE = "https://github.com/openbmc/openbmc"
LICENSE = "Apache-2.0"
LIC_FILES_CHKSUM = "file://LICENSE;md5=86d3f3a95c324c9479bd8986968f4327"
PR = "r1"

inherit meson
inherit pkgconfig
inherit obmc-phosphor-dbus-service

# Source repository (adjust for your project)
SRC_URI = "git://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-greeter;branch=master;protocol=https"
SRCREV = "${AUTOREV}"

S = "${WORKDIR}/git"

# Build dependencies (compile-time)
DEPENDS += " \
    sdbusplus \
    phosphor-logging \
    boost \
    systemd \
    "

# Runtime dependencies
RDEPENDS:${PN} += " \
    sdbusplus \
    phosphor-logging \
    libsystemd \
    "

# D-Bus service configuration for obmc-phosphor-dbus-service.bbclass
# This bbclass automatically installs the D-Bus activation file and
# links the systemd unit to the appropriate target.
DBUS_SERVICE:${PN} = "xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.service"

# systemd service configuration
SYSTEMD_SERVICE:${PN} = "xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.service"
```

### Adding the Recipe to Your Image

    

Add the package to your machine image configuration:

```bitbake
# In your machine.conf or local.conf
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " phosphor-greeter"
```

Or add it to a packagegroup:

```bitbake
# In meta-your-machine/recipes-phosphor/packagegroups/packagegroup-your-machine-apps.bb
RDEPENDS:${PN}:append = " phosphor-greeter"
```

### Using bbappend for Customization

    

To customize the service for your platform without modifying the upstream recipe:

```bitbake
# meta-your-machine/recipes-phosphor/example/phosphor-greeter_%.bbappend

FILESEXTRAPATHS:prepend := "${THISDIR}/${PN}:"

# Override the greeting default
SRC_URI += "file://0001-change-default-greeting.patch"

# Add platform-specific configuration
SRC_URI += "file://greeter-config.json"

do_install:append() {
    install -d ${D}${datadir}/phosphor-greeter
    install -m 0644 ${WORKDIR}/greeter-config.json \
        ${D}${datadir}/phosphor-greeter/
}
```

> The `obmc-phosphor-dbus-service.bbclass` handles D-Bus activation file installation and systemd service linking automatically. You only need to set `DBUS_SERVICE` and `SYSTEMD_SERVICE` variables.

## Troubleshooting

    

### Issue: Service Fails to Start with “Name already taken”

    

**Symptom**: journalctl shows `Failed to request name xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter: Name already taken`

**Cause**: Another process already owns the D-Bus bus name. This happens when a previous instance did not shut down cleanly or you have a duplicate service.

**Solution**:

1. Check for running instances: `systemctl status xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter`
2. Stop the existing service: `systemctl stop xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter`
3. Verify no orphan process: `ps aux | grep phosphor-greeter`
4. Kill orphan processes if found: `kill `

### Issue: sdbus++ Fails with “Interface not found”

    

**Symptom**: `sdbus++: error: Could not find interface xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter`

**Cause**: The YAML file path does not match the interface name, or the `-r` (root) argument points to the wrong directory.

**Solution**:

1. Verify the YAML file is at `yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Example/Greeter.interface.yaml`
2. Verify directory structure matches the interface name exactly (case-sensitive)
3. Ensure the `-r` flag points to the parent of the `xyz/` directory

### Issue: Properties Not Visible After Service Starts

    

**Symptom**: `busctl introspect` shows the interface but no properties or methods.

**Cause**: You forgot to call `iface->initialize()` after registering all properties and methods.

**Solution**: Add `iface->initialize()` after the last `register_property` or `register_method` call. The interface is not published to D-Bus until you call initialize.

### Issue: “Permission denied” When Connecting to System Bus

    

**Symptom**: Service crashes with `Failed to open system bus: Permission denied`

**Cause**: D-Bus security policy does not allow your service to own the requested bus name.

**Solution**: Create a D-Bus policy file at `/etc/dbus-1/system.d/`:

<div class="language-xml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"><!-- /etc/dbus-1/system.d/xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter.conf --></span>
<span class="cp"><!DOCTYPE busconfig PUBLIC
 "-//freedesktop//DTD D-BUS Bus Configuration 1.0//EN"
 "http://www.freedesktop.org/standards/dbus/1.0/busconfig.dtd"></span>
<span class="nt"><busconfig></span>
    <span class="nt">
user="root">
         own="xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter"/>
         send_destination="xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter"/>
    
     context="default">
         send_destination="xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter"/>
    

```

### Issue: BitBake Recipe Build Fails

    

**Symptom**: `bitbake phosphor-greeter` fails with missing dependency errors.

**Cause**: DEPENDS or RDEPENDS are incomplete, or sdbusplus is not available in the build environment.

**Solution**:

1. Verify `meta-phosphor` layer is included in `bblayers.conf`
2. Check that `sdbusplus-native` is available for code generation: `bitbake sdbusplus-native`
3. Add missing dependencies to DEPENDS in the recipe
4. Run `bitbake -e phosphor-greeter | grep ^DEPENDS` to inspect resolved dependencies

### Debug Commands

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check service status</span>
systemctl status xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter

<span class="c"># View service logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter <span class="nt">-f</span>

<span class="c"># List all D-Bus services</span>
busctl list | <span class="nb">grep </span>Example

<span class="c"># Full introspection of the service</span>
busctl introspect xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/example/greeter

<span class="c"># Monitor all signals from the service</span>
busctl monitor xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter

<span class="c"># Check if D-Bus activation file is installed</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> <span class="nt">-la</span> /usr/share/dbus-1/system-services/ | <span class="nb">grep </span>Greeter

<span class="c"># Verify systemd unit is installed</span>
systemctl <span class="nb">cat </span>xyz.openbmc_project.Example.Greeter
```

</div></div>
