## Troubleshooting

    

### Sensor not appearing

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check Entity Manager found the device</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> <sensor-name>

<span class="c"># Check hwmon sysfs exists</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/class/hwmon/

<span class="c"># Check sensor daemon logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> xyz.openbmc_project.adcsensor <span class="nt">-f</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> xyz.openbmc_project.hwmontempsensor <span class="nt">-f</span>
```

</div></div>

### Incorrect readings

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Verify raw hwmon value</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon<span class="k">*</span>/temp1_input

<span class="c"># Check scale factor in Entity Manager config</span>
<span class="c"># Value on D-Bus = raw_value * ScaleFactor</span>

<span class="c"># For ADC, verify voltage divider calculation</span>
```

</div></div>

### Threshold alarms not triggering

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check threshold configuration</span>
busctl introspect xyz.openbmc_project.HwmonTempSensor <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/sensors/temperature/<name> | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> threshold

<span class="c"># Verify SEL logger is running</span>
systemctl status xyz.openbmc_project.sel-logger
```

</div></div>
---

## Deep Dive

    

Advanced implementation details for sensor developers.

### Sensor Reading Pipeline

    

Each sensor daemon follows a common pattern for reading and publishing sensor values:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Sensor Reading Pipeline                              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   1. HARDWARE LAYER                                                     │
│   ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│   │  I2C Device → Kernel Driver → sysfs/hwmon                        │  │
│   │  Example: TMP75 at 0x48 → tmp75 driver → /sys/class/hwmon/hwmonN │  │
│   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   2. SENSOR DAEMON (e.g., hwmontempsensor)                              │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │  a. Entity Manager signals new Configuration object             │   │
│   │  b. Daemon matches Type (e.g., "TMP75") to its supported types  │   │
│   │  c. Daemon locates hwmon sysfs path for bus/address             │   │
│   │  d. Creates Sensor object with D-Bus interface                  │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   3. POLLING LOOP                                                       │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │  while (running) {                                              │   │
│   │      raw_value = read("/sys/class/hwmon/hwmonN/temp1_input");   │   │
│   │      scaled_value = raw_value / 1000.0 * scaleFactor;           │   │
│   │      if (value_changed) {                                       │   │
│   │          update_dbus_property("Value", scaled_value);           │   │
│   │          check_thresholds(scaled_value);                        │   │
│   │      }                                                          │   │
│   │      sleep(pollInterval);  // typically 1 second                │   │
│   │  }                                                              │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   4. D-BUS PUBLICATION                                                  │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │  Service: xyz.openbmc_project.HwmonTempSensor                   │   │
│   │  Path: /xyz/openbmc_project/sensors/temperature/CPU_Temp        │   │
│   │  Interface: xyz.openbmc_project.Sensor.Value                    │   │
│   │      Property: Value = 45.5 (double)                            │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Source reference**: [HwmonTempSensor.cpp](https://github.com/openbmc/dbus-sensors/blob/master/src/HwmonTempSensor.cpp)

### Threshold Detection Algorithm

    

Thresholds use hysteresis to prevent rapid alarm toggling:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Threshold Hysteresis                                │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                        │
│   Temperature (°C)                                                     │
│        │                                                               │
│    95 ─┼─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ Upper Critical                       │
│        │                                                               │
│    90 ─┼─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ Upper Critical Hysteresis (95-5)     │
│        │                                                               │
│    85 ─┼─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ Upper Warning                        │
│        │              ╭───╮                                            │
│    80 ─┼─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─╱─ ─ ╲─ ─ ─ ─ Upper Warning Hysteresis (85-5)     │
│        │            ╱       ╲       (clear alarm below this)           │
│    75 ─┼───────────╱         ╲──────                                   │
│        │          ╱           ╲                                        │
│    70 ─┼─────────╱             ╲                                       │
│        │                                                               │
│        └────────────────────────────────────────────────────▶ Time     │
│                                                                        │
│   Alarm Logic:                                                         │
│   ├── SET alarm when: value >= threshold                               │
│   ├── CLEAR alarm when: value < (threshold - hysteresis)               │
│   └── Default hysteresis: 1.0 (configurable per threshold)             │
│                                                                        │
│   Code pattern (Thresholds.cpp):                                       │
│   if (!alarm && value >= threshold) {                                  │
│       alarm = true;                                                    │
│       log_event("threshold crossed");                                  │
│   } else if (alarm && value < (threshold - hysteresis)) {              │
│       alarm = false;                                                   │
│       log_event("threshold cleared");                                  │
│   }                                                                    │
│                                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Source reference**: [Thresholds.cpp](https://github.com/openbmc/dbus-sensors/blob/master/src/Thresholds.cpp)

### Entity Manager Integration Flow

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Sensor Discovery Flow                                │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   1. Entity Manager loads JSON configuration                            │
│      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│      │ { "Name": "CPU_Temp", "Type": "TMP75", "Bus": 1, ... }      │    │
│      └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   2. Entity Manager creates D-Bus Configuration object                  │
│      Path: /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/.../CPU_Temp                  │
│      Interface: xyz.openbmc_project.Configuration.TMP75                 │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   3. HwmonTempSensor receives InterfacesAdded signal                    │
│      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│      │ match = "type='signal',interface='ObjectManager',"          │    │
│      │         "member='InterfacesAdded'"                          │    │
│      └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   4. Daemon checks if Type matches its supported types                  │
│      ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│      │ supportedTypes = {"TMP75", "TMP112", "LM75", "EMC1403", ...} │   │
│      │ if (config.Type in supportedTypes) { createSensor(); }       │   │
│      └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   5. Daemon locates hwmon sysfs path                                    │
│      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│      │ Scan /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/device/                        │    │
│      │ Match i2c-{bus}-00{address} to configuration                │    │
│      │ e.g., i2c-1-0048 for Bus=1, Address=0x48                    │    │
│      └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### ADC Scaling and Voltage Dividers

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    ADC Voltage Calculation                              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Hardware Voltage Divider:                                             │
│                                                                         │
│       Vin ──────┬──────                                                 │
│                 │                                                       │
│                ┌┴┐ R1                                                   │
│                │ │ (e.g., 10kΩ)                                         │
│                └┬┘                                                      │
│                 ├──────────▶ ADC Input                                  │
│                ┌┴┐ R2                                                   │
│                │ │ (e.g., 3.3kΩ)                                        │
│                └┬┘                                                      │
│                 │                                                       │
│       GND ──────┴──────                                                 │
│                                                                         │
│   Voltage Divider Formula:                                              │
│   V_adc = V_in × R2 / (R1 + R2)                                         │
│   V_in = V_adc × (R1 + R2) / R2                                         │
│                                                                         │
│   ScaleFactor Calculation:                                              │
│   ScaleFactor = (R1 + R2) / R2                                          │
│   Example: (10k + 3.3k) / 3.3k = 4.03                                   │
│                                                                         │
│   Entity Manager Configuration:                                         │
│   {                                                                     │
│       "Name": "P12V",                                                   │
│       "Type": "ADC",                                                    │
│       "Index": 0,                                                       │
│       "ScaleFactor": 4.03,     ← Voltage divider ratio                  │
│       "PowerState": "On"       ← Only read when host is on              │
│   }                                                                     │
│                                                                         │
│   Raw to Final Conversion:                                              │
│   raw_mv = read("/sys/bus/iio/devices/iio:device0/in_voltage0_raw");    │
│   adc_voltage = raw_mv × reference_voltage / max_raw_value;             │
│   actual_voltage = adc_voltage × ScaleFactor;                           │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Power State Filtering

    

Sensors can be configured to only read when the host is in a specific power state:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Power State Filtering                                │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   PowerState Options:                                                   │
│   ┌─────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│   │ Value       │ Sensor reads when...                               │  │
│   ├─────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤  │
│   │ "Always"    │ Always (default, standby power sensors)            │  │
│   │ "On"        │ Host is powered on (CPU/memory sensors)            │  │
│   │ "BiosPost"  │ Host is in BIOS POST (initialization sensors)      │  │
│   │ "Chassis"   │ Chassis power is on (12V rail sensors)             │  │
│   └─────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                                                         │
│   Implementation:                                                       │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ // Subscribe to host state changes                              │   │
│   │ match = "type='signal',path='/xyz/openbmc_project/state/host0'" │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │ // In polling loop                                              │   │
│   │ if (powerState == "On" && hostState != Running) {               │   │
│   │     value = NaN;  // Mark sensor unavailable                    │   │
│   │     return;                                                     │   │
│   │ }                                                               │   │
│   │ value = read_sensor();                                          │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
│   When sensor is unavailable (host off), D-Bus Value = NaN              │
│   This prevents false alarms and stale readings                         │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

## Overview

    

The Linux **hwmon** (Hardware Monitoring) subsystem provides a standardized interface for hardware monitoring devices. OpenBMC uses hwmon through two approaches:

1. **phosphor-hwmon** - Legacy daemon that reads hwmon sysfs and exposes D-Bus sensors
2. **dbus-sensors** - Modern approach with specialized sensor daemons

```mermaid
---
title: Hwmon Architecture
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph consumers["D-Bus Consumers"]
        direction LR
        bmcweb["bmcweb"]
        ipmid["ipmid"]
        fanctrl["fan-control"]
    end

    subgraph dbus["D-Bus Layer"]
        sensorval["xyz.openbmc_project.Sensor.Value"]
    end

    subgraph daemons["Sensor Daemons"]
        direction LR
        phosphor["phosphor-hwmon  
(legacy)"]
        hwmontemp["dbus-sensors  
hwmontemp"]
        fansensor["dbus-sensors  
fansensor"]
    end

    subgraph sysfs["Linux hwmon sysfs"]
        hwmon["/sys/class/hwmon/hwmonN/"]
    end

    subgraph kernel["Kernel Drivers"]
        drivers["lm75, tmp75, pmbus, aspeed-adc, ..."]
    end

    consumers --> dbus
    dbus --> daemons
    daemons --> sysfs
    sysfs --> kernel
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Hwmon Architecture                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                 │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                      D-Bus Consumers                        ││
│  │              (bmcweb, ipmid, fan-control)                   ││
│  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘│
│                             │                                   │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                         D-Bus                               ││
│  │           xyz.openbmc_project.Sensor.Value                  ││
│  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘│
│                             │                                   │
│        ┌────────────────────┼────────────────────┐              │
│        │                    │                    │              │
│  ┌─────┴─────┐       ┌──────┴─────┐      ┌──────┴─────┐         │
│  │phosphor-  │       │ dbus-      │      │ dbus-      │         │
│  │hwmon      │       │ sensors    │      │ sensors    │         │
│  │(legacy)   │       │ hwmontemp  │      │ fansensor  │         │
│  └─────┬─────┘       └──────┬─────┘      └──────┬─────┘         │
│        │                    │                    │              │
│        └────────────────────┼────────────────────┘              │
│                             │                                   │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                    Linux hwmon sysfs                        ││
│  │                  /sys/class/hwmon/hwmonN/                   ││
│  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘│
│                             │                                   │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                    Kernel Drivers                           ││
│  │            (lm75, tmp75, pmbus, aspeed-adc, ...)            ││
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘│
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Setup & Configuration

    

### Build-Time Configuration (Yocto)

    

Choose between phosphor-hwmon (legacy) or dbus-sensors (modern):

```bitbake
# Modern approach: dbus-sensors (recommended for new platforms)
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " dbus-sensors"

# Legacy approach: phosphor-hwmon
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " phosphor-hwmon"

# Include specific dbus-sensors daemons
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " \
    hwmontempsensor \
    fansensor \
    psusensor \
"
```

### Meson Build Options (dbus-sensors)

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
meson setup build <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Dhwmon-temp</span><span class="o">=</span>enabled <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Dfan</span><span class="o">=</span>enabled <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Dpsu</span><span class="o">=</span>enabled
```

</div></div>

### Meson Build Options (phosphor-hwmon)

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
meson setup build <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Dupdate-functional-on-fail</span><span class="o">=</span>enabled
```

</div></div>

### Runtime Enable/Disable

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># For dbus-sensors hwmontempsensor</span>
systemctl status xyz.openbmc_project.hwmontempsensor
systemctl stop xyz.openbmc_project.hwmontempsensor
systemctl disable xyz.openbmc_project.hwmontempsensor

<span class="c"># For phosphor-hwmon</span>
systemctl status xyz.openbmc_project.Hwmon@<device>.service
systemctl stop <span class="s2">"xyz.openbmc_project.Hwmon@ahb--apb--bus@1e78a000--i2c-bus@80--tmp75@48.service"</span>
```

</div></div>

### Phosphor-Hwmon Configuration

    

Configuration files are in `/etc/default/obmc/hwmon/`:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Create configuration file</span>
<span class="c"># Filename format: device-path-with-dashes.conf</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="o">></span> /etc/default/obmc/hwmon/ahb--apb--bus@1e78a000--i2c-bus@80--tmp75@48.conf <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="sh">'</span><span class="no">EOF</span><span class="sh">'
# Sensor label (required)
LABEL_temp1=ambient_temp

# Thresholds (in raw units, typically millidegrees)
WARNHI_temp1=40000
WARNLO_temp1=5000
CRITHI_temp1=45000
CRITLO_temp1=0

# Scaling
GAIN_temp1=1.0
OFFSET_temp1=0

# Remove sensor when not present
REMOVERCS_temp1=1
</span><span class="no">EOF

</span><span class="c"># Restart service</span>
systemctl restart xyz.openbmc_project.Hwmon@ahb--apb--bus@1e78a000--i2c-bus@80--tmp75@48.service
```

</div></div>

### Phosphor-Hwmon Configuration Options

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Option | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LABEL_` | D-Bus sensor name | `LABEL_temp1=cpu_temp` |
| `WARNHI_` | Warning high (raw) | `WARNHI_temp1=85000` |
| `WARNLO_` | Warning low (raw) | `WARNLO_temp1=0` |
| `CRITHI_` | Critical high (raw) | `CRITHI_temp1=95000` |
| `CRITLO_` | Critical low (raw) | `CRITLO_temp1=-5000` |
| `GAIN_` | Multiplier | `GAIN_in1=1.5` |
| `OFFSET_` | Offset to add | `OFFSET_temp1=1000` |
| `REMOVERCS_` | Remove when absent | `REMOVERCS_temp1=1` |
| `MODE_` | Read mode | `MODE_temp1=label` |

</div>

### Entity Manager Configuration (dbus-sensors)

    

Configure via JSON in `/usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/`:

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Exposes"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"CPU Temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TMP75"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Bus"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Address"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"0x48"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"PowerState"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"On"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"PollRate"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Thresholds"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper critical"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Severity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Value"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">95</span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper warning"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Severity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Value"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">85</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TempBoard"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TRUE"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Board"</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### Entity Manager Sensor Properties

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | string | required | Sensor name on D-Bus |
| `Type` | string | required | Sensor type (TMP75, LM75A, etc.) |
| `Bus` | int | required | I2C bus number |
| `Address` | string | required | I2C address (hex) |
| `PowerState` | string | `Always` | `On`, `BiosPost`, `Always` |
| `PollRate` | float | 1.0 | Seconds between readings |
| `Offset` | float | 0.0 | Value offset |
| `ScaleFactor` | float | 1.0 | Value multiplier |
| `MaxValue` | float | - | Maximum expected value |
| `MinValue` | float | - | Minimum expected value |
| `Hysteresis` | float | - | Threshold hysteresis |

</div>

### Kernel Driver Configuration

    

Load I2C sensor drivers:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check if driver is loaded</span>
lsmod | <span class="nb">grep </span>tmp75

<span class="c"># Manually instantiate device</span>
<span class="nb">echo </span>tmp75 0x48 <span class="o">></span> /sys/bus/i2c/devices/i2c-1/new_device

<span class="c"># Verify hwmon created</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/bus/i2c/devices/1-0048/hwmon/

<span class="c"># Remove device</span>
<span class="nb">echo </span>0x48 <span class="o">></span> /sys/bus/i2c/devices/i2c-1/delete_device
```

</div></div>

Device tree configuration:

```dts
&i2c1 {
    status = "okay";

    tmp75@48 {
        compatible = "ti,tmp75";
        reg = <0x48>;
    };
};
```

## Linux Hwmon Basics

    

### Sysfs Structure

    

Hwmon devices appear under `/sys/class/hwmon/`:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># List hwmon devices</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/class/hwmon/
<span class="c"># hwmon0  hwmon1  hwmon2  ...</span>

<span class="c"># Check device name</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon0/name
<span class="c"># tmp75</span>

<span class="c"># List available sensors</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon0/
<span class="c"># name  temp1_input  temp1_max  temp1_max_hyst  ...</span>
```

</div></div>

### Sensor Types and Naming

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Prefix | Type | Unit | Scale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `temp` | Temperature | millidegrees C | /1000 |
| `in` | Voltage | millivolts | /1000 |
| `curr` | Current | milliamps | /1000 |
| `power` | Power | microwatts | /1000000 |
| `fan` | Fan speed | RPM | 1 |
| `pwm` | PWM duty | 0-255 | /255 |

</div>

### Common Attributes

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Temperature sensor attributes</span>
temp1_input       <span class="c"># Current reading (millidegrees)</span>
temp1_max         <span class="c"># Maximum threshold</span>
temp1_max_hyst    <span class="c"># Hysteresis for max</span>
temp1_min         <span class="c"># Minimum threshold</span>
temp1_crit        <span class="c"># Critical threshold</span>
temp1_label       <span class="c"># Sensor label</span>

<span class="c"># Voltage sensor attributes</span>
in1_input         <span class="c"># Current reading (millivolts)</span>
in1_max           <span class="c"># Maximum threshold</span>
in1_min           <span class="c"># Minimum threshold</span>
in1_label         <span class="c"># Sensor label</span>

<span class="c"># Fan sensor attributes</span>
fan1_input        <span class="c"># Current RPM</span>
fan1_min          <span class="c"># Minimum RPM threshold</span>
fan1_target       <span class="c"># Target RPM (for control)</span>
pwm1              <span class="c"># PWM output (0-255)</span>
pwm1_enable       <span class="c"># Control mode (0=off, 1=manual, 2=auto)</span>
```

</div></div>

## Phosphor-Hwmon

    

### Overview

    

**phosphor-hwmon** is the legacy sensor daemon that:

* Reads hwmon sysfs periodically
* Exposes sensors on D-Bus
* Configured via YAML files
* Being replaced by dbus-sensors for new platforms

### Configuration

    

Configuration files in `/etc/default/obmc/hwmon/`:

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1"># /etc/default/obmc/hwmon/ahb--apb--bus@1e78a000--i2c-bus@80--tmp75@48.conf</span>
<span class="s">LABEL_temp1=ambient_temp</span>
<span class="s">WARNHI_temp1=40000</span>
<span class="s">WARNLO_temp1=5000</span>
<span class="s">CRITHI_temp1=45000</span>
<span class="s">CRITLO_temp1=0</span>
```

</div></div>

### Configuration Options

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `LABEL_` | D-Bus sensor name |
| `WARNHI_` | Warning high threshold (raw units) |
| `WARNLO_` | Warning low threshold |
| `CRITHI_` | Critical high threshold |
| `CRITLO_` | Critical low threshold |
| `GAIN_` | Multiplier for reading |
| `OFFSET_` | Offset to add to reading |
| `REMOVERCS_` | Remove sensor when not present |

</div>

### File Naming

    

Config file names match the device tree path with special characters replaced:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
Device tree path: /ahb/apb/bus@1e78a000/i2c-bus@80/tmp75@48
Config file:      ahb--apb--bus@1e78a000--i2c-bus@80--tmp75@48.conf
```

</div></div>

### Example Configuration

    

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1"># Temperature sensor with thresholds</span>
<span class="s">LABEL_temp1=cpu_temp</span>
<span class="s">WARNHI_temp1=85000</span>
<span class="s">CRITHI_temp1=95000</span>
<span class="s">WARNLO_temp1=0</span>
<span class="s">CRITLO_temp1=-5000</span>

<span class="c1"># Voltage sensor with scaling</span>
<span class="s">LABEL_in1=p12v_aux</span>
<span class="s">GAIN_in1=1.5</span>
<span class="s">WARNHI_in1=13200</span>
<span class="s">WARNLO_in1=10800</span>
<span class="s">CRITHI_in1=13800</span>
<span class="s">CRITLO_in1=10200</span>
```

</div></div>

### systemd Service

    

<div class="language-ini highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># /lib/systemd/system/xyz.openbmc_project.Hwmon@.service
</span><span class="nn">[Unit]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="py">Description</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">Hwmon %I</span>
<span class="w">
</span><span class="nn">[Service]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="py">ExecStart</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">/usr/bin/phosphor-hwmon-readd </span><span class="se">\
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">--path=/sys/class/hwmon/%i </span><span class="se">\
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">--instance=%i</span>
<span class="py">Restart</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">on-failure</span>
<span class="w">
</span><span class="nn">[Install]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="py">WantedBy</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">multi-user.target</span>
```

</div></div>

## Dbus-Sensors Hwmon

    

### HwmonTempSensor

    

The modern approach using dbus-sensors with Entity Manager.

**Service:** `xyz.openbmc_project.HwmonTempSensor`

### Entity Manager Configuration

    

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Exposes"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Address"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"0x48"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Bus"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Ambient Temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TMP75"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Thresholds"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper critical"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Severity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Value"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">45</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper warning"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Severity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

                </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w">

    </span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TRUE"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Board"</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

### Supported Sensor Types

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Type | Kernel Driver | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TMP75` | tmp75 | TI TMP75 temperature sensor |
| `TMP421` | tmp421 | TI TMP421 remote diode sensor |
| `TMP112` | tmp102 | TI TMP112 low-power sensor |

### FanSensor Daemon

    

For fan tachometer and PWM monitoring.

**Service:** `xyz.openbmc_project.FanSensor`

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Exposes"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Connector"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Fan0"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"Pwm"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"Tachs"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Fan0"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"AspeedFan"</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"FanBoard"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TRUE"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Board"</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### Fan Redundancy and Presence

    

The `fansensor` daemon does more than publish tach RPM — it can also track **fan
redundancy** (are enough fans healthy?) and **fan presence** (is the fan physically
installed?).

#### Redundancy

    

An `xyz.openbmc_project.Configuration.FanRedundancy` entry declares how many fans may
fail before the group is no longer redundant. The daemon exposes an
`xyz.openbmc_project.Control.FanRedundancy` interface at
`/xyz/openbmc_project/control/FanRedundancy/Tach`, whose `Status` property reports one
of three states:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `Full` | Every fan in the collection is healthy |
| `Degraded` | Some fans failed, but still within `AllowedFailures` |
| `Failed` | More fans failed than `AllowedFailures` permits |

</div>

Crossing out of and back into `Full` logs the Redfish messages
`OpenBMC.0.1.FanRedundancyLost` and `OpenBMC.0.1.FanRedundancyRegained`.

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.FanSensor <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/control/FanRedundancy/Tach <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Control.FanRedundancy Status
<span class="c"># s "Full"</span>
```

</div></div>

#### Presence GPIO

    

A fan’s config can carry a `Presence` sub-object so the daemon knows whether the fan is
installed. The `MonitorType` field selects one of two strategies:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| `MonitorType` | Class | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Event` (default) | `EventPresenceGpio` | Reacts to GPIO edge events (interrupt-driven) |
| `Polling` | `PollingPresenceGpio` | Samples the GPIO line on a timer |

</div>

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Connector"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Fan0"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Pwm"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Tachs"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Presence"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"MonitorType"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Event"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"PinName"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"FAN0_PRESENCE"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Polarity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Low"</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Fan0"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"AspeedFan"</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

`Polarity` is `"Low"` when the line reads low while the fan is present (inverted), or
`"High"` otherwise. When a fan is reported absent, its tach sensor is treated as
not-present rather than as a failed fan, which keeps a deliberately empty fan slot from
tripping the redundancy logic.

---

## Kernel Driver Configuration

    

### Device Tree

    

```dts
// I2C temperature sensor
&i2c1 {
    status = "okay";

    tmp75@48 {
        compatible = "ti,tmp75";
        reg = <0x48>;
    };

    tmp75@49 {
        compatible = "ti,tmp75";
        reg = <0x49>;
    };
};

// Aspeed ADC
&adc {
    status = "okay";
    pinctrl-names = "default";
    pinctrl-0 = <&pinctrl_adc0_default
                 &pinctrl_adc1_default
                 &pinctrl_adc2_default>;
};

// Aspeed PWM/Fan tach
&pwm_tacho {
    status = "okay";
    pinctrl-names = "default";
    pinctrl-0 = <&pinctrl_pwm0_default
                 &pinctrl_tach0_default>;

    fan@0 {
        reg = <0x00>;
        aspeed,fan-tach-ch = /bits/ 8 <0x00>;
    };
};
```

### Loading Drivers Manually

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Load I2C device</span>
<span class="nb">echo </span>tmp75 0x48 <span class="o">></span> /sys/bus/i2c/devices/i2c-1/new_device

<span class="c"># Check if hwmon appeared</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/bus/i2c/devices/1-0048/hwmon/

<span class="c"># Remove device</span>
<span class="nb">echo </span>0x48 <span class="o">></span> /sys/bus/i2c/devices/i2c-1/delete_device
```

</div></div>
---

## Reading Sensors

    

### Direct Sysfs Access

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Find hwmon device</span>
find /sys/class/hwmon <span class="nt">-name</span> <span class="s2">"name"</span> <span class="nt">-exec</span> sh <span class="nt">-c</span> <span class="s1">'echo "$1: $(cat $1)"'</span> _ <span class="o">{}</span> <span class="se">\;</span>

<span class="c"># Read temperature (millidegrees to degrees)</span>
<span class="nv">temp</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="si">$(</span><span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon0/temp1_input<span class="si">)</span>
<span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"Temperature: </span><span class="k">$((</span>temp <span class="o">/</span> <span class="m">1000</span><span class="k">))</span><span class="s2">.</span><span class="k">$((</span>temp <span class="o">%</span> <span class="m">1000</span><span class="k">))</span><span class="s2"> C"</span>

<span class="c"># Read all temperature sensors</span>
<span class="k">for </span>f <span class="k">in</span> /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon<span class="k">*</span>/temp<span class="k">*</span>_input<span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">do
    </span><span class="nv">name</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="si">$(</span><span class="nb">dirname</span> <span class="nv">$f</span><span class="si">)</span>/name
    <span class="nv">label</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="si">$(</span><span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="nv">$f</span> | <span class="nb">sed</span> <span class="s1">'s/_input/_label/'</span><span class="si">)</span>
    <span class="nv">val</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="si">$(</span><span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="nv">$f</span> 2>/dev/null<span class="si">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="o">[</span> <span class="nt">-n</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="nv">$val</span><span class="s2">"</span> <span class="o">]</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">then
        </span><span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">$(</span><span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="nv">$name</span> 2>/dev/null<span class="si">)</span><span class="s2"> </span><span class="si">$(</span><span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="nv">$label</span> 2>/dev/null<span class="si">)</span><span class="s2">: </span><span class="k">$((</span>val/1000<span class="k">))</span><span class="s2">C"</span>
    <span class="k">fi
done</span>
```

</div></div>

```
    GetSubTree sias <span class="s2">"/xyz/openbmc_project/sensors"</span> 0 1 <span class="se">\</span>
```

## Phosphor-Hwmon vs Dbus-Sensors

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Feature | phosphor-hwmon | dbus-sensors |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Configuration | YAML files | Entity Manager JSON |
| Auto-discovery | No | Yes (probes) |
| Hot-plug support | Limited | Yes |
| Sensor types | Generic | Type-specific daemons |
| Threshold config | YAML | JSON with severity |
| Recommended for | Legacy systems | New platforms |

</div>

### Migration Path

    

1. Identify existing phosphor-hwmon configs
2. Create Entity Manager JSON equivalents
3. Verify sensor names match
4. Test threshold behavior
5. Remove old YAML configs
6. Update machine layer

---

## Troubleshooting

    

### Sensor Not Appearing

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check kernel driver loaded</span>
dmesg | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> tmp75
lsmod | <span class="nb">grep </span>tmp75

<span class="c"># Verify I2C device exists</span>
i2cdetect <span class="nt">-y</span> 1

<span class="c"># Check hwmon created</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/bus/i2c/devices/1-0048/hwmon/

<span class="c"># Check daemon logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> xyz.openbmc_project.hwmontempsensor <span class="nt">-f</span>
```

</div></div>

### Wrong Readings

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Compare raw hwmon value</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon0/temp1_input
<span class="c"># 25500 (25.5°C in millidegrees)</span>

<span class="c"># Compare D-Bus value</span>
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.HwmonTempSensor <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/sensors/temperature/Ambient_Temp <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Sensor.Value Value
<span class="c"># d 25.5</span>

<span class="c"># Check for scaling issues in Entity Manager</span>
<span class="c"># ScaleFactor, Offset properties</span>
```

</div></div>

### Threshold Alarms Not Working

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check threshold values on D-Bus</span>
busctl introspect xyz.openbmc_project.HwmonTempSensor <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/sensors/temperature/Ambient_Temp | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> threshold

<span class="c"># Verify sel-logger is running</span>
systemctl status xyz.openbmc_project.sel-logger

<span class="c"># Check for threshold events</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> xyz.openbmc_project.sel-logger | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> threshold
```

</div></div>

### Device Not Binding

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check device tree</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/ahb/apb/bus@1e78a000/i2c-bus@80/tmp75@48/compatible

<span class="c"># Try manual bind</span>
<span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"1-0048"</span> <span class="o">></span> /sys/bus/i2c/drivers/tmp75/bind

<span class="c"># Check kernel errors</span>
dmesg | <span class="nb">tail</span> <span class="nt">-20</span>
```

</div></div>

## Best Practices

    

1. **Use dbus-sensors** for new platforms
2. **Verify device tree** bindings match actual hardware
3. **Test thresholds** to ensure alarms trigger correctly
4. **Use meaningful names** that identify physical location
5. **Document scaling factors** for voltage dividers
6. **Monitor daemon logs** during development

## Deep Dive

    

Advanced implementation details for hwmon sensor developers.

### Hwmon Sysfs Attribute Lifecycle

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Hwmon Device Registration Flow                          │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  I2C Device Probe                                                          │
│        │                                                                   │
│        v                                                                   │
│  ┌─────────────────┐                                                       │
│  │ tmp75_probe()   │  Driver probes I2C device                             │
│  │                 │                                                       │
│  │ 1. i2c_smbus_   │                                                       │
│  │    read_byte()  │  Verify device responds                               │
│  │                 │                                                       │
│  │ 2. Allocate     │                                                       │
│  │    driver data  │                                                       │
│  └────────┬────────┘                                                       │
│           │                                                                │
│           v                                                                │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │              devm_hwmon_device_register_with_info()                 │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  Parameters:                                                        │   │
│  │    - dev: parent device (i2c_client)                                │   │
│  │    - name: "tmp75"                                                  │   │
│  │    - drvdata: driver private data                                   │   │
│  │    - chip: hwmon_chip_info structure                                │   │
│  │    - extra_groups: additional sysfs groups (optional)               │   │
│  └────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                               │                                            │
│                               v                                            │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                   Hwmon Core Processing                             │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  1. Allocate hwmon_device                                           │   │
│  │  2. Assign hwmonN name (hwmon0, hwmon1, ...)                        │   │
│  │  3. Create sysfs directory:                                         │   │
│  │     /sys/class/hwmon/hwmonN/                                        │   │
│  │  4. Create standard attributes:                                     │   │
│  │     - name (device name)                                            │   │
│  │     - device -> symlink to parent                                   │   │
│  │  5. Create channel attributes from hwmon_chip_info:                 │   │
│  │     - temp1_input, temp1_max, temp1_min, ...                        │   │
│  │  6. Add device to hwmon class                                       │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                               │                                            │
│                               v                                            │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │                 Sysfs Attribute Access                              │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  User reads /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon0/temp1_input                     │   │
│  │        │                                                            │   │
│  │        v                                                            │   │
│  │  hwmon_attr_show()                                                  │   │
│  │        │                                                            │   │
│  │        v                                                            │   │
│  │  chip->ops->read(dev, hwmon_temp, hwmon_temp_input, channel, &val)  │   │
│  │        │                                                            │   │
│  │        v                                                            │   │
│  │  Driver's read function (e.g., tmp75_read())                        │   │
│  │        │                                                            │   │
│  │        v                                                            │   │
│  │  i2c_smbus_read_word_data() → returns millidegrees                  │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Hwmon Channel Configuration

    

<div class="language-c highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="cm">/* Driver hwmon_chip_info structure example (simplified tmp75) */</span>

<span class="k">static</span> <span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">u32</span> <span class="n">tmp75_temp_config</span><span class="p">[]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="n">HWMON_T_INPUT</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="n">HWMON_T_MAX</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="n">HWMON_T_MIN</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="n">HWMON_T_MAX_HYST</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="mi">0</span>  <span class="cm">/* Terminator */</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="k">static</span> <span class="k">const</span> <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">hwmon_channel_info</span> <span class="n">tmp75_temp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">hwmon_temp</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">config</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">tmp75_temp_config</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="k">static</span> <span class="k">const</span> <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">hwmon_channel_info</span> <span class="o">*</span><span class="n">tmp75_info</span><span class="p">[]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="o">&</span><span class="n">tmp75_temp</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="nb">NULL</span>  <span class="cm">/* Terminator */</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="k">static</span> <span class="k">const</span> <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">hwmon_ops</span> <span class="n">tmp75_hwmon_ops</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">is_visible</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">tmp75_is_visible</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="cm">/* Which attrs are visible */</span>
    <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">read</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">tmp75_read</span><span class="p">,</span>               <span class="cm">/* Read attribute value */</span>
    <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">write</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">tmp75_write</span><span class="p">,</span>             <span class="cm">/* Write attribute value */</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="k">static</span> <span class="k">const</span> <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">hwmon_chip_info</span> <span class="n">tmp75_chip_info</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">ops</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="o">&</span><span class="n">tmp75_hwmon_ops</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">info</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">tmp75_info</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="cm">/* Attribute flag meanings:
 * HWMON_T_INPUT     -> temp1_input     (current reading)
 * HWMON_T_MAX       -> temp1_max       (high threshold)
 * HWMON_T_MIN       -> temp1_min       (low threshold)
 * HWMON_T_MAX_HYST  -> temp1_max_hyst  (hysteresis)
 * HWMON_T_CRIT      -> temp1_crit      (critical threshold)
 * HWMON_T_LABEL     -> temp1_label     (sensor name)
 */</span>
```

</div></div>

### Phosphor-Hwmon Sysfs Matching Algorithm

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 Phosphor-Hwmon Device Discovery                            │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  1. SYSTEMD SERVICE INSTANTIATION                                          │
│     ─────────────────────────────                                          │
│     xyz.openbmc_project.Hwmon@ahb--apb--bus@1e78a000--i2c-bus@80--tmp75@48  │
│                                                                            │
│     Instance name encodes device tree path:                                │
│       / → --                                                               │
│       @ → @                                                                │
│                                                                            │
│  2. DEVICE PATH RESOLUTION                                                 │
│     ───────────────────────                                                │
│     Instance: ahb--apb--bus@1e78a000--i2c-bus@80--tmp75@48                  │
│          │                                                                 │
│          v                                                                 │
│     /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/ahb/apb/bus@1e78a000/i2c-bus@80/tmp75@48 │
│          │                                                                 │
│          v                                                                 │
│     Find symlink in /sys/bus/i2c/devices/                                  │
│     → 1-0048 (bus 1, address 0x48)                                         │
│          │                                                                 │
│          v                                                                 │
│     /sys/bus/i2c/devices/1-0048/hwmon/hwmon3/                              │
│                                                                            │
│  3. CONFIGURATION FILE LOOKUP                                              │
│     ──────────────────────────                                             │
│     Search order:                                                          │
│       1. /etc/default/obmc/hwmon/<instance>.conf                           │
│       2. /usr/share/phosphor-hwmon/<instance>.conf                         │
│                                                                            │
│     Config content:                                                        │
│       LABEL_temp1=ambient_temp                                             │
│       WARNHI_temp1=40000                                                   │
│       CRITHI_temp1=45000                                                   │
│                                                                            │
│  4. D-BUS OBJECT CREATION                                                  │
│     ────────────────────────                                               │
│     Path: /xyz/openbmc_project/sensors/temperature/ambient_temp            │
│     Interfaces:                                                            │
│       - xyz.openbmc_project.Sensor.Value                                   │
│       - xyz.openbmc_project.Sensor.Threshold.Warning                       │
│       - xyz.openbmc_project.Sensor.Threshold.Critical                      │
│       - xyz.openbmc_project.State.Decorator.OperationalStatus              │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Dbus-Sensors HwmonTempSensor Processing Pipeline

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  HwmonTempSensor Processing Flow                           │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  ENTITY MANAGER SIGNAL                                                     │
│  ─────────────────────                                                     │
│        │                                                                   │
│        v                                                                   │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  createSensors() callback triggered                                 │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  1. Query ObjectMapper for Entity Manager configurations            │   │
│  │  2. Filter for supported sensor types (TMP75, LM75A, etc.)          │   │
│  │  3. Extract Bus, Address, Name from configuration                   │   │
│  └────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                           │                                                │
│                           v                                                │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  findHwmonPath(bus, address)                                        │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  Search algorithm:                                                  │   │
│  │    for each /sys/bus/i2c/devices/<bus>-<addr>/hwmon/hwmon*/         │   │
│  │      check name matches expected driver                             │   │
│  │      verify temp*_input exists                                      │   │
│  │      return path on match                                           │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  Result: /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon3/temp1_input                        │   │
│  └────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                           │                                                │
│                           v                                                │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  HwmonTempSensor object construction                                │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  sensor = std::make_shared<HwmonTempSensor>(                        │   │
│  │      hwmonPath,                 // "/sys/class/hwmon/hwmon3"        │   │
│  │      sensorType,                // "TMP75"                          │   │
│  │      objectServer,              // D-Bus object server              │   │
│  │      dbusConnection,            // D-Bus connection                 │   │
│  │      name,                      // "Ambient_Temp"                   │   │
│  │      thresholds,                // vector of threshold configs      │   │
│  │      pollRate,                  // 1.0 seconds                      │   │
│  │      powerState                 // "Always"                         │   │
│  │  );                                                                 │   │
│  └────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                           │                                                │
│                           v                                                │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  setupRead() - Initialize polling                                   │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  1. Open file descriptor for temp1_input                            │   │
│  │  2. Set up boost::asio::posix::stream_descriptor                    │   │
│  │  3. Start async_wait timer for polling                              │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  Poll cycle:                                                        │   │
│  │    waitTimer.expires_after(pollRate)                                │   │
│  │    waitTimer.async_wait([this] {                                    │   │
│  │        handleResponse();  // Read and process                       │   │
│  │    });                                                              │   │
│  └────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                           │                                                │
│                           v                                                │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  handleResponse() - Process reading                                 │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  1. lseek(fd, 0, SEEK_SET)         // Reset to start                │   │
│  │  2. read(fd, buffer, size)         // Read raw value                │   │
│  │  3. value = atof(buffer) / 1000.0  // Convert millidegrees          │   │
│  │  4. updateValue(value)             // Update D-Bus + thresholds     │   │
│  │  5. Schedule next read                                              │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  updateValue() triggers:                                            │   │
│  │    - D-Bus property change signal                                   │   │
│  │    - Threshold crossing check                                       │   │
│  │    - SEL entry generation if threshold crossed                      │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Threshold Hysteresis Implementation

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  Threshold Crossing with Hysteresis                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  Temperature                                                               │
│      ^                                                                     │
│      │                                                                     │
│  95° ├─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─  Critical High                 │
│      │                    ╱ ╲                                              │
│  92° ├─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─╱─ ─╲─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─  Crit High - Hysteresis        │
│      │                  ╱     ╲                                            │
│  85° ├─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─  ╱─ ─ ─ ─╲─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─  Warning High                  │
│      │                ╱         ╲                                          │
│  82° ├─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─╱─ ─ ─ ─ ─ ─╲─ ─ ─ ─ ─  Warn High - Hysteresis        │
│      │              ╱             ╲                                        │
│  70° ├─────────────╱───────────────╲───────  Normal Operation              │
│      │            ╱                 ╲                                      │
│      │           ╱                   ╲                                     │
│      └──────────────────────────────────────> Time                         │
│                                                                            │
│  THRESHOLD STATE MACHINE:                                                  │
│                                                                            │
│   ┌──────────┐    value > threshold     ┌──────────┐                       │
│   │  Normal  │ ────────────────────────>│ Asserted │                       │
│   │          │                          │          │                       │
│   │ alarm=   │<─────────────────────────│ alarm=   │                       │
│   │ false    │  value < (thresh - hyst) │ true     │                       │
│   └──────────┘                          └──────────┘                       │
│                                                                            │
│  Example with 3°C hysteresis:                                              │
│    - Warning asserts when temp > 85°C                                      │
│    - Warning deasserts when temp < 82°C (85 - 3)                           │
│    - Prevents oscillation when temp hovers near threshold                  │
│                                                                            │
│  Code pattern (from thresholds.cpp):                                       │
│                                                                            │
│    if (!asserted && value > threshold) {                                   │
│        asserted = true;                                                    │
│        logThresholdCrossing(/* assert */);                                 │
│    } else if (asserted && value < (threshold - hysteresis)) {              │
│        asserted = false;                                                   │
│        logThresholdCrossing(/* deassert */);                               │
│    }                                                                       │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Source Code Reference

    

Key implementation files in [dbus-sensors](https://github.com/openbmc/dbus-sensors) and [phosphor-hwmon](https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-hwmon):

<div class="table-wrapper">
| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `dbus-sensors/src/HwmonTempSensor.cpp` | Temperature sensor implementation with sysfs polling |
| `dbus-sensors/src/Thresholds.cpp` | Threshold crossing detection with hysteresis |
| `dbus-sensors/src/Utils.cpp` | Hwmon path discovery and Entity Manager query |
| `phosphor-hwmon/mainloop.cpp` | Main sensor reading loop for legacy hwmon |
| `phosphor-hwmon/sysfs.cpp` | Sysfs attribute reading and parsing |
| `phosphor-hwmon/env.cpp` | Configuration file parsing (LABEL_, WARNHI_, etc.) |

</div>

**Tested on**: OpenBMC master, QEMU romulus

## Overview

    

**Entity Manager** is the configuration backbone of OpenBMC. It:

* Discovers hardware through **probes**
* Exposes hardware entities on **D-Bus**
* Configures sensors, fans, LEDs, and other components via **JSON**
* Replaces hardcoded YAML configurations with dynamic discovery

```mermaid
---
title: Entity Manager Architecture
---
flowchart TB
    json["JSON Configurations  
/usr/share/entity-manager/configs/"]

    json --> em

    subgraph em["Entity Manager"]
        direction LR
        probes["Probes  
(hardware detection)"]
        matcher["Matcher  
(evaluates conditions)"]
        exposes["Exposes  
(creates D-Bus objs)"]
        probes --> matcher --> exposes
    end

    em --> dbus["D-Bus  
xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item.*  
xyz.openbmc_project.Configuration.*"]

    dbus --> sensors["dbus-sensors"]
    dbus --> fan["fan-control"]
    dbus --> fru["FRU"]
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Entity Manager Architecture                  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                 │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                      JSON Configurations                    ││
│  │              /usr/share/entity-manager/configs/             ││
│  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘│
│                             │                                   │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                      Entity Manager                         ││
│  │                                                             ││
│  │   ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐  ││
│  │   │    Probes    │───▶│   Matcher    │───▶│   Exposes    │  ││
│  │   │  (hardware   │    │ (evaluates   │    │ (creates     │  ││
│  │   │  detection)  │    │  conditions) │    │  D-Bus objs) │  ││
│  │   └──────────────┘    └──────────────┘    └──────────────┘  ││
```
