## Setup & Configuration

    

### Build-Time Configuration (Yocto)

    

Include Entity Manager in your image:

```bitbake
# In your machine .conf or image recipe
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " entity-manager"

# Include FRU device support
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " fru-device"
```

### Meson Build Options

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
meson setup build <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Dfru-device</span><span class="o">=</span>enabled <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Dconfiguration-directory</span><span class="o">=</span>/usr/share/entity-manager/configurations
```

</div></div>

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fru-device` | enabled | FRU EEPROM detection |
| `configuration-directory` | /usr/share/… | JSON config location |

</div>

### Runtime Enable/Disable

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check Entity Manager status</span>
systemctl status xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager

<span class="c"># Restart to reload configurations</span>
systemctl restart xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager

<span class="c"># Disable Entity Manager (not recommended)</span>
systemctl stop xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager
systemctl disable xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager

<span class="c"># Check FRU device service</span>
systemctl status xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice
```

</div></div>

### Configuration File Locations

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Primary configuration directory</span>
/usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/

<span class="c"># Machine-specific overrides (higher priority)</span>
/etc/entity-manager/configurations/

<span class="c"># Runtime configuration directory</span>
/var/lib/entity-manager/
```

</div></div>

### Adding New Configurations

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Create a new configuration file</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="o">></span> /usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/my-board.json <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="sh">'</span><span class="no">EOF</span><span class="sh">'
{
    "Name": "MyBoard",
    "Type": "Board",
    "Probe": "TRUE",
    "Exposes": [...]
}
</span><span class="no">EOF

</span><span class="c"># Reload Entity Manager</span>
systemctl restart xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager

<span class="c"># Verify configuration loaded</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager | <span class="nb">grep </span>MyBoard
```

</div></div>

### Configuration Priority

    

When multiple configurations match:

1. `/etc/entity-manager/configurations/` (highest priority)
2. `/usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/`
3. Built-in defaults (lowest priority)

### Hot-Reload Configurations

    

Entity Manager monitors for file changes:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Modify a configuration file</span>
vim /usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/my-board.json

<span class="c"># Entity Manager automatically reloads (no restart needed)</span>
<span class="c"># Or force reload</span>
busctl call xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/EntityManager <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager Reload
```

</div></div>

### Disable Specific Configurations

    

To disable a configuration without deleting it:

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"DisabledBoard"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Board"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"FALSE"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Exposes"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="err">...</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

Or move to a disabled directory:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="nb">mkdir</span> <span class="nt">-p</span> /usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/disabled
<span class="nb">mv </span>my-board.json configurations/disabled/
systemctl restart xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager
```

</div></div>

### D-Bus Configuration Interface

    

Query and manipulate configurations via D-Bus:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># List all configurations</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager

<span class="c"># Get configuration properties</span>
busctl introspect xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/MyBoard

<span class="c"># Check if entity is present</span>
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/MyBoard <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item Present
```

</div></div>
---

## JSON Configuration Structure

    

> **Source Reference**: entity-manager
>   
>     Configuration examples: configurations/
>     Schema documentation: docs/

### Basic Structure

    

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"MyBoard"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Board"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TRUE"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Exposes"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Sensor1"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"SensorType"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="err">...</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### Key Fields

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | Yes | Unique identifier for this entity |
| `Type` | Yes | Entity type (Board, Chassis, CPU, etc.) |
| `Probe` | Yes | Condition for when to load this config |
| `Exposes` | No | Array of components this entity exposes |
| `xyz.openbmc_project.*` | No | Additional D-Bus interfaces to implement |

</div>
---

## Probe System

    

Probes determine when a configuration should be applied.

### Simple Probes

    

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">Always</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">apply</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TRUE"</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">Never</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">apply</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">(disabled)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"FALSE"</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### FRU Probes

    

Detect hardware by reading FRU EEPROM data:

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">Match</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">specific</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">board</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">by</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">FRU</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">fields</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME': 'MyBoard'})"</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">Match</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">by</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">manufacturer</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'BOARD_MANUFACTURER': 'ACME'})"</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">Match</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">by</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">part</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">number</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'PRODUCT_PART_NUMBER': 'ABC-123'})"</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### I2C Device Probes

    

Detect I2C devices:

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">Check</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">device</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">responds</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">at</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">address</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"i2c({'bus': 1, 'address': 72})"</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">With</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">multiple</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">addresses</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"i2c({'bus': 1, 'address': [72, 73]})"</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### GPIO Probes

    

Detect by GPIO state:

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">Check</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">GPIO</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">value</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"gpio({'name': 'BOARD_ID0', 'value': 1})"</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### Compound Probes

    

Combine conditions with AND/OR:

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">AND</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">condition</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"AND(
    xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME': 'MyBoard'}),
    i2c({'bus': 1, 'address': 72})
)"</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">OR</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">condition</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"OR(
    xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME': 'BoardV1'}),
    xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME': 'BoardV2'})
)"</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### Record-Based Probes

    

Use found records in expressions:

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'PRODUCT_MANUFACTURER': 'ACME'})"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Board"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Exposes"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME Temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Bus"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$bus"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Address"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$address"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TMP75"</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>
---

## Exposes Section

    

The `Exposes` array defines components provided by this entity.

### Sensor Exposures

    

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```

            </span><span class="nl">"Thresholds"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">

                    </span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper critical"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

                    </span><span class="nl">"Value"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">95</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper warning"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Severity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"Value"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">85</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"P12V"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"ADC"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Index"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"ScaleFactor"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">4.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"PowerState"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"On"</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

## D-Bus Interface Implementation

    

Entity Manager can implement arbitrary D-Bus interfaces:

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"MyBoard"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TRUE"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Board"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

    </span><span class="nl">"xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Present"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"PrettyName"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Main Board"</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">

    </span><span class="nl">"xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Asset"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Manufacturer"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"ACME Corp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Model"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Server-X"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"PartNumber"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"ABC-123"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"SerialNumber"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"SN-001"</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">

    </span><span class="nl">"xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Revision"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Version"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"1.0"</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

## Configuration Files Location

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
/usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/
├── baseboard.json           # Main system board
├── psu.json                 # Power supplies
├── fans.json                # Fan configuration
├── cpu.json                 # CPU sensors
├── memory.json              # Memory configuration
└── add-ons/
    ├── riser1.json         # Add-on card
    └── gpu.json            # GPU configuration
```

</div></div>

## Complete Example

    

### Board with Sensors, Fans, and FRU

    

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"MyServerBoard"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Board"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME': 'MyServer'})"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

    </span><span class="nl">"xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Present"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"PrettyName"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Server Main Board"</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">

    </span><span class="nl">"xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Asset"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Manufacturer"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$PRODUCT_MANUFACTURER"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"Model"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"PartNumber"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$PRODUCT_PART_NUMBER"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"SerialNumber"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$PRODUCT_SERIAL_NUMBER"</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">

    </span><span class="nl">"Exposes"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Inlet Temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TMP75"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Bus"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$bus"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Address"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"0x48"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Thresholds"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper critical"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Severity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Value"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">45</span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper warning"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Severity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Value"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">40</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Outlet Temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TMP75"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Bus"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"$bus"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Address"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"0x49"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Thresholds"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper critical"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Severity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Value"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">55</span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="nl">"Direction"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"greater than"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"upper warning"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Severity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nl">"Value"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"P12V"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"ADC"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
```

## D-Bus Interface

    

Entity Manager exposes configuration on D-Bus:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># List all configurations</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager

<span class="c"># Introspect a configuration</span>
busctl introspect xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/MyServerBoard

<span class="c"># Get configuration property</span>
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/board/MyServerBoard <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item Present
```

</div></div>

### Watching for Changes

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">

```
<span class="c"># Monitor for new devices</span>

<span class="c"># Monitor object manager signals</span>
dbus-monitor <span class="nt">--system</span> <span class="s2">"type='signal',interface='org.freedesktop.DBus.ObjectManager'"</span>
```

## Troubleshooting

    

### Configuration Not Loading

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check JSON syntax</span>
python3 <span class="nt">-m</span> json.tool < config.json

<span class="c"># Check Entity Manager logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> error

<span class="c"># Verify probe condition</span>
<span class="c"># For FRU probes, check if FRU is detected</span>
busctl call xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/FruDevice/device_0 <span class="se">\</span>
    org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties GetAll s <span class="s2">""</span>
```

</div></div>

### Sensors Not Appearing

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check sensor daemon received configuration</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> xyz.openbmc_project.hwmontempsensor | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> config

<span class="c"># Verify D-Bus object exists</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> sensor

<span class="c"># Check I2C device exists</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/bus/i2c/devices/
```

</div></div>

### Probe Not Matching

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Debug FRU probe</span>
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/FruDevice/device_0 <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME

<span class="c"># Check exact field name and value</span>
<span class="c"># Field names are case-sensitive</span>
```

</div></div>

## Best Practices

    

1. **Use probes** - Don’t use `"Probe": "TRUE"` unless absolutely necessary
2. **Test JSON** - Validate syntax before deploying
3. **Use variables** - Leverage `$bus`, `$address` from probe records
4. **Document thresholds** - Explain why each threshold value was chosen
5. **Group logically** - Keep related sensors in the same config file
6. **Version control** - Track configuration changes in git

---

## Deep Dive

    

Advanced implementation details for Entity Manager developers.

### Probe Evaluation Algorithm

    

Entity Manager evaluates probes in a specific order to determine which configurations to load:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Probe Evaluation Flow                               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   1. STARTUP                                                            │
│      ├── Load all JSON files from configuration directories             │
│      ├── Parse each configuration into memory                           │
│      └── Build dependency graph of probe conditions                     │
│                                                                         │
│   2. INITIAL PROBE EVALUATION                                           │
│      ├── Evaluate "TRUE" probes first (always match)                    │
│      ├── Query D-Bus for FruDevice objects                              │
│      ├── Query I2C bus for device presence                              │
│      ├── Query GPIO states                                              │
│      └── Evaluate compound probes (AND/OR)                              │
│                                                                         │
│   3. MATCH HANDLING                                                     │
│      ├── For each matching probe:                                       │
│      │   ├── Extract record values ($bus, $address, $FIELD)             │
│      │   ├── Substitute variables in Exposes section                    │
│      │   └── Create D-Bus objects for entity and children               │
│      └── Store matched configurations in active set                     │
│                                                                         │
│   4. CONTINUOUS MONITORING                                              │
│      ├── Watch for D-Bus signals (new FRU devices, etc.)                │
│      ├── Watch for file changes (inotify)                               │
│      └── Re-evaluate affected probes on changes                         │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Probe Evaluation Priority:**

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Priority | Probe Type | Evaluation Method |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `TRUE` / `FALSE` | Immediate (no D-Bus query) |
| 2 | `i2c()` | I2C device presence check |
| 3 | `gpio()` | GPIO line state query |
| 4 | `xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice()` | D-Bus property match |
| 5 | `AND()` / `OR()` | Recursive evaluation |

</div>

**Source reference**: [EntityManager.cpp](https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/blob/master/src/EntityManager.cpp)

### Variable Substitution System

    

Entity Manager supports variable substitution using the `$` prefix:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Variable Substitution                                │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Source Variables (from matched probe record):                         │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │  FruDevice match at /xyz/openbmc_project/FruDevice/device_0     │   │
│   │  ├── PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME = "MyServer"                          │   │
│   │  ├── PRODUCT_MANUFACTURER = "ACME"                              │   │
│   │  ├── PRODUCT_SERIAL_NUMBER = "SN12345"                          │   │
│   │  ├── bus = 1                                                    │   │
│   │  └── address = 80                                               │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
│   Configuration Template:                     After Substitution:       │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────┐            ┌─────────────────────┐    │
│   │ "Name": "$PRODUCT_PRODUCT   │     →      │ "Name": "MyServer"  │    │
│   │         _NAME"              │            │                     │    │
│   │ "Bus": "$bus"               │     →      │ "Bus": 1            │    │
│   │ "Address": "$address"       │     →      │ "Address": 80       │    │
│   └─────────────────────────────┘            └─────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                         │
│   Special Variables:                                                    │
│   ├── $bus      - I2C bus number from probe match                       │
│   ├── $address  - I2C device address from probe match                   │
│   ├── $index    - Array index when multiple matches                     │
│   └── $FIELD    - Any FRU field (PRODUCT_*, BOARD_*, CHASSIS_*)         │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Variable resolution order:**

1. Probe record properties (bus, address)
2. FRU field values (PRODUCT_*, BOARD_*)
3. Parent entity properties (inheritance)
4. Default values (if specified)

### Configuration Loading Sequence

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Configuration Loading Sequence                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Time ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────▶  │
│                                                                         │
│   ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐       │
│   │systemd  │  │FruDevice│  │ Entity  │  │ dbus-   │  │  PID    │       │
│   │ start   │  │ scans   │  │ Manager │  │ sensors │  │ control │       │
│   │         │  │ I2C bus │  │ probes  │  │ starts  │  │ starts  │       │
│   └────┬────┘  └────┬────┘  └────┬────┘  └────┬────┘  └────┬────┘       │
│        │            │            │            │            │            │
│        ▼            ▼            ▼            ▼            ▼            │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │                        D-Bus Timeline                           │   │
│   ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤   │
│   │ t=0s    xyz.openbmc_project.EntityManager claims name           │   │
│   │ t=0.5s  xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice claims name               │   │
│   │ t=1s    FruDevice emits InterfacesAdded for each EEPROM         │   │
│   │ t=1.5s  EntityManager receives signal, evaluates probes         │   │
│   │ t=2s    EntityManager creates D-Bus objects for matches         │   │
│   │ t=2.5s  dbus-sensors detects new Configuration objects          │   │
│   │ t=3s    Sensors appear on D-Bus                                 │   │
│   │ t=3.5s  phosphor-pid-control reads sensor configs               │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Key dependencies:**

* `xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice` must start before FRU probes work
* Entity Manager creates `xyz.openbmc_project.Configuration.*` objects
* Sensor daemons watch for Configuration objects via ObjectMapper

### D-Bus Object Creation

    

When a probe matches, Entity Manager creates D-Bus objects:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    D-Bus Object Hierarchy                               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Configuration JSON:                  D-Bus Objects Created:           │
│                                                                         │
│   {                                    /xyz/openbmc_project/            │
│     "Name": "MyBoard",                 └── inventory/                   │
│     "Type": "Board",                       └── system/                  │
│     ...                        ───▶            └── board/               │
│     "Exposes": [                                   └── MyBoard          │
│       {                                                ├── Decorator... │
│         "Name": "CPU_Temp",                            └── Item         │
│         "Type": "TMP75"                                                 │
│       }                                /xyz/openbmc_project/            │
│     ]                                  └── inventory/                   │
│   }                            ───▶        └── system/                  │
│                                                └── board/               │
│                                                    └── MyBoard/         │
│                                                        └── CPU_Temp     │
│                                                            └── TMP75    │
│                                                                         │
│   Object Path Construction:                                             │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ /xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/{Type}/{Name}/{Exposed}   │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Interface mapping:**

<div class="table-wrapper">
| JSON Field | D-Bus Interface |
| --- | --- |
| `xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item` | `xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Item` |
| `xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Asset` | `xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Asset` |
| `Type` in Exposes | `xyz.openbmc_project.Configuration.{Type}` |

</div>

### Hot-Reload Mechanism

    

Entity Manager uses inotify to detect configuration file changes:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Hot-Reload Implementation                            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │                     inotify Watches                             │   │
│   │   /usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/  ← IN_MODIFY        │   │
│   │   /etc/entity-manager/configurations/        ← IN_CREATE        │   │
│   │                                              ← IN_DELETE        │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
│   File Change Detection:                                                │
│   ┌──────────┐    ┌──────────┐    ┌──────────┐    ┌──────────┐          │
│   │ inotify  │───▶│ Parse    │───▶│ Compare  │───▶│ Update   │          │
│   │ event    │    │ new JSON │    │ with old │    │ D-Bus    │          │
│   └──────────┘    └──────────┘    └──────────┘    └──────────┘          │
│                                                                         │
│   Change Types:                                                         │
│   ├── New file: Evaluate probe, create objects if match                 │
│   ├── Modified: Re-evaluate probe, update or remove objects             │
│   └── Deleted: Remove associated D-Bus objects                          │
│                                                                         │
│   Debouncing:                                                           │
│   └── Multiple rapid changes are batched (100ms window)                 │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Note:** Hot-reload may not update all dependent services. Some sensor daemons require restart to pick up configuration changes.

### Probe Expression Parser

    

The probe expression parser supports a simple grammar:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Probe Expression Grammar                             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   probe      := "TRUE" | "FALSE" | func_call | compound                 │
│   compound   := "AND(" probe_list ")" | "OR(" probe_list ")"            │
│   probe_list := probe ("," probe)*                                      │
│   func_call  := func_name "(" params ")"                                │
│   func_name  := "i2c" | "gpio" | dbus_interface                         │
│   params     := json_object                                             │
│                                                                         │
│   Examples:                                                             │
│   ├── TRUE                                                              │
│   ├── i2c({'bus': 1, 'address': 72})                                    │
│   ├── xyz.openbmc_project.FruDevice({'PRODUCT_NAME': 'Board'})          │
│   ├── AND(i2c(...), gpio(...))                                          │
│   └── OR(FruDevice(...), FruDevice(...))                                │
│                                                                         │
│   Property Matching:                                                    │
│   ├── Exact match: {'FIELD': 'value'}                                   │
│   ├── Prefix match: {'FIELD': 'prefix*'}  (not supported)               │
│   └── Regex match: Not supported - use exact values                     │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Source reference**: [PerformProbe.cpp](https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/blob/master/src/PerformProbe.cpp)

## Overview

    

**phosphor-pid-control** (swampd) is the thermal management daemon for OpenBMC. It uses PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) control to maintain optimal temperatures by adjusting fan speeds.

```mermaid
---
title: Fan Control Architecture
---
flowchart TB
    sensors["Temperature Sensors  
(CPU, DIMM, Inlet, Outlet, VRM, etc.)"]

    sensors --> pid

    subgraph pid["phosphor-pid-control"]
        direction TB
        z0["Zone 0  
(CPU area)  
PID Control"]
        z1["Zone 1  
(Memory area)  
PID Control"]
        zn["Zone N  
(...)  
PID Control"]
    end

    pid --> fans["Fan PWM Outputs  
(Fan0, Fan1, Fan2, Fan3, ...)"]
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Fan Control Architecture                      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                 │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                  Temperature Sensors                        ││
│  │       (CPU, DIMM, Inlet, Outlet, VRM, etc.)                 ││
│  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘│
│                             │                                   │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                  phosphor-pid-control                       ││
│  │                                                             ││
│  │   ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐  ││
│  │   │  Zone 0      │    │  Zone 1      │    │  Zone N      │  ││
│  │   │  (CPU area)  │    │ (Memory area)│    │  (...)       │  ││
│  │   │              │    │              │    │              │  ││
│  │   │ PID Control  │    │ PID Control  │    │ PID Control  │  ││
│  │   └──────┬───────┘    └──────┬───────┘    └──────┬───────┘  ││
│  │          │                   │                   │          ││
│  └──────────┼───────────────────┼───────────────────┼──────────┘│
│             │                   │                   │           │
│  ┌──────────┴───────────────────┴───────────────────┴──────────┐│
│  │                       Fan PWM Outputs                       ││

└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div>  </div>

## Key Concepts

    

### Zones

    

A **zone** is a thermal control region with:

* Input sensors (temperature, margin)
* Output fans (PWM control)
* PID controllers for each sensor
* A failsafe behavior

### PID Controller

    

The PID algorithm calculates fan speed based on:

* **Proportional (P)**: Immediate response to error
* **Integral (I)**: Accumulated error over time
* **Derivative (D)**: Rate of change (often disabled)

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
Output = Kp × error + Ki × ∫error dt + Kd × d(error)/dt
```

</div></div>

### Setpoint

    

The target temperature the PID tries to maintain. The controller increases fan speed when temperature exceeds setpoint.

---

## Setup & Enable/Disable

    

### Build-Time Configuration (Yocto)

    

Include fan control in your image:

```bitbake
# In your machine .conf or image recipe
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " phosphor-pid-control"

# Or exclude it
IMAGE_INSTALL:remove = "phosphor-pid-control"
```

### Meson Build Options

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
meson setup build <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Dcontrol</span><span class="o">=</span>enabled <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Dhost-interface</span><span class="o">=</span>enabled <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Djson</span><span class="o">=</span>enabled <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-Dboot-time</span><span class="o">=</span>enabled
```

</div></div>

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `control` | enabled | Enable fan control daemon |
| `host-interface` | enabled | D-Bus interface for host control |
| `json` | enabled | JSON configuration support |
| `boot-time` | disabled | Log boot-time thermal data |

</div>

### Runtime Enable/Disable

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check service status</span>
systemctl status phosphor-pid-control

<span class="c"># Stop fan control (fans go to failsafe)</span>
systemctl stop phosphor-pid-control

<span class="c"># Disable fan control permanently</span>
systemctl disable phosphor-pid-control

<span class="c"># Re-enable and start</span>
systemctl <span class="nb">enable </span>phosphor-pid-control
systemctl start phosphor-pid-control

<span class="c"># Restart after config change</span>
systemctl restart phosphor-pid-control
```

</div></div>

### Manual vs Automatic Mode

    

Switch between manual and automatic fan control:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Get current mode</span>
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.State.FanCtrl <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/control/thermal/0 <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Control.ThermalMode Current

<span class="c"># Switch to Manual mode (disable PID control)</span>
busctl set-property xyz.openbmc_project.State.FanCtrl <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/control/thermal/0 <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Control.ThermalMode Current s <span class="s2">"Manual"</span>

<span class="c"># Switch back to Automatic mode (PID control)</span>
busctl set-property xyz.openbmc_project.State.FanCtrl <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/control/thermal/0 <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Control.ThermalMode Current s <span class="s2">"Default"</span>
```

</div></div>

### Direct PWM Control (Manual Mode)

    

When in manual mode, control fans directly:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Set fan to 50% (value 0-255, so 128 = ~50%)</span>
<span class="nb">echo </span>128 <span class="o">></span> /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon0/pwm1

<span class="c"># Or via D-Bus</span>
busctl set-property xyz.openbmc_project.FanSensor <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/control/fanpwm/Fan0 <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Control.FanPwm Target t 128
```

</div></div>
---

## Configuration

    

Configuration is done via JSON files loaded by Entity Manager or directly in `/usr/share/swampd/`.

> **Source Reference**: phosphor-pid-control
>   
>     Configuration schema: phosphor-pid-control/conf.hpp
>     Example configs: phosphor-pid-control/test/

### Zone Configuration

    

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"zones"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"minThermalOutput"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">25.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"failsafePercent"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">100.0</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Zone identifier |
| `minThermalOutput` | Minimum PWM % when zone is active |
| `failsafePercent` | PWM % when failsafe triggers |

</div>

### PID Configuration

    

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"pid"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"CPU Temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"inputs"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"CPU_Temp"</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"setpoint"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">80.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"pid"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"samplePeriod"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"proportionalCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"integralCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">-0.2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"feedFwdOffsetCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"feedFwdGainCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"integralLimit_min"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"integralLimit_max"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">100.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"outLim_min"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">25.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"outLim_max"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">100.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"slewNeg"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"slewPos"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### PID Parameters

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Parameter | Description | Typical Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `samplePeriod` | Control loop interval (seconds) | 0.1 - 1.0 |
| `proportionalCoeff` | P gain (often 0 for thermal) | 0.0 - 1.0 |
| `integralCoeff` | I gain (negative for cooling) | -0.5 to -0.1 |
| `feedFwdOffsetCoeff` | Feed-forward offset | 0.0 |
| `feedFwdGainCoeff` | Feed-forward gain | 0.0 |
| `integralLimit_min/max` | Integral windup limits | 0.0 - 100.0 |
| `outLim_min/max` | Output PWM limits | 0.0 - 100.0 |
| `slewNeg/slewPos` | Rate limits (0=unlimited) | 0.0 - 10.0 |

</div>

### Fan Configuration

    

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"fans"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Fan0"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"zone"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"sensors"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"Fan0_Tach"</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"output"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Fan0_PWM"</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Fan1"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"zone"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"sensors"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"Fan1_Tach"</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"output"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Fan1_PWM"</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>
---

```
    </span><span class="nl">"pid"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"CPU Temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"inputs"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"CPU_Temp"</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"setpoint"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">80.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"pid"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"samplePeriod"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"proportionalCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"integralCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">-0.2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"feedFwdOffsetCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"feedFwdGainCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"integralLimit_min"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"integralLimit_max"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">100.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"outLim_min"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">25.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"outLim_max"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">100.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"slewNeg"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"slewPos"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Inlet Temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"temp"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"inputs"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"Inlet_Temp"</span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"setpoint"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">35.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"pid"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"samplePeriod"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"proportionalCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"integralCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">-0.3</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"feedFwdOffsetCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"feedFwdGainCoeff"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"integralLimit_min"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"integralLimit_max"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">100.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"outLim_min"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">25.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"outLim_max"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">100.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"slewNeg"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"slewPos"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>
