## Setup & Configuration

    

### Build-Time Configuration (Yocto)

    

```bitbake
# In your machine .conf or local.conf

# Include LED management
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " \
    phosphor-led-manager \
    phosphor-led-sysfs \
"

# LED group configuration (JSON or YAML)
LED_MANAGER_LED_CONFIG = "led.yaml"
```

### Configuration Files and Paths

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Config File | Install Path | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LED groups (YAML) | `/usr/share/phosphor-led-manager/led.yaml` | YAML | Legacy: compiled into C++ at build time |
| LED groups (JSON) | `/usr/share/phosphor-led-manager/led.json` | JSON | Preferred: runtime-parsed at service startup |
| Entity Manager | `/usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/*.json` | EM JSON | Alternative: define LEDs via Entity Manager |

</div>

### Two Configuration Methods

    

phosphor-led-manager supports two approaches:

<div class="table-wrapper">
|  | YAML Config (build-time) | JSON Config (runtime) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Config path | `/usr/share/phosphor-led-manager/led.yaml` | `/usr/share/phosphor-led-manager/led.json` |
| When parsed | At meson build time (generates C++ constexpr) | At service startup (runtime parsing) |
| Edit cycle | Rebuild image for changes | Replace file and restart service |
| Meson option | Default | `-Duse-json=enabled` |
| Recommended for | Production (smaller binary) | Development and rapid iteration |

</div>

### JSON Configuration (preferred for development)

    

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"leds"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"group"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"/xyz/openbmc_project/led/groups/enclosure_identify"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"members"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"identify"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"action"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Blink"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"dutyOn"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"period"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"group"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"/xyz/openbmc_project/led/groups/power_fault"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"members"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"power"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"action"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"On"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"dutyOn"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">100</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
                    </span><span class="nl">"period"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### YAML Configuration (legacy)

    

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1"># led.yaml - compiled into C++ at build time</span>
<span class="na">bmc_booted</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">enclosure_identify</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="na">Action</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s1">'</span><span class="s">Off'</span>
        <span class="na">DutyOn</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">50</span>
        <span class="na">Period</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">0</span>

<span class="na">enclosure_identify</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">enclosure_identify</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="na">Action</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s1">'</span><span class="s">Blink'</span>
        <span class="na">DutyOn</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">50</span>
        <span class="na">Period</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">1000</span>

<span class="na">fault</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">power</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="na">Action</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s1">'</span><span class="s">On'</span>
        <span class="na">DutyOn</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">100</span>
        <span class="na">Period</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">0</span>
```

</div></div>

### Deploying LED Configuration via Yocto

    

#### Method 1: JSON Config (runtime)

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># meta-myplatform/recipes-phosphor/leds/phosphor-led-manager/</span>
<span class="c"># └── files/</span>
<span class="c"># │   └── led.json</span>
<span class="c"># └── phosphor-led-manager_%.bbappend</span>

<span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="o">></span> phosphor-led-manager_%.bbappend <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="sh">'</span><span class="no">EOF</span><span class="sh">'
FILESEXTRAPATHS:prepend := "</span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">THISDIR</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/files:"
SRC_URI += "file://led.json"

# Enable JSON parsing (instead of compiled YAML)
EXTRA_OEMESON:append = " -Duse-json=enabled"

do_install:append() {
    install -d </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">D</span><span class="k">}${</span><span class="nv">datadir</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/phosphor-led-manager
    install -m 0644 </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">WORKDIR</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/led.json </span><span class="se">\</span><span class="sh">
        </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">D</span><span class="k">}${</span><span class="nv">datadir</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/phosphor-led-manager/
}
</span><span class="no">EOF
</span>
```

</div></div>

#### Method 2: YAML Config (build-time)

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># meta-myplatform/recipes-phosphor/leds/phosphor-led-manager/</span>
<span class="c"># └── files/</span>
<span class="c"># │   └── led.yaml</span>
<span class="c"># └── phosphor-led-manager_%.bbappend</span>

<span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="o">></span> phosphor-led-manager_%.bbappend <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="sh">'</span><span class="no">EOF</span><span class="sh">'
FILESEXTRAPATHS:prepend := "</span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">THISDIR</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/files:"
SRC_URI += "file://led.yaml"

# Tell the build system where to find your YAML
LED_MANAGER_LED_CONFIG = "</span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">WORKDIR</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/led.yaml"
</span><span class="no">EOF
</span>
```

</div></div>

### Verification

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check LED manager service</span>
systemctl status phosphor-led-manager

<span class="c"># View available physical LEDs</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/class/leds/

<span class="c"># Check LED D-Bus groups</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.LED.GroupManager

<span class="c"># Verify a specific group is defined</span>
busctl introspect xyz.openbmc_project.LED.GroupManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/led/groups/enclosure_identify
```

</div></div>

## LED Actions

    

### Action Types

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Action | Description | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Off | LED off | None |
| On | LED on | None |
| Blink | Blinking | DutyOn (%), Period (ms) |

</div>

### Control LEDs via D-Bus

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Turn on identify LED</span>
busctl set-property xyz.openbmc_project.LED.GroupManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/led/groups/enclosure_identify <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Led.Group <span class="se">\</span>
    Asserted b <span class="nb">true</span>

<span class="c"># Turn off identify LED</span>
busctl set-property xyz.openbmc_project.LED.GroupManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/led/groups/enclosure_identify <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Led.Group <span class="se">\</span>
    Asserted b <span class="nb">false</span>
```

</div></div>

### Control via Redfish

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Get chassis indicator</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Chassis/chassis

<span class="c"># Turn on identify LED</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> PATCH <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"LocationIndicatorActive": true}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Chassis/chassis

<span class="c"># Turn off identify LED</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> PATCH <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"LocationIndicatorActive": false}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Chassis/chassis
```

</div></div>

### Control via IPMI

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Chassis identify on (continuous)</span>
ipmitool <span class="nt">-I</span> lanplus <span class="nt">-H</span> bmc-ip <span class="nt">-U</span> root <span class="nt">-P</span> 0penBmc chassis identify

<span class="c"># Chassis identify on (15 seconds)</span>
ipmitool <span class="nt">-I</span> lanplus <span class="nt">-H</span> bmc-ip <span class="nt">-U</span> root <span class="nt">-P</span> 0penBmc chassis identify 15

<span class="c"># Chassis identify off</span>
ipmitool <span class="nt">-I</span> lanplus <span class="nt">-H</span> bmc-ip <span class="nt">-U</span> root <span class="nt">-P</span> 0penBmc chassis identify 0
```

</div></div>
---

## LED Groups

    

### Standard Groups

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Group | Purpose | Trigger |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enclosure_identify` | Locate chassis | User request |
| `power_fault` | Power problem | PSU fault |
| `bmc_booted` | BMC ready | Boot complete |
| `cpu_fault` | CPU error | Hardware error |
| `memory_fault` | Memory error | DIMM fault |

</div>

### Create Custom Group

    

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1"># In led.yaml</span>
<span class="na">my_custom_group</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">custom_led</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="na">Action</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s1">'</span><span class="s">Blink'</span>
        <span class="na">DutyOn</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">50</span>
        <span class="na">Period</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">500</span>
```

</div></div>

### Group Priorities

    

When multiple groups control the same LED, priority determines the action:

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1"># Higher priority takes precedence</span>
<span class="c1"># Priority: Blink > On > Off</span>
```

</div></div>
---

## Lamp Test

    

Lamp test activates all LEDs to verify functionality.

### Trigger Lamp Test via D-Bus

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Start lamp test</span>
busctl set-property xyz.openbmc_project.LED.GroupManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/led/groups/lamp_test <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Led.Group <span class="se">\</span>
    Asserted b <span class="nb">true</span>

<span class="c"># Stop lamp test</span>
busctl set-property xyz.openbmc_project.LED.GroupManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/led/groups/lamp_test <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Led.Group <span class="se">\</span>
    Asserted b <span class="nb">false</span>
```

</div></div>

### Lamp Test Configuration

    

<div class="language-yaml highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="na">lamp_test</span><span class="pi">:</span>
    <span class="na">identify</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="na">Action</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s1">'</span><span class="s">On'</span>
        <span class="na">DutyOn</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">100</span>
        <span class="na">Period</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">0</span>
    <span class="na">power</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="na">Action</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s1">'</span><span class="s">On'</span>
        <span class="na">DutyOn</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">100</span>
        <span class="na">Period</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">0</span>
    <span class="na">fault</span><span class="pi">:</span>
        <span class="na">Action</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="s1">'</span><span class="s">On'</span>
        <span class="na">DutyOn</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">100</span>
        <span class="na">Period</span><span class="pi">:</span> <span class="m">0</span>
```

</div></div>

## sysfs LED Interface

    

### LED Sysfs Path

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># View LED attributes</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/leds/identify/brightness
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/leds/identify/max_brightness
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/leds/identify/trigger

<span class="c"># Set LED directly</span>
<span class="nb">echo </span>255 <span class="o">></span> /sys/class/leds/identify/brightness
<span class="nb">echo </span>0 <span class="o">></span> /sys/class/leds/identify/brightness
```

</div></div>

### Hardware Blink

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Use hardware blink if supported</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/leds/identify/trigger
<span class="c"># [none] timer heartbeat ...</span>

<span class="nb">echo </span>timer <span class="o">></span> /sys/class/leds/identify/trigger
<span class="nb">echo </span>500 <span class="o">></span> /sys/class/leds/identify/delay_on
<span class="nb">echo </span>500 <span class="o">></span> /sys/class/leds/identify/delay_off
```

</div></div>
---

## Entity Manager Integration

    

Entity Manager can define physical LED-to-GPIO mappings, which phosphor-led-sysfs
uses to create the sysfs LED entries. This is an alternative to device tree
`gpio-leds` definitions.

**Install path**: `/usr/share/entity-manager/configurations/.json`

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"MyBoard LEDs"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Board"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Probe"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"TRUE"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

    </span><span class="nl">"Exposes"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Identify LED"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"led"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Polarity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Active High"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"GpioPin"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"IDENTIFY_LED"</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">},</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Name"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Fault LED"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"led"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"Polarity"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"Active Low"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"GpioPin"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"FAULT_LED"</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

Deploy via Yocto:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="o">></span> entity-manager_%.bbappend <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="sh">'</span><span class="no">EOF</span><span class="sh">'
FILESEXTRAPATHS:prepend := "</span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">THISDIR</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/files:"
SRC_URI += "file://my-board-leds.json"

do_install:append() {
    install -d </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">D</span><span class="k">}${</span><span class="nv">datadir</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/entity-manager/configurations
    install -m 0444 </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">WORKDIR</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/my-board-leds.json </span><span class="se">\</span><span class="sh">
        </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">D</span><span class="k">}${</span><span class="nv">datadir</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/entity-manager/configurations/
}
</span><span class="no">EOF
</span>
```

</div></div>

Entity Manager LED definitions define the **physical LED hardware**. You still
need a `led.json` or `led.yaml` to define the **logical LED groups** (which
groups map to which physical LEDs with what actions).

---

## GPIO-Based LEDs

    

### Device Tree Configuration

    

```dts
leds {
    compatible = "gpio-leds";

    identify {
        label = "identify";
        gpios = <&gpio ASPEED_GPIO(A, 0) GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
        default-state = "off";
    };

    power {
        label = "power";
        gpios = <&gpio ASPEED_GPIO(A, 1) GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
        default-state = "on";
    };

    fault {
        label = "fault";
        gpios = <&gpio ASPEED_GPIO(A, 2) GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
        default-state = "off";
    };
};
```

## Troubleshooting

    

### LED Not Responding

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check sysfs LED exists</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/class/leds/

<span class="c"># Check LED permissions</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> <span class="nt">-la</span> /sys/class/leds/identify/

<span class="c"># Check LED driver</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/leds/identify/trigger

<span class="c"># Direct control test</span>
<span class="nb">echo </span>255 <span class="o">></span> /sys/class/leds/identify/brightness
```

</div></div>

### Group Not Activating

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check group exists</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.LED.GroupManager

<span class="c"># Check group properties</span>
busctl introspect xyz.openbmc_project.LED.GroupManager <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/led/groups/enclosure_identify

<span class="c"># Check LED manager logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> phosphor-led-manager
```

</div></div>

### Wrong LED Behavior

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Verify configuration file</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /usr/share/phosphor-led-manager/led.yaml

<span class="c"># Check priority conflicts</span>
<span class="c"># Multiple groups may control same LED</span>
```

## Deep Dive

    

Advanced implementation details for LED management developers.

### LED Blinking Algorithm

    

The LED manager implements software-controlled blinking for LEDs:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Blink Pattern Implementation                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Blink Parameters:                                                     │
│   ├── Period: Total cycle time (e.g., 1000ms)                           │
│   └── DutyOn: Percentage of period LED is on (e.g., 50%)                │
│                                                                         │
│   Example: Period=1000ms, DutyOn=50%                                    │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │   LED State                                                     │   │
│   │      ON  ─┐     ┌─────┐     ┌─────┐     ┌─────┐                 │   │
│   │           │     │     │     │     │     │     │                 │   │
│   │     OFF  ─┴─────┴─────┴─────┴─────┴─────┴─────┴─────────        │   │
│   │           │←  500ms  →│←  500ms  →│                             │   │
│   │           │←─────── 1000ms ──────→│                             │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
│   Implementation (timer-based):                                         │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ onTime = period * dutyOn / 100;                                 │   │
│   │ offTime = period - onTime;                                      │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │ while (blinking) {                                              │   │
│   │     setLED(ON);                                                 │   │
│   │     sleep(onTime);                                              │   │
│   │     setLED(OFF);                                                │   │
│   │     sleep(offTime);                                             │   │
│   │ }                                                               │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
│   Action Types:                                                         │
│   ├── On: LED constantly on (DutyOn=100, Period=0)                      │
│   ├── Off: LED constantly off                                           │
│   └── Blink: LED cycles per DutyOn/Period                               │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### LED Group Priority Resolution

    

When multiple LED groups request different states, priority determines outcome:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    LED Group Priority                                   │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Priority Levels (higher = more important):                            │
│   ┌────────┬─────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┐  │
│   │Priority│ Group               │ Description                       │  │
│   ├────────┼─────────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────┤  │
│   │   1    │ lamp_test           │ Override for manufacturing test   │  │
│   │   2    │ fault               │ Hardware fault indication         │  │
│   │   3    │ enclosure_identify  │ Chassis locate request            │  │
│   │   4    │ power               │ System power state                │  │
│   │   5    │ bmc_booted          │ BMC ready indication              │  │
│   └────────┴─────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                                                         │
│   Resolution Example:                                                   │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ LED: "identify" (front panel blue LED)                          │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │ Group Requests:                                                 │   │
│   │ ├── bmc_booted:        Blink (Priority 5)                       │   │
│   │ ├── power:             On (Priority 4)                          │   │
│   │ └── enclosure_identify: Blink-fast (Priority 3)                 │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │ Resolution: enclosure_identify wins → LED blinks fast           │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │ If enclosure_identify deactivated:                              │   │
│   │ → power group now wins → LED on                                 │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
│   D-Bus Group Interface:                                                │
│   /xyz/openbmc_project/led/groups/<group-name>                          │
│   └── Asserted (bool) - Group active state                              │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Sysfs LED Interface

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Kernel LED Sysfs Interface                           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   /sys/class/leds/<led-name>/                                           │
│   ├── brightness        # 0=off, max_brightness=full on                 │
│   ├── max_brightness    # Maximum brightness value (often 255)          │
│   ├── trigger           # Current trigger (none, timer, heartbeat)      │
│   ├── delay_on          # On time in ms (when trigger=timer)            │
│   └── delay_off         # Off time in ms (when trigger=timer)           │
│                                                                         │
│   phosphor-led-sysfs Mapping:                                           │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │   D-Bus Action         Sysfs Operations                         │   │
│   │   ─────────────        ────────────────                         │   │
│   │   Action=On         →  echo max > brightness                    │   │
│   │                        echo none > trigger                      │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │   Action=Off        →  echo 0 > brightness                      │   │
│   │                        echo none > trigger                      │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │   Action=Blink      →  echo timer > trigger                     │   │
│   │                        echo <on_ms> > delay_on                  │   │
│   │                        echo <off_ms> > delay_off                │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
│   Device Tree LED Definition:                                           │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ leds {                                                          │   │
│   │     compatible = "gpio-leds";                                   │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │     identify {                                                  │   │
│   │         gpios = <&gpio0 10 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;                   │   │
│   │         default-state = "off";                                  │   │
│   │     };                                                          │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │     fault {                                                     │   │
│   │         gpios = <&gpio0 11 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>;                    │   │
│   │         default-state = "off";                                  │   │
│   │     };                                                          │   │
│   │ };                                                              │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

## Overview

    

**phosphor-certificate-manager** manages X.509 certificates for HTTPS, LDAP, and other secure services on OpenBMC.

```mermaid
---
title: Certificate Manager Architecture
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph certmgr["phosphor-certificate-manager"]
        direction LR
        https["HTTPS Certs  
(/etc/ssl/certs/https/)"]
        ldapcert["LDAP Certs  
(/etc/ssl/certs/ldap/)"]
        authority["Authority Certs  
(Trusted CAs)"]
        csr["CSR Generation  
(Signing Req)"]
    end

    subgraph consumers["Certificate Consumers"]
        direction LR
        bmcweb["bmcweb  
(HTTPS server)"]
        ldapclient["LDAP Client  
(secure auth)"]
    end

    certmgr --> consumers
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                Certificate Manager Architecture                   |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                   |
|  +------------------------------------------------------------+   |
|  |             phosphor-certificate-manager                   |   |
|  |                                                            |   |
|  |   +------------------+  +------------------+               |   |
|  |   | HTTPS Certs      |  | LDAP Certs       |               |   |
|  |   | (/etc/ssl/certs/ |  | (/etc/ssl/certs/ |               |   |
|  |   |  https/)         |  |  ldap/)          |               |   |
|  |   +------------------+  +------------------+               |   |
|  |                                                            |   |
|  |   +------------------+  +------------------+               |   |
|  |   | Authority Certs  |  | CSR Generation   |               |   |
|  |   | (Trusted CAs)    |  | (Signing Req)    |               |   |
|  |   +------------------+  +------------------+               |   |
|  |                                                            |   |
|  +----------------------------+-------------------------------+   |
|                               |                                   |
|           +-------------------+-------------------+               |
|           |                                       |               |
|           v                                       v               |
|  +------------------+                   +------------------+      |
|  |     bmcweb       |                   |   LDAP Client    |      |
|  |  (HTTPS server)  |                   |  (secure auth)   |      |
|  +------------------+                   +------------------+      |
|                                                                   |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

</div>  </div>

---

## Setup & Configuration

    

### Build-Time Configuration

    

```bitbake
# Include certificate manager
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " phosphor-certificate-manager"
```

### Certificate Locations

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Type | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HTTPS Server | /etc/ssl/certs/https/server.pem | Web server certificate |
| HTTPS CA | /etc/ssl/certs/https/authority/ | Trusted CA certificates |
| LDAP Client | /etc/ssl/certs/ldap/ | LDAP client certificates |

</div>
---

## Managing Certificates

    

### View Current Certificate

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Via Redfish</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/CertificateService/CertificateLocations

<span class="c"># View certificate details</span>
openssl x509 <span class="nt">-in</span> /etc/ssl/certs/https/server.pem <span class="nt">-text</span> <span class="nt">-noout</span>
```

</div></div>

### Generate Self-Signed Certificate

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Generate on BMC</span>
openssl req <span class="nt">-x509</span> <span class="nt">-newkey</span> rsa:2048 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-keyout</span> /etc/ssl/private/server.pem <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-out</span> /etc/ssl/certs/https/server.pem <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-days</span> 365 <span class="nt">-nodes</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-subj</span> <span class="s2">"/CN=openbmc/O=MyOrg"</span>

<span class="c"># Restart bmcweb</span>
systemctl restart bmcweb
```

</div></div>

### Replace Certificate via Redfish

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Replace HTTPS certificate</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "CertificateType": "PEM",
        "CertificateString": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n...\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----"
    }'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/NetworkProtocol/HTTPS/Certificates

<span class="c"># Generate CSR</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "CommonName": "bmc.example.com",
        "Organization": "MyOrg",
        "Country": "US"
    }'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/CertificateService/Actions/CertificateService.GenerateCSR
```

</div></div>

### Add CA Certificate

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Add trusted CA</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "CertificateType": "PEM",
        "CertificateString": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n...\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----"
    }'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/Truststore/Certificates
```

</div></div>

## Deep Dive

    

Advanced implementation details for certificate management developers.

### X.509 Certificate Chain Validation

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Certificate Chain Validation Flow                       │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  INCOMING CERTIFICATE CHAIN                                                │
│  ──────────────────────────                                                │
│                                                                            │
│  ┌─────────────────────┐                                                   │
│  │   Leaf Certificate  │  Subject: CN=bmc.example.com                      │
│  │   (Server Cert)     │  Issuer: CN=Intermediate CA                       │
│  │                     │  Key Usage: Digital Signature, Key Encipherment   │
│  │                     │  Ext Key Usage: TLS Web Server Authentication     │
│  └──────────┬──────────┘                                                   │
│             │ Signed by                                                    │
│             v                                                              │
│  ┌─────────────────────┐                                                   │
│  │ Intermediate CA     │  Subject: CN=Intermediate CA                      │
│  │ Certificate         │  Issuer: CN=Root CA                               │
│  │                     │  Basic Constraints: CA:TRUE, pathLen:0            │
│  │                     │  Key Usage: Certificate Sign, CRL Sign            │
│  └──────────┬──────────┘                                                   │
│             │ Signed by                                                    │
│             v                                                              │
│  ┌─────────────────────┐                                                   │
│  │   Root CA           │  Subject: CN=Root CA (self-signed)                │
│  │   Certificate       │  Issuer: CN=Root CA                               │
│  │   (Trust Anchor)    │  Basic Constraints: CA:TRUE                       │
│  └─────────────────────┘                                                   │
│                                                                            │
│  VALIDATION STEPS (OpenSSL in phosphor-certificate-manager):               │
│  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────                │
│                                                                            │
│  1. PARSE CERTIFICATE CHAIN                                                │
│     ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│     │ PEM_read_bio_X509() for each certificate in chain               │    │
│     │ Build X509_STORE with trusted root CAs from /etc/ssl/certs/     │    │
│     └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                            │
│  2. VERIFY CERTIFICATE SIGNATURES                                          │
│     ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│     │ X509_verify(leaf_cert, intermediate_pubkey) == 1                │    │
│     │ X509_verify(intermediate_cert, root_pubkey) == 1                │    │
│     │ X509_verify(root_cert, root_pubkey) == 1 (self-signed)          │    │
│     └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                            │
│  3. CHECK VALIDITY PERIOD                                                  │
│     ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│     │ X509_cmp_current_time(X509_get_notBefore(cert)) <= 0            │    │
│     │ X509_cmp_current_time(X509_get_notAfter(cert)) >= 0             │    │
│     │                                                                 │    │
│     │ notBefore ──────────── NOW ──────────── notAfter                │    │
│     │     ✓                   │                   ✓                   │    │
│     └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                            │
│  4. VERIFY KEY USAGE & EXTENDED KEY USAGE                                  │
│     ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│     │ For HTTPS server certificate:                                   │    │
│     │   - digitalSignature bit must be set                            │    │
│     │   - keyEncipherment bit must be set (RSA) OR                    │    │
│     │   - keyAgreement bit must be set (ECDH)                         │    │
│     │   - extKeyUsage: id-kp-serverAuth (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.1)           │    │
│     │                                                                 │    │
│     │ For LDAP client certificate:                                    │    │
│     │   - extKeyUsage: id-kp-clientAuth (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2)           │    │
│     └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                            │
│  5. BUILD TRUST CHAIN TO ROOT                                              │
│     ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│     │ X509_STORE_CTX_init(ctx, store, leaf_cert, intermediates)       │    │
│     │ X509_verify_cert(ctx)                                           │    │
│     │                                                                 │    │
│     │ Result: X509_V_OK (0) or error code                             │    │
│     └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Certificate Storage and File Format

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Certificate Storage Architecture                        │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  /etc/ssl/                                                                 │
│  ├── certs/                                                                │
│  │   ├── https/                                                            │
│  │   │   ├── server.pem          ← HTTPS server cert + private key         │
│  │   │   └── authority/          ← Trusted CA certs for client auth        │
│  │   │       ├── ca1.pem                                                   │
│  │   │       └── ca2.pem                                                   │
│  │   └── ldap/                                                             │
│  │       └── client.pem          ← LDAP client certificate                 │
│  └── private/                                                              │
│      └── server.pem              ← Private key (mode 0600)                 │
│                                                                            │
│  COMBINED PEM FILE FORMAT (server.pem):                                    │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────                                     │
│                                                                            │
│  -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----                                               │
│  MIIEvgIBADANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAASCBKgwggSkAgEAAoIBAQC...                    │
│  ... (Base64 encoded private key) ...                                      │
│  -----END PRIVATE KEY-----                                                 │
│  -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----                                               │
│  MIIDXTCCAkWgAwIBAgIJAJC1HiIAZAiUMA0GCSqGSIb3Qq...                         │
│  ... (Base64 encoded server certificate) ...                               │
│  -----END CERTIFICATE-----                                                 │
│  -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----                                               │
│  MIIDrzCCApegAwIBAgIQCDvgVpBCRrGhdWrJWZHHSj...                             │
│  ... (Base64 encoded intermediate CA - optional) ...                       │
│  -----END CERTIFICATE-----                                                 │
│                                                                            │
│  D-BUS OBJECT STRUCTURE:                                                   │
│  ─────────────────────                                                     │
│                                                                            │
│  /xyz/openbmc_project/certs                                                │
│  ├── server                                                                │
│  │   └── https                                                             │
│  │       └── 1                   ← Certificate object                      │
│  │           ├── xyz.openbmc_project.Certs.Certificate                     │
│  │           │   ├── CertificateString (PEM)                               │
│  │           │   ├── Subject                                               │
│  │           │   ├── Issuer                                                │
│  │           │   ├── ValidNotBefore                                        │
│  │           │   └── ValidNotAfter                                         │
│  │           └── xyz.openbmc_project.Object.Delete                         │
│  └── authority                                                             │
│      └── truststore                                                        │
│          ├── 1                   ← CA certificate 1                        │
│          └── 2                   ← CA certificate 2                        │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### CSR Generation Process

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Certificate Signing Request (CSR) Flow                   │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  REDFISH CSR REQUEST                                                       │
│  ───────────────────                                                       │
│  POST /redfish/v1/CertificateService/Actions/                              │
│       CertificateService.GenerateCSR                                       │
│  {                                                                         │
│      "CommonName": "bmc.example.com",                                      │
│      "Organization": "ACME Corp",                                          │
│      "OrganizationalUnit": "IT",                                           │
│      "City": "San Francisco",                                              │
│      "State": "CA",                                                        │
│      "Country": "US",                                                      │
│      "AlternativeNames": ["bmc", "192.168.1.100"],                         │
│      "KeyPairAlgorithm": "EC",                                             │
│      "KeyCurveId": "secp384r1"                                             │
│  }                                                                         │
│                                                                            │
│  CSR GENERATION STEPS:                                                     │
│  ────────────────────                                                      │
│                                                                            │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  1. Generate Key Pair                                               │   │
│  │     ────────────────────                                            │   │
│  │     // For EC key (recommended)                                     │   │
│  │     EVP_PKEY* pkey = EVP_EC_gen("secp384r1");                       │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │     // For RSA key                                                  │   │
│  │     EVP_PKEY* pkey = EVP_RSA_gen(2048);                             │   │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────-┘   │
│                                                                            │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  2. Create CSR Structure                                            │   │
│  │     ─────────────────────                                           │   │
│  │     X509_REQ* req = X509_REQ_new();                                 │   │
│  │     X509_REQ_set_pubkey(req, pkey);                                 │   │
│  │     X509_REQ_set_version(req, 0);  // Version 1                     │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                            │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  3. Set Subject Distinguished Name                                  │   │
│  │     ────────────────────────────                                    │   │
│  │     X509_NAME* name = X509_REQ_get_subject_name(req);               │   │
│  │     X509_NAME_add_entry_by_txt(name, "CN", MBSTRING_ASC,            │   │
│  │                                "bmc.example.com", -1, -1, 0);       │   │
│  │     X509_NAME_add_entry_by_txt(name, "O", MBSTRING_ASC,             │   │
│  │                                "ACME Corp", -1, -1, 0);             │   │
│  │     // ... additional fields                                        │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                            │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  4. Add Subject Alternative Names (SAN) Extension                   │   │
│  │     ──────────────────────────────────────────                      │   │
│  │     STACK_OF(X509_EXTENSION)* exts = sk_X509_EXTENSION_new_null();  │   │
│  │     X509_EXTENSION* san_ext = X509V3_EXT_conf_nid(                  │   │
│  │         NULL, NULL, NID_subject_alt_name,                           │   │
│  │         "DNS:bmc,DNS:bmc.example.com,IP:192.168.1.100");            │   │
│  │     sk_X509_EXTENSION_push(exts, san_ext);                          │   │
│  │     X509_REQ_add_extensions(req, exts);                             │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                            │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  5. Sign CSR with Private Key                                       │   │
│  │     ──────────────────────────                                      │   │
│  │     X509_REQ_sign(req, pkey, EVP_sha384());                         │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                            │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  6. Output PEM-encoded CSR                                          │   │
│  │     ─────────────────────                                           │   │
│  │     -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----                             │   │
│  │     MIICpDCCAYwCAQAwXzELMAkGA1UEBhMCVVMxCzAJBgNVBAgMAkNB...         │   │
│  │     ... (Base64 encoded CSR) ...                                    │   │
│  │     -----END CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----                               │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                            │
│  7. Store private key in /etc/ssl/private/ (mode 0600)                     │
│  8. Return CSR to administrator for CA signing                             │
│  9. After signing, install certificate via Replace action                  │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Service Restart Integration

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              Certificate Installation Service Integration                  │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  Certificate Installed                                                     │
│         │                                                                  │
│         v                                                                  │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  phosphor-certificate-manager                                       │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  1. Write certificate to filesystem                                 │   │
│  │     install(cert_pem, "/etc/ssl/certs/https/server.pem")            │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  2. Set proper permissions                                          │   │
│  │     chmod 0644 server.pem (cert)                                    │   │
│  │     chmod 0600 private key                                          │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  3. Notify dependent services via D-Bus                             │   │
│  │     Certificate.Install signal                                      │   │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────-┘   │
│         │                                                                  │
│         v                                                                  │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  Service Restart Mechanism                                          │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  Option 1: systemd unit dependency (phosphor-certificate-manager)   │   │
│  │    [Unit]                                                           │   │
│  │    PropagatesReloadTo=bmcweb.service                                │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  Option 2: Direct service restart                                   │   │
│  │    sd_bus_call_method(                                              │   │
│  │        bus, "org.freedesktop.systemd1",                             │   │
│  │        "/org/freedesktop/systemd1",                                 │   │
│  │        "org.freedesktop.systemd1.Manager",                          │   │
│  │        "RestartUnit", "bmcweb.service", "replace"                   │   │
│  │    );                                                               │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  Option 3: Service watches certificate file                         │   │
│  │    inotify_add_watch(fd, "/etc/ssl/certs/https/", IN_MODIFY)        │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│         │                                                                  │
│         v                                                                  │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  bmcweb SSL Context Reload                                          │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  SSL_CTX_use_certificate_chain_file(ctx, "/etc/ssl/.../server.pem") │   │
│  │  SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file(ctx, "/etc/ssl/.../server.pem")        │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  New connections use new certificate                                │   │
│  │  Existing connections continue with old cert until closed           │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

## Overview

    

**phosphor-time-manager** handles time synchronization, timezone configuration, and BMC/host time ownership.

```mermaid
---
title: Time Manager Architecture
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph sources["Time Sources"]
        direction LR
        ntp["NTP Servers  
(pool.ntp.org)"]
        host["Host System  
(time source)"]
    end

    subgraph timemgr["phosphor-time-manager"]
        direction LR
        mode["Time Mode  
(NTP/Manual)"]
        owner["Time Owner  
(BMC/Host)"]
        tz["Timezone  
Setting"]
    end

    subgraph backends["Time Backends"]
        direction LR
        timesyncd["systemd-timesyncd  
(NTP client)"]
        rtc["RTC  
(Hardware Clock)"]
    end

    sources --> timemgr
    timemgr --> backends
```
