## Deep Dive

    

Advanced implementation details for IPMI developers.

### Command Handler Registration

    

IPMI commands are handled by provider libraries that register handlers at startup:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Handler Registration Flow                            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   1. ipmid loads provider libraries at startup                          │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ /usr/lib/ipmid-providers/                                       │   │
│   │ ├── libchassishandler.so                                        │   │
│   │ ├── libsensorhandler.so                                         │   │
│   │ ├── libstoragehandler.so                                        │   │
│   │ └── liboemhandler.so                                            │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   2. Each library has constructor that calls ipmi::registerHandler()    │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ // In chassishandler.cpp                                        │   │
│   │ IPMI_REGISTER_HANDLER(                                          │   │
│   │     ipmi::prioOpenBmcBase,           // Priority                │   │
│   │     ipmi::netFnChassis,              // NetFn = 0x00            │   │
│   │     ipmi::chassis::cmdGetChassisStatus, // Cmd = 0x01           │   │
│   │     ipmi::Privilege::User,           // Minimum privilege       │   │
│   │     ipmiGetChassisStatus             // Handler function        │   │
│   │ );                                                              │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   3. Handler stored in dispatch table                                   │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ handlers[{netFn, cmd}] = {priority, privilege, handler}         │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │ Multiple handlers can register for same (netFn, cmd)            │   │
│   │ Higher priority handler wins (OEM can override base)            │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Priority levels (higher wins):**

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Priority | Value | Use Case |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prioOpenBmcBase` | 10 | Default OpenBMC handlers |
| `prioOemBase` | 20 | OEM-specific overrides |
| `prioMax` | 40 | Highest priority handlers |

</div>

**Source reference**: [ipmid/api.hpp](https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-host-ipmid/blob/master/include/ipmid/api.hpp)

### Message Flow Through KCS Interface

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    KCS Message Flow                                     │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Host CPU                              BMC                             │
│   ┌────────────┐                        ┌────────────┐                  │
│   │            │                        │            │                  │
│   │  Host OS   │    KCS Registers       │   ipmid    │                  │
│   │  (driver)  │    ┌──────────┐        │            │                  │
│   │            │───▶│ Data_In  │───────▶│            │                  │
│   │            │    │ Data_Out │◀───────│            │                  │
│   │            │    │ Command  │        │            │                  │
│   │            │◀───│ Status   │───────▶│            │                  │
│   └────────────┘    └──────────┘        └────────────┘                  │
│                                                                         │
│   Message Structure (IPMI Request):                                     │
│   ┌────────┬────────┬────────┬─────────────────────┐                    │
│   │ NetFn  │  Cmd   │  Data  │        ...          │                    │
│   │ (6-bit)│ (8-bit)│ (0-N)  │                     │                    │
│   └────────┴────────┴────────┴─────────────────────┘                    │
│                                                                         │
│   KCS State Machine:                                                    │
│   ┌──────┐    Write_Start    ┌──────┐                                   │
│   │ IDLE │──────────────────▶│ WRITE│                                   │
│   └──────┘                   └───┬──┘                                   │
│       ▲                          │                                      │
│       │                          │ Write_End                            │
│       │ Response_Complete        ▼                                      │
│   ┌───┴──┐                   ┌──────┐                                   │
│   │ READ │◀──────────────────│ EXEC │                                   │
│   └──────┘    Read_Start     └──────┘                                   │
│                                                                         │
│   Device: /dev/ipmi-kcs1 (or /dev/kcs1)                                 │
│   Driver: kcs_bmc (kernel module)                                       │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### RMCP+ Session Authentication

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    RMCP+ Session Establishment                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Client                                    BMC (netipmid)              │
│      │                                          │                       │
│      │  1. Get Channel Auth Capabilities        │                       │
│      │─────────────────────────────────────────▶│                       │
│      │◀─────────────────────────────────────────│ (RMCP+ supported)     │
│      │                                          │                       │
│      │  2. Open Session Request                 │                       │
│      │   (auth algorithm, integrity, cipher)    │                       │
│      │─────────────────────────────────────────▶│                       │
│      │◀─────────────────────────────────────────│ (session ID, algos)   │
│      │                                          │                       │
│      │  3. RAKP Message 1 (client random)       │                       │
│      │─────────────────────────────────────────▶│                       │
│      │◀─────────────────────────────────────────│ RAKP 2 (BMC random,   │
│      │                                          │  session auth)        │
│      │  4. RAKP Message 3 (client auth)         │                       │
│      │─────────────────────────────────────────▶│                       │
│      │◀─────────────────────────────────────────│ RAKP 4 (success)      │
│      │                                          │                       │
│      │  5. Authenticated IPMI Commands          │                       │
│      │   (encrypted with session keys)          │                       │
│      │─────────────────────────────────────────▶│                       │
│      │                                          │                       │
│                                                                         │
│   Cipher Suite 17 (commonly used):                                      │
│   ├── Authentication: RAKP-HMAC-SHA256                                  │
│   ├── Integrity: HMAC-SHA256-128                                        │
│   └── Confidentiality: AES-CBC-128                                      │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### SDR (Sensor Data Record) Structure

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    SDR Record Types                                    │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                        │
│   SDR Type 0x01 - Full Sensor Record (43+ bytes):                      │
│   ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│   │ Offset │ Field                    │ Size │ Description        │    │
│   ├────────┼──────────────────────────┼──────┼────────────────────┤    │
│   │ 0-1    │ Record ID                │ 2    │ Unique identifier  │    │
│   │ 2      │ SDR Version              │ 1    │ 0x51 = IPMI 1.5    │    │
│   │ 3      │ Record Type              │ 1    │ 0x01 = Full        │    │
│   │ 4      │ Record Length            │ 1    │ Bytes following    │    │
│   │ 5      │ Sensor Owner ID          │ 1    │ I2C address/LUN    │    │
│   │ 6      │ Sensor Owner LUN         │ 1    │ Channel/LUN        │    │
│   │ 7      │ Sensor Number            │ 1    │ 0-255              │    │
│   │ 8      │ Entity ID                │ 1    │ CPU, memory, etc.  │    │
│   │ 9      │ Entity Instance          │ 1    │ Which instance     │    │
│   │ 10     │ Sensor Initialization    │ 1    │ Flags              │    │
│   │ 11     │ Sensor Capabilities      │ 1    │ Threshold support  │    │
│   │ 12     │ Sensor Type              │ 1    │ Temperature, etc.  │    │
│   │ 13     │ Event/Reading Type       │ 1    │ Threshold/discrete │    │
│   │ 14-15  │ Assertion Event Mask     │ 2    │ Events to assert   │    │
│   │ 16-17  │ Deassertion Event Mask   │ 2    │ Events to deassert │    │
│   │ 18-19  │ Discrete Reading Mask    │ 2    │ Readable states    │    │
│   │ 20     │ Sensor Units 1           │ 1    │ Unit modifiers     │    │
│   │ 21     │ Sensor Units 2 (Base)    │ 1    │ Degrees C, Volts   │    │
│   │ 22     │ Sensor Units 3 (Mod)     │ 1    │ Modifier unit      │    │
│   │ 23     │ Linearization            │ 1    │ Linear, log, etc.  │    │
│   │ 24-25  │ M, M Tolerance           │ 2    │ Scaling: M         │    │
│   │ 26-27  │ B, B Accuracy            │ 2    │ Scaling: B         │    │
│   │ 28     │ Accuracy/Direction       │ 1    │ Acc exp, direction │    │
│   │ 29     │ R exp, B exp             │ 1    │ Exponents          │    │
│   │ ...    │ Thresholds, ID string    │ ...  │                    │    │
│   └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                        │
│   Reading Conversion:                                                  │
│   y = (M × raw + B × 10^Bexp) × 10^Rexp                                │
│                                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### OEM Command Registration Pattern

    

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// Example: Custom OEM command handler</span>
<span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf"><ipmid/api.hpp></span><span class="cp">
</span>
<span class="c1">// Define OEM NetFn (0x30-0x3F are OEM)</span>
<span class="k">constexpr</span> <span class="n">ipmi</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">NetFn</span> <span class="n">oemNetFn</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mh">0x30</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="k">constexpr</span> <span class="n">ipmi</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Cmd</span> <span class="n">oemGetInfo</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mh">0x01</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="c1">// Handler function</span>
<span class="n">ipmi</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">RspType</span><span class="o"><</span><span class="kt">uint8_t</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="c1">// version</span>
              <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="o">></span> <span class="c1">// description</span>
    <span class="n">oemGetInfoHandler</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ipmi</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Context</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">ptr</span> <span class="n">ctx</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="c1">// Access D-Bus if needed</span>
    <span class="k">auto</span> <span class="n">bus</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">getSdBus</span><span class="p">();</span>

    <span class="c1">// Return success with data</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">ipmi</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">responseSuccess</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="kt">uint8_t</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="mh">0x01</span><span class="p">},</span>           <span class="c1">// version</span>
        <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s">"My OEM"</span><span class="p">}</span>    <span class="c1">// description</span>
    <span class="p">);</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c1">// Register at library load</span>
<span class="kt">void</span> <span class="nf">registerOemHandlers</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="n">__attribute__</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">constructor</span><span class="p">));</span>
<span class="kt">void</span> <span class="nf">registerOemHandlers</span><span class="p">()</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="n">ipmi</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">registerHandler</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">ipmi</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">prioOemBase</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">oemNetFn</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">oemGetInfo</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">ipmi</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Privilege</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">User</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">oemGetInfoHandler</span>
    <span class="p">);</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
```

## Overview

    

**Redfish** is a modern, RESTful API standard for server management, replacing IPMI for most use cases. OpenBMC implements Redfish through **bmcweb**, including support for **Redfish Aggregation** to manage multiple BMCs from a single endpoint.

```mermaid
---
title: Redfish Architecture
---
flowchart TB
    clients["External Clients  
(curl, Redfish clients, WebUI)"]

    clients -->|"HTTPS/443"| bmcweb

    subgraph bmcweb["bmcweb"]
        direction LR
        subgraph handlers["Resource Handlers"]
            direction TB
            Systems
            Chassis
            Managers
            Account
            Event
            OEM
        end
        auth["Authentication  
(Basic, Session, mTLS)"]
    end

    bmcweb --> dbus["D-Bus  
(phosphor-* services, inventory, sensors)"]
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Redfish Architecture                        │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                  │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                    External Clients                          ││
│  │            (curl, Redfish clients, WebUI)                    ││
│  └──────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘│
│                             │                                    │
│                         HTTPS/443                                │
│                             │                                    │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                        bmcweb                                ││
│  │                                                              ││
│  │   ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   ││
│  │   │              Resource Handlers                       │   ││
│  │   │                                                      │   ││
│  │   │ Systems │ Chassis │ Managers │ Account │ Event │ OEM │   ││
│  │   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   ││
│  │                                                              ││
│  │   ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   ││
│  │   │              Authentication                          │   ││
│  │   │         (Basic, Session, mTLS)                       │   ││
│  │   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   ││
```

## Setup & Configuration

    

> bmcweb’s web server serves responses over both **HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2** on the same HTTPS listener. When a client advertises HTTP/2 during the TLS handshake (via ALPN), bmcweb uses it; otherwise the connection falls back to HTTP/1.1. Both run on the standard HTTPS port, so no extra configuration is needed to accept either – the examples in this guide work unchanged regardless of which the client negotiates.

### Build-Time Configuration (Yocto)

    

Configure bmcweb features in your build:

```bitbake
# In your machine .conf or local.conf

# Enable/disable bmcweb features
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-bmcweb = " \
    -Dredfish-dbus-log=enabled \
    -Dredfish-bmc-journal=enabled \
    -Dredfish-cpu-log=enabled \
    -Dredfish-host-logger=enabled \
    -Dinsecure-tftp-update=disabled \
    -Dinsecure-push-style-notification=disabled \
    -Dkvm=enabled \
    -Dvm-websocket=enabled \
    -Dvm-nbdproxy=enabled \
    -Dmutual-tls-auth=enabled \
    -Dhttp-body-limit=65 \
"
```

### Meson Build Options Reference

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Core Features** |  |  |
| `redfish` | enabled | Core Redfish support |
| `redfish-aggregation` | disabled | Aggregation support |
| `rest` | disabled | Legacy REST API (deprecated) |
| **Logging** |  |  |
| `redfish-dbus-log` | enabled | D-Bus logging |
| `redfish-bmc-journal` | enabled | BMC journal logs |
| `redfish-cpu-log` | disabled | CPU crash logs |
| `redfish-host-logger` | enabled | Host console logging |
| **Remote Access** |  |  |
| `kvm` | enabled | KVM WebSocket |
| `vm-websocket` | enabled | Virtual Media WebSocket |
| `vm-nbdproxy` | enabled | NBD proxy for virtual media |
| **Security** |  |  |
| `mutual-tls-auth` | enabled | mTLS support |
| `insecure-tftp-update` | disabled | Allow TFTP updates |
| `insecure-push-style-notification` | disabled | Push notifications |
| **Limits** |  |  |
| `http-body-limit` | 30 | Max request body (MB) |

</div>

### Runtime Enable/Disable

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check bmcweb status</span>
systemctl status bmcweb

<span class="c"># Restart bmcweb</span>
systemctl restart bmcweb

<span class="c"># Stop bmcweb (disables all Redfish/web access)</span>
systemctl stop bmcweb
systemctl disable bmcweb

<span class="c"># View logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> bmcweb <span class="nt">-f</span>
```

</div></div>

### HTTPS Certificate Configuration

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># View current certificate</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> https://localhost/redfish/v1/CertificateService/CertificateLocations

<span class="c"># Generate self-signed certificate (on BMC)</span>
openssl req <span class="nt">-x509</span> <span class="nt">-newkey</span> rsa:2048 <span class="nt">-keyout</span> /etc/ssl/private/server.pem <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-out</span> /etc/ssl/certs/server.pem <span class="nt">-days</span> 365 <span class="nt">-nodes</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-subj</span> <span class="s2">"/CN=openbmc"</span>

<span class="c"># Replace via Redfish</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "CertificateType": "PEM",
        "CertificateString": "
"
    }' \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/NetworkProtocol/HTTPS/Certificates
```

### Network Protocol Settings

    

```
# Get network protocol settings
curl -k -u root:0penBmc \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/NetworkProtocol

# Enable/disable protocols via Redfish
curl -k -u root:0penBmc -X PATCH \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "HTTPS": {"ProtocolEnabled": true, "Port": 443},
        "SSH": {"ProtocolEnabled": true, "Port": 22},
        "IPMI": {"ProtocolEnabled": true, "Port": 623},
        "NTP": {"ProtocolEnabled": true}
    }' \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/NetworkProtocol
```

### Session Configuration

    

```
# Get session service settings
curl -k -u root:0penBmc \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/SessionService

# Configure session timeout (seconds)
curl -k -u root:0penBmc -X PATCH \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"SessionTimeout": 3600}' \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/SessionService
```

### Account Service Configuration

    

```
# Get account policy
curl -k -u root:0penBmc \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/AccountService

# Configure account lockout
curl -k -u root:0penBmc -X PATCH \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "AccountLockoutThreshold": 5,
        "AccountLockoutDuration": 300,
        "MinPasswordLength": 8
    }' \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/AccountService
```

### Event Service Configuration

    

```
# Get event service settings
curl -k -u root:0penBmc \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/EventService

# Enable/disable event service
curl -k -u root:0penBmc -X PATCH \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "ServiceEnabled": true,
        "DeliveryRetryAttempts": 3,
        "DeliveryRetryIntervalSeconds": 60
    }' \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/EventService
```

### Telemetry Configuration

    

```
# Get telemetry service
curl -k -u root:0penBmc \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/TelemetryService

# Create metric report
curl -k -u root:0penBmc -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "Id": "PowerMetrics",
        "Name": "Power Consumption Report",
        "MetricReportDefinitionType": "Periodic",
        "ReportUpdates": "Overwrite",
        "Schedule": {
            "RecurrenceInterval": "PT60S"
        },
        "Metrics": [
            {
                "MetricId": "TotalPower",
                "MetricProperties": ["/redfish/v1/Chassis/chassis/Power#/PowerControl/0/PowerConsumedWatts"]
            }
        ]
    }' \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/TelemetryService/MetricReportDefinitions
```

## Redfish Basics

    

### API Structure

    

```
/redfish/v1/                        # Service Root
├── Systems/                        # Computer systems
│   └── system/                     # This system
│       ├── Processors/             # CPUs
│       ├── Memory/                 # DIMMs
│       ├── Storage/                # Storage devices
│       └── LogServices/            # System logs
├── Chassis/                        # Physical enclosures
│   └── chassis/                    # This chassis
│       ├── Power/                  # Power info
│       ├── Thermal/                # Thermal info
│       └── Sensors/                # All sensors
├── Managers/                       # BMC managers
│   └── bmc/                        # This BMC
│       ├── NetworkProtocol/        # Network services
│       ├── EthernetInterfaces/     # Network ports
│       └── LogServices/            # BMC logs
├── AccountService/                 # User management
│   ├── Accounts/                   # User accounts
│   └── Roles/                      # Privilege roles
├── SessionService/                 # Session management
├── EventService/                   # Event subscriptions
├── UpdateService/                  # Firmware updates
└── TelemetryService/               # Telemetry data
```

### Common Operations

    

```
# Set up alias for convenience
alias bmcurl='curl -k -u root:0penBmc'

# Get service root
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/

# Get system info
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/system

# Get chassis info
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/Chassis/chassis

# Get BMC info
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc
```

## Authentication

    

### Basic Authentication

    

```
curl -k -u root:0penBmc https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/system
```

### Session Authentication

    

```
# Create session
curl -k -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"UserName":"root","Password":"0penBmc"}' \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions

# Response includes X-Auth-Token header
# Use token for subsequent requests
curl -k -H "X-Auth-Token: " \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/system

# Delete session
curl -k -X DELETE \
    -H "X-Auth-Token: " \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions/
```

### mTLS Authentication

    

Configure client certificates for mutual TLS authentication.

## Power Operations

    

### Get Power State

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/system | jq <span class="s1">'.PowerState'</span>
```

</div></div>

### Power On/Off

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Power on</span>
bmcurl <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"ResetType":"On"}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/system/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset

<span class="c"># Graceful shutdown</span>
bmcurl <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"ResetType":"GracefulShutdown"}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/system/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset

<span class="c"># Force off</span>
bmcurl <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"ResetType":"ForceOff"}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/system/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset

<span class="c"># Reboot</span>
bmcurl <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"ResetType":"ForceRestart"}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/system/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset
```

</div></div>

### Reset Types

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `On` | Power on |
| `ForceOff` | Immediate power off |
| `GracefulShutdown` | Graceful OS shutdown |
| `GracefulRestart` | Graceful reboot |
| `ForceRestart` | Immediate reboot |
| `Nmi` | Non-maskable interrupt |

</div>

## Redfish Aggregation

    

Redfish Aggregation allows a single BMC (the “Aggregator”) to present resources from multiple downstream BMCs through a unified API. This is useful for multi-node systems, disaggregated infrastructure, or centralized datacenter management.

### Architecture

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        Aggregation Architecture                         │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│                    ┌──────────────────────────────┐                     │
│                    │     Management Client        │                     │
│                    │  (Single Entry Point)        │                     │
│                    └──────────────┬───────────────┘                     │
│                                   │                                     │
│                              HTTPS/443                                  │
│                                   │                                     │
│                    ┌──────────────┴────────────────┐                    │
│                    │      Aggregating BMC          │                    │
│                    │   (bmcweb with aggregation)   │                    │
│                    │                               │                    │
│                    │  /redfish/v1/                 │                    │
│                    │  ├── AggregationService/      │                    │
│                    │  ├── Systems/                 │◄─── Aggregated     │
│                    │  ├── Chassis/                 │     from all       │
│                    │  └── Managers/                │     satellites     │
│                    └──────────────┬────────────────┘                    │
│                                   │                                     │
│              ┌────────────────────┼────────────────────┐                │
│              │                    │                    │                │
│         HTTPS/443            HTTPS/443            HTTPS/443             │
│              │                    │                    │                │
│   ┌──────────┴─────┐   ┌─────────┴──────┐   ┌────────┴───────┐          │
│   │  Satellite 1   │   │  Satellite 2   │   │  Satellite 3   │          │
│   │  (Node BMC)    │   │  (Node BMC)    │   │  (Node BMC)    │          │
│   │  192.168.1.10  │   │  192.168.1.11  │   │  192.168.1.12  │          │
│   └────────────────┘   └────────────────┘   └────────────────┘          │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Enable Aggregation

    

Enable the aggregation feature at build time:

```bitbake
# In your machine .conf or local.conf
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-bmcweb = " \
    -Dredfish-aggregation=enabled \
"
```

### Aggregation Service API

    

Once enabled, the AggregationService endpoint becomes available:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Get aggregation service</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/AggregationService

<span class="c"># Response</span>
<span class="o">{</span>
    <span class="s2">"@odata.id"</span>: <span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/AggregationService"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"@odata.type"</span>: <span class="s2">"#AggregationService.v1_0_1.AggregationService"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"Id"</span>: <span class="s2">"AggregationService"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"Name"</span>: <span class="s2">"Aggregation Service"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"Description"</span>: <span class="s2">"Aggregation Service"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"ServiceEnabled"</span>: <span class="nb">true</span>,
    <span class="s2">"AggregationSources"</span>: <span class="o">{</span>
        <span class="s2">"@odata.id"</span>: <span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/AggregationService/AggregationSources"</span>
    <span class="o">}</span>,
    <span class="s2">"ConnectionMethods"</span>: <span class="o">{</span>
        <span class="s2">"@odata.id"</span>: <span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/AggregationService/ConnectionMethods"</span>
    <span class="o">}</span>
<span class="o">}</span>
```

</div></div>

### Managing Aggregation Sources

    

Aggregation sources define the downstream BMCs to aggregate:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># List configured aggregation sources</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/AggregationService/AggregationSources

<span class="c"># Add a new aggregation source (satellite BMC)</span>
bmcurl <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "HostName": "192.168.1.10",
        "UserName": "admin",
        "Password": "password",
        "Links": {
            "ConnectionMethod": {
                "@odata.id": "/redfish/v1/AggregationService/ConnectionMethods/Redfish"
            }
        }
    }'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/AggregationService/AggregationSources

<span class="c"># Get details of an aggregation source</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/AggregationService/AggregationSources/1

<span class="c"># Remove an aggregation source</span>
bmcurl <span class="nt">-X</span> DELETE <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/AggregationService/AggregationSources/1
```

</div></div>

### Aggregation Source Properties

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Property | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HostName` | string | IP address or hostname of satellite BMC |
| `UserName` | string | Authentication username |
| `Password` | string | Authentication password (write-only) |
| `SNMP` | object | SNMP community settings (optional) |
| `Links.ConnectionMethod` | link | Connection method to use |
| `Links.ResourcesAccessed` | array | Resources aggregated from this source |

</div>

### Connection Methods

    

Connection methods define how the aggregator connects to satellites:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># List available connection methods</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/AggregationService/ConnectionMethods

<span class="c"># Get connection method details</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/AggregationService/ConnectionMethods/Redfish

<span class="c"># Response</span>
<span class="o">{</span>
    <span class="s2">"@odata.id"</span>: <span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/AggregationService/ConnectionMethods/Redfish"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"@odata.type"</span>: <span class="s2">"#ConnectionMethod.v1_0_0.ConnectionMethod"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"Id"</span>: <span class="s2">"Redfish"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"Name"</span>: <span class="s2">"Redfish Connection Method"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"ConnectionMethodType"</span>: <span class="s2">"Redfish"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"ConnectionMethodVariant"</span>: <span class="s2">"Redfish"</span>
<span class="o">}</span>
```

</div></div>

### Accessing Aggregated Resources

    

Aggregated resources appear with prefixed IDs to identify their source:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># List all systems (local + aggregated)</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems

<span class="c"># Response includes aggregated systems</span>
<span class="o">{</span>
    <span class="s2">"Members"</span>: <span class="o">[</span>
        <span class="o">{</span><span class="s2">"@odata.id"</span>: <span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/Systems/system"</span><span class="o">}</span>,           <span class="c"># Local</span>
        <span class="o">{</span><span class="s2">"@odata.id"</span>: <span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/Systems/agg1_system"</span><span class="o">}</span>,      <span class="c"># Satellite 1</span>
        <span class="o">{</span><span class="s2">"@odata.id"</span>: <span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/Systems/agg2_system"</span><span class="o">}</span>       <span class="c"># Satellite 2</span>
    <span class="o">]</span>
<span class="o">}</span>

<span class="c"># Access aggregated system</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/agg1_system

<span class="c"># The request is proxied to the satellite BMC</span>
```

</div></div>

### Resource Prefixing

    

Aggregated resources use prefixes to avoid ID collisions:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Local Resource | Aggregated Resource (Source 1) |
| --- | --- |
| `/Systems/system` | `/Systems/agg1_system` |
| `/Chassis/chassis` | `/Chassis/agg1_chassis` |
| `/Managers/bmc` | `/Managers/agg1_bmc` |
| `/Sensors/CPU_Temp` | `/Sensors/agg1_CPU_Temp` |

</div>

### Aggregation Use Cases

    

#### Multi-Node Server Management

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Power on all aggregated systems</span>
<span class="k">for </span>sys <span class="k">in </span>system agg1_system agg2_system agg3_system<span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">do
    </span>bmcurl <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
        <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
        <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"ResetType":"On"}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
        <span class="s2">"https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/</span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">sys</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="s2">/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset"</span>
<span class="k">done</span>
```

</div></div>

#### Unified Sensor Monitoring

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Get all temperature sensors across all nodes</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/Chassis | jq <span class="nt">-r</span> <span class="s1">'.Members[]."@odata.id"'</span> | <span class="se">\</span>
<span class="k">while </span><span class="nb">read </span>chassis<span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">do
    </span><span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"=== </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">chassis</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="s2"> ==="</span>
    bmcurl <span class="s2">"</span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">chassis</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="s2">/Thermal"</span> | jq <span class="s1">'.Temperatures[] | {Name, ReadingCelsius}'</span>
<span class="k">done</span>
```

</div></div>

#### Centralized Log Collection

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Collect event logs from all systems</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems | jq <span class="nt">-r</span> <span class="s1">'.Members[]."@odata.id"'</span> | <span class="se">\</span>
<span class="k">while </span><span class="nb">read </span>system<span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">do
    </span><span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"=== </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">system</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="s2"> ==="</span>
    bmcurl <span class="s2">"</span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">system</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="s2">/LogServices/EventLog/Entries"</span> | jq <span class="s1">'.Members[:5]'</span>
<span class="k">done</span>
```

</div></div>

### Aggregation Configuration

    

#### Trust Store for Satellite Certificates

    

Configure trusted certificates for satellite BMC connections:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Add satellite certificate to trust store</span>
bmcurl <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "CertificateType": "PEM",
        "CertificateString": "
"
    }' \
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/Truststore/Certificates
```

#### Aggregation with mTLS

    

For mutual TLS authentication with satellites:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Configure client certificate for satellite authentication</span>
bmcurl <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "HostName": "192.168.1.10",
        "Links": {
            "ConnectionMethod": {
                "@odata.id": "/redfish/v1/AggregationService/ConnectionMethods/Redfish"
            }
        }
    }'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/AggregationService/AggregationSources
```

</div></div>

### Troubleshooting Aggregation

    

#### Check Aggregation Source Status

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Get aggregation source status</span>
bmcurl https://localhost/redfish/v1/AggregationService/AggregationSources/1 | jq <span class="s1">'.Status'</span>

<span class="c"># Response</span>
<span class="o">{</span>
    <span class="s2">"State"</span>: <span class="s2">"Enabled"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"Health"</span>: <span class="s2">"OK"</span>
<span class="o">}</span>
```

</div></div>

#### Common Issues

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Issue | Cause | Solution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Source unreachable | Network/firewall issue | Check connectivity to satellite |
| Authentication failed | Wrong credentials | Verify username/password |
| Certificate error | Untrusted satellite cert | Add to trust store or disable verification |
| Resources not appearing | Service not ready | Wait for satellite to fully boot |
| Timeout errors | Slow satellite response | Increase timeout settings |

</div>

#### Debug Logging

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Enable verbose bmcweb logging</span>
<span class="c"># Edit /lib/systemd/system/bmcweb.service to add:</span>
<span class="c"># Environment="BMCWEB_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG"</span>

systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl restart bmcweb
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> bmcweb <span class="nt">-f</span> | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> aggregat
```

</div></div>

## OEM Extensions

    

### OEM Resource Locations

    

OEM extensions appear under `Oem` properties:

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"@odata.id"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/Systems/system"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"Oem"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="nl">"OpenBMC"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"@odata.type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"#OemComputerSystem.v1_0_0.OpenBMC"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"FirmwareProvisioning"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
                </span><span class="nl">"ProvisioningStatus"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"NotProvisioned"</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### Implementing OEM Extensions

    

Add OEM properties in bmcweb handlers:

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// In systems.hpp</span>
<span class="n">nlohmann</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">json</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">oem</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">jsonValue</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"Oem"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s">"OpenBMC"</span><span class="p">];</span>
<span class="n">oem</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"@odata.type"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"#OemComputerSystem.v1_0_0.OpenBMC"</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="n">oem</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"MyCustomProperty"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"value"</span><span class="p">;</span>
```

</div></div>

## bmcweb Configuration

    

### Build Options

    

```bitbake
# In your machine config or local.conf
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-bmcweb = " \
    -Dredfish-dbus-log=enabled \
    -Dhttp-body-limit=65 \
    -Dinsecure-tftp-update=disabled \
    "
```

### Common Options

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `redfish-dbus-log` | Enable D-Bus based logging |
| `insecure-tftp-update` | Allow TFTP firmware updates |
| `http-body-limit` | Max request body size (MB) |
| `mutual-tls-auth` | Enable mTLS |
| `kvm` | Enable KVM support |
| `vm-websocket` | Enable Virtual Media WebSocket |

</div>

## Adding Custom Routes

    

### Basic Route Handler

    

> **Source Reference**: Pattern based on bmcweb
>   
>     Route patterns: redfish-core/lib/managers.hpp
>     Privilege definitions: registries/privilege_registry.hpp

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// In a new file under redfish-core/lib/</span>
<span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf"><app.hpp></span><span class="cp">
#include</span> <span class="cpf"><registries/privilege_registry.hpp></span><span class="cp">
</span>
<span class="k">namespace</span> <span class="n">redfish</span>
<span class="p">{</span>

<span class="kr">inline</span> <span class="kt">void</span> <span class="n">requestRoutesMyOem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">App</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="n">BMCWEB_ROUTE</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">app</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"/redfish/v1/Oem/MyVendor/MyResource"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">privileges</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">redfish</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">privileges</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">getManager</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">methods</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">boost</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">beast</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">http</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">verb</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">)(</span>
            <span class="p">[](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">crow</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Request</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="p">,</span>
               <span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">shared_ptr</span><span class="o"><</span><span class="n">bmcweb</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">AsyncResp</span><span class="o">>&</span> <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
                <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">jsonValue</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"@odata.type"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span>
                    <span class="s">"#MyResource.v1_0_0.MyResource"</span><span class="p">;</span>
                <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">jsonValue</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"@odata.id"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span>
                    <span class="s">"/redfish/v1/Oem/MyVendor/MyResource"</span><span class="p">;</span>
                <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">jsonValue</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"Name"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"My Custom Resource"</span><span class="p">;</span>
                <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">jsonValue</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"Status"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s">"State"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"Enabled"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="p">});</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="p">}</span> <span class="c1">// namespace redfish</span>
```

</div></div>

### Register in bmcweb

    

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// In src/webserver_main.cpp or appropriate location</span>
<span class="cp">#include</span> <span class="cpf">"myoem.hpp"</span><span class="cp">
</span>
<span class="c1">// In main():</span>
<span class="n">redfish</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">requestRoutesMyOem</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">app</span><span class="p">);</span>
```

</div></div>

## Deep Dive

    

Advanced implementation details for Redfish developers.

### Request Routing Architecture

    

bmcweb uses a route registration pattern for handling HTTP requests:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    bmcweb Request Routing                               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   HTTP Request: GET /redfish/v1/Chassis/chassis0/Thermal                │
│                                   │                                     │
│                                   ▼                                     │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │                    Crow HTTP Server                             │   │
│   │   (Boost.Beast HTTP, Boost.Asio I/O)                            │   │
│   └────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                │                                        │
│                                ▼                                        │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │                    Route Matching                               │   │
│   │   Routes registered at startup via BMCWEB_ROUTE macro           │   │
│   │                                                                 │   │
│   │   Pattern: "/redfish/v1/Chassis/<str>/Thermal"                  │   │
│   │   Matches: chassis0 → extracted as parameter                    │   │
│   └────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                │                                        │
│                                ▼                                        │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │                    Authentication Check                         │   │
│   │   ├── Session token validation                                  │   │
│   │   ├── Basic auth (if enabled)                                   │   │
│   │   └── mTLS certificate (if enabled)                             │   │
│   └────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                │                                        │
│                                ▼                                        │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │                    Handler Function                             │   │
│   │   thermal.cpp::handleThermalGet()                               │   │
│   │   ├── Query D-Bus for sensor data                               │   │
│   │   ├── Build JSON response                                       │   │
│   │   └── Send response via asyncResp                               │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

**Route registration pattern:**

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// In redfish-core/lib/thermal.hpp</span>
<span class="kr">inline</span> <span class="kt">void</span> <span class="nf">requestRoutesThermal</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">App</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">app</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="n">BMCWEB_ROUTE</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">app</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"/redfish/v1/Chassis/<str>/Thermal/"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">privileges</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">redfish</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">privileges</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">getThermal</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="n">methods</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">boost</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">beast</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">http</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">verb</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">)(</span>
            <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">bind_front</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">handleThermalGet</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">ref</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">app</span><span class="p">)));</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
```

</div></div>

**Source reference**: [redfish-core/lib/](https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/tree/master/redfish-core/lib)

### Async D-Bus Query Pattern

    

bmcweb uses async callbacks to avoid blocking the event loop:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Async D-Bus Query Pattern                            │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Handler receives asyncResp (shared_ptr to response object)            │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ void handleChassisGet(                                          │   │
│   │     App& app,                                                   │   │
│   │     const crow::Request& req,                                   │   │
│   │     const std::shared_ptr<bmcweb::AsyncResp>& asyncResp,        │   │
│   │     const std::string& chassisId)                               │   │
│   │ {                                                               │   │
│   │     // asyncResp->res.jsonValue populated over multiple calls   │   │
│   │     // Response sent when asyncResp refcount reaches zero       │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
│   Multiple async queries in flight:                                     │
│   ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│   │ asyncResp │───▶ Query 1: Get Chassis info ──────┐              │    │
│   │           │───▶ Query 2: Get Power state ───────┤ All complete │    │
│   │           │───▶ Query 3: Get Thermal data ──────┤     │        │    │
│   │           │───▶ Query 4: Get LED state ─────────┘     ▼        │    │
│   │           │                              Response sent         │    │
│   └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                                                         │
│   Pattern for D-Bus async call:                                         │
│   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│   │ crow::connections::systemBus->async_method_call(                │   │
│   │     [asyncResp](const boost::system::error_code& ec,            │   │
│   │                 const PropertiesType& props) {                  │   │
│   │         if (ec) {                                               │   │
│   │             messages::internalError(asyncResp->res);            │   │
│   │             return;                                             │   │
│   │         }                                                       │   │
│   │         // Populate asyncResp->res.jsonValue                    │   │
│   │     },                                                          │   │
│   │     service, objectPath, "org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties",     │   │
│   │     "GetAll", interface);                                       │   │
│   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Event Service (SSE) Implementation

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Redfish Event Service                                │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                         │
│   Event Flow:                                                           │
│   ┌────────────────┐     ┌────────────────┐     ┌────────────────┐      │
│   │ D-Bus Signal   │────▶│ Event Filter   │────▶│ SSE Stream /   │      │
│   │ (phosphor-*)   │     │ (subscription  │     │ Push Webhook   │      │
│   │                │     │  match rules)  │     │                │      │
│   └────────────────┘     └────────────────┘     └────────────────┘      │
│                                                                         │
│   Subscription Types:                                                   │
│   ├── SSE (Server-Sent Events) - persistent HTTP connection             │
│   │   GET /redfish/v1/EventService/SSE                                  │
│   │   Response: text/event-stream                                       │
│   │                                                                     │
│   └── Push Style (Webhook) - HTTP POST to destination                   │
│       POST to subscriber's Destination URL                              │
│                                                                         │
│   Event Types:                                                          │
│   ├── Alert - hardware alerts (thresholds, failures)                    │
│   ├── ResourceAdded - new resource created                              │
│   ├── ResourceRemoved - resource deleted                                │
│   ├── ResourceUpdated - resource property changed                       │
│   └── MetricReport - telemetry data                                     │
│                                                                         │
│   D-Bus Signal to Redfish Event Mapping:                                │
│   ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│   │ D-Bus: PropertiesChanged on Sensor.Value                         │  │
│   │   └─▶ Redfish: Alert with MessageId "Threshold exceeded"         │  │
│   │                                                                  │  │
│   │ D-Bus: InterfacesAdded on Inventory path                         │  │
│   │   └─▶ Redfish: ResourceAdded for new inventory item              │  │
│   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│                                                                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### OEM Extension Pattern

    

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// Example: Adding OEM data to an existing resource</span>
<span class="c1">// In redfish-core/lib/chassis.cpp</span>

<span class="kr">inline</span> <span class="kt">void</span> <span class="nf">handleChassisGet</span><span class="p">(...)</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="c1">// Standard Redfish properties</span>
    <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">jsonValue</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"@odata.type"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"#Chassis.v1_16_0.Chassis"</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">jsonValue</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"Id"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">chassisId</span><span class="p">;</span>

    <span class="c1">// Add OEM section</span>
    <span class="n">nlohmann</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">json</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">oem</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">jsonValue</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"Oem"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s">"OpenBMC"</span><span class="p">];</span>
    <span class="n">oem</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"@odata.type"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">"#OpenBMCChassis.v1_0_0.Chassis"</span><span class="p">;</span>

    <span class="c1">// Query OEM-specific D-Bus properties</span>
    <span class="n">crow</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">connections</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">systemBus</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">async_method_call</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">boost</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">system</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">error_code</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">ec</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">customProp</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n">ec</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
                <span class="n">asyncResp</span><span class="o">-></span><span class="n">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">jsonValue</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"Oem"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s">"OpenBMC"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="p">[</span><span class="s">"CustomProperty"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">customProp</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="p">}</span>
        <span class="p">},</span>
        <span class="s">"xyz.openbmc_project.OEM.Service"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">objectPath</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">"org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">"Get"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">"xyz.openbmc_project.OEM.CustomInterface"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s">"CustomProperty"</span><span class="p">);</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
```

## Overview

    

**webui-vue** is the modern, Vue.js-based web interface for OpenBMC. It provides a browser-based management console that communicates with the BMC through the Redfish API.

> **webui-vue replaces phosphor-webui.** The earlier OpenBMC web interface,
> phosphor-webui, was built on
> AngularJS (now end-of-life) and drove the BMC through the legacy **REST D-Bus
> API**, which is disabled by default in bmcweb. phosphor-webui is deprecated in
> favor of webui-vue and is slated to move to read-only. By contrast, **webui-vue
> is Redfish-only** — it talks exclusively to the Redfish API. If you come across
> documentation or code referring to phosphor-webui, `ng-app`, or AngularJS
> controllers, it belongs to that older UI and does not apply here.

```mermaid
---
title: WebUI Architecture
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph browser["Web Browser"]
        subgraph webui["webui-vue"]
            direction LR
            vue["Vue 2  
Router"]
            vuex["Vuex  
Store"]
            bootstrap["Bootstrap  
Vue"]
            axios["Axios  
Client"]
        end
    end

    bmcweb["bmcweb  
(Serves static files + Redfish API)"]

    dbus["D-Bus  
(phosphor-* services, state, sensors)"]

    browser -->|"HTTPS/443"| bmcweb --> dbus
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       WebUI Architecture                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                 │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                      Web Browser                            ││
│  │                                                             ││
│  │   ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  ││
│  │   │                   webui-vue                          │  ││
│  │   │                                                      │  ││
│  │   │  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────┐  │  ││
│  │   │  │  Vue 2  │  │ Vuex    │  │Bootstrap│  │ Axios   │  │  ││
│  │   │  │ Router  │  │ Store   │  │   Vue   │  │ Client  │  │  ││
│  │   │  └─────────┘  └─────────┘  └─────────┘  └─────────┘  │  ││
│  │   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  ││
│  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘│
│                             │                                   │
│                         HTTPS/443                               │
│                             │                                   │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                        bmcweb                               ││
│  │           (Serves static files + Redfish API)               ││
│  └──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘│
│                             │                                   │
│  ┌──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────┐│
│  │                         D-Bus                               ││
│  │            (phosphor-* services, state, sensors)            ││
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘│
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Setup & Configuration

    

### Build-Time Configuration (Yocto)

    

Include webui-vue in your image:

```bitbake
# In your machine .conf or local.conf

# Include web interface
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " webui-vue"

# Configure features via environment options
EXTRA_OEMAKE:pn-webui-vue = "VUE_APP_COMPANY_NAME='MyCompany'"
```

### Build Configuration Options

    

Configure webui-vue at build time using environment variables:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `VUE_APP_COMPANY_NAME` | OpenBMC | Company name in header |
| `VUE_APP_PRODUCT_NAME` | OpenBMC | Product name |
| `VUE_APP_SERVER_ROOT` |  | Prefix for all API requests |
| `VUE_APP_THEME` | default | Theme name |
| `VUE_APP_INTERNAL_LINKS` |  | Custom navigation links (JSON) |
| `VUE_APP_ROUTER_BASE` | / | Router base path |

</div>

### Runtime Configuration

    

The WebUI runs as static files served by bmcweb:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check bmcweb status (serves WebUI)</span>
systemctl status bmcweb

<span class="c"># WebUI files location</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /usr/share/www/

<span class="c"># Restart to pick up WebUI changes</span>
systemctl restart bmcweb
```

</div></div>

### Access the WebUI

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Default URL</span>
https://<bmc-ip>/

<span class="c"># Default credentials</span>
Username: root
Password: 0penBmc
```

</div></div>
---

## WebUI Features

    

### Dashboard

    

The dashboard provides an at-a-glance view of system status:

* **System Health**: Overall health indicators
* **Power Status**: Current power state and controls
* **Quick Actions**: Common operations (reboot, power cycle)
* **Sensor Summary**: Critical sensor readings

### Operations Pages

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Page | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Server power operations** | Power on/off, restart, one-time boot |
| **KVM & Console** | Remote keyboard/video/mouse, serial console |
| **Virtual Media** | Mount ISO images remotely |
| **Firmware** | Update BMC and BIOS firmware |
| **SOL Console** | Serial over LAN terminal |

</div>

### Hardware Pages

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Page | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Inventory** | FRU data, serial numbers, hardware info |
| **Sensors** | All sensors with readings and thresholds |
| **System Info** | CPU, memory, storage details |
| **Event Logs** | System event history |

</div>

### Settings Pages

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Page | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Network** | IP configuration, VLAN, DNS |
| **Date & Time** | NTP, timezone, manual time |
| **User Management** | Add/modify/delete users |
| **Certificates** | HTTPS certificates management |
| **Policies** | Power restore, boot options |

</div>

## Customization

    

### Custom Branding

    

Create a custom theme by modifying or overriding files:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
webui-vue/
├── src/
│   ├── assets/
│   │   ├── images/
│   │   │   ├── logo-header.svg    # Header logo (40px height)
│   │   │   ├── logo-login.svg     # Login page logo
│   │   │   └── favicon.ico        # Browser favicon
│   │   └── styles/
│   │       └── _colors.scss       # Color definitions
│   ├── env/
│   │   └── components/
│   │       └── AppHeader/         # Custom header component
│   └── views/
│       └── Login/
│           └── Login.vue          # Custom login page
```

</div></div>

### Replacing the Logo

    

1. Create your logo (SVG recommended, ~40px height for header)
2. Replace files in your meta layer:

```bitbake
# In your recipe .bbappend
FILESEXTRAPATHS:prepend := "${THISDIR}/files:"

SRC_URI += " \
    file://logo-header.svg \
    file://logo-login.svg \
    file://favicon.ico \
"

do_install:append() {
    install -m 0644 ${WORKDIR}/logo-header.svg \
        ${D}${datadir}/www/assets/images/
    install -m 0644 ${WORKDIR}/logo-login.svg \
        ${D}${datadir}/www/assets/images/
    install -m 0644 ${WORKDIR}/favicon.ico \
        ${D}${datadir}/www/
}
```

### Custom Colors

    

Override SCSS color variables in your theme:

<div class="language-scss highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// _colors.scss</span>
<span class="nv">$primary</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#0a3d6c</span><span class="p">;</span>        <span class="c1">// Primary brand color</span>
<span class="nv">$secondary</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#6c757d</span><span class="p">;</span>      <span class="c1">// Secondary color</span>
<span class="nv">$success</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#28a745</span><span class="p">;</span>        <span class="c1">// Success states</span>
<span class="nv">$danger</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#dc3545</span><span class="p">;</span>         <span class="c1">// Error states</span>
<span class="nv">$warning</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#ffc107</span><span class="p">;</span>        <span class="c1">// Warning states</span>
<span class="nv">$info</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#17a2b8</span><span class="p">;</span>           <span class="c1">// Info states</span>

<span class="c1">// Header colors</span>
<span class="nv">$navbar-bg</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#1a1a1a</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="nv">$navbar-color</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#ffffff</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="c1">// Sidebar colors</span>
<span class="nv">$sidebar-bg</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#2c3e50</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="nv">$sidebar-active</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mh">#3498db</span><span class="p">;</span>
```

</div></div>

### Build Custom Theme

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Clone webui-vue</span>
git clone https://github.com/openbmc/webui-vue.git
<span class="nb">cd </span>webui-vue

<span class="c"># Install dependencies</span>
npm <span class="nb">install</span>

<span class="c"># Set environment variables</span>
<span class="nb">export </span><span class="nv">VUE_APP_COMPANY_NAME</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"My Company"</span>
<span class="nb">export </span><span class="nv">VUE_APP_PRODUCT_NAME</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"Server Manager"</span>

<span class="c"># Build for production</span>
npm run build

<span class="c"># Output in dist/ directory</span>
```

</div></div>

### Create a New View

    

1. Create the Vue component:

<div class="language-vue highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
