```
<span class="c"><!-- src/views/Custom/MyPage.vue --></span>
<span class="nt"><</span><span class="k">template</span><span class="nt">></span>
  <span class="nt"><b-container</span> <span class="na">fluid=</span><span class="s">"xl"</span><span class="nt">></span>
    <span class="nt">
:description="$t('pageMyPage.description')" />

    
      
        
          
            My Custom Page
          
          
            Custom content here

</span>
            <span class="nt"><b-button</span> <span class="na">variant=</span><span class="s">"primary"</span> <span class="err">@</span><span class="na">click=</span><span class="s">"performAction"</span><span class="nt">></span>
              Do Something
            <span class="nt"></b-button></span>
          <span class="nt"></b-card-body></span>
        <span class="nt"></b-card></span>
      <span class="nt"></b-col></span>
    <span class="nt"></b-row></span>
  <span class="nt"></b-container></span>
<span class="nt"></</span><span class="k">template</span><span class="nt">></span>

<span class="nt"><</span><span class="k">script</span><span class="nt">></span>
<span class="k">import</span> <span class="nx">PageTitle</span> <span class="k">from</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">@/components/Global/PageTitle</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="k">export</span> <span class="k">default</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="na">name</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">MyPage</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="na">components</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span> <span class="nx">PageTitle</span> <span class="p">},</span>
  <span class="nf">data</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{</span>
      <span class="na">loading</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">false</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">};</span>
  <span class="p">},</span>
  <span class="na">methods</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nf">performAction</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="p">{</span>
      <span class="c1">// Call Redfish API via Vuex store</span>
      <span class="k">this</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">$store</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">dispatch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">myCustomStore/performAction</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">then</span><span class="p">(()</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="p">{</span>
          <span class="k">this</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">$bvToast</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">toast</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">Action completed</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span>
            <span class="na">title</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">Success</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="na">variant</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">success</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
          <span class="p">});</span>
        <span class="p">})</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="k">catch</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="p">{</span>
          <span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">);</span>
        <span class="p">});</span>
    <span class="p">},</span>
  <span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">};</span>
<span class="nt"></</span><span class="k">script</span><span class="nt">></span>
```

</div></div>

1. Add the route:

<div class="language-javascript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// src/router/routes.js</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="nl">path</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">/custom/my-page</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="nx">name</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">my-page</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="nx">component</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">()</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="k">import</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">@/views/Custom/MyPage</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">),</span>
  <span class="nx">meta</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="nl">title</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">My Page</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="nx">requiresAuth</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">},</span>
```

</div></div>

1. Add navigation entry:

<div class="language-javascript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// src/store/modules/GlobalStore.js</span>
<span class="c1">// Add to sidebar navigation items</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="nl">id</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">my-page</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="nx">label</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">My Page</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="nx">route</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">/custom/my-page</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="nx">icon</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">iconCustom</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">},</span>
```

### Create a Vuex Store Module

    

<div class="language-javascript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// src/store/modules/MyCustomStore.js</span>
<span class="k">import</span> <span class="nx">api</span> <span class="k">from</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">@/store/api</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="kd">const</span> <span class="nx">MyCustomStore</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="na">namespaced</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="na">state</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="na">data</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">null</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="p">},</span>
  <span class="na">getters</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="na">getData</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">state</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="nx">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">data</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="p">},</span>
  <span class="na">mutations</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="na">setData</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">state</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nx">data</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nx">data</span><span class="p">),</span>
  <span class="p">},</span>
  <span class="na">actions</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="nf">fetchData</span><span class="p">({</span> <span class="nx">commit</span> <span class="p">})</span> <span class="p">{</span>
      <span class="k">return</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="nx">api</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">/redfish/v1/Oem/MyVendor/MyResource</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">then</span><span class="p">(({</span> <span class="nx">data</span> <span class="p">})</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="p">{</span>
          <span class="nf">commit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">setData</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nx">data</span><span class="p">);</span>
          <span class="k">return</span> <span class="nx">data</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">})</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="k">catch</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="p">{</span>
          <span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">);</span>
          <span class="k">throw</span> <span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">});</span>
    <span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="k">async</span> <span class="nf">performAction</span><span class="p">({</span> <span class="nx">dispatch</span> <span class="p">})</span> <span class="p">{</span>
      <span class="k">return</span> <span class="k">await</span> <span class="nx">api</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">post</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">/redfish/v1/Oem/MyVendor/MyResource/Actions/MyAction</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">then</span><span class="p">(()</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="nf">dispatch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">fetchData</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="p">.</span><span class="k">catch</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="p">{</span>
          <span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">error</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">);</span>
          <span class="k">throw</span> <span class="nx">error</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="p">});</span>
    <span class="p">},</span>
  <span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">};</span>

<span class="k">export</span> <span class="k">default</span> <span class="nx">MyCustomStore</span><span class="p">;</span>
```

</div></div>

## Internationalization (i18n)

    

### Adding Translations

    

WebUI uses vue-i18n for internationalization:

<div class="language-javascript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// src/locales/en-US.json</span>
<span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">pageMyPage</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">description</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">Description of my custom page</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">title</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">My Page Title</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">actionButton</span><span class="dl">"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">"</span><span class="s2">Perform Action</span><span class="dl">"</span>
  <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
```

</div></div>

### Using Translations

    

<div class="language-vue highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="nt"><</span><span class="k">template</span><span class="nt">></span>
  <span class="nt"><h1></h1></span>
  <span class="nt">

</span>
  <span class="nt"><b-button></b-button></span>
<span class="nt"></</span><span class="k">template</span><span class="nt">></span>
```

</div></div>

### Adding New Language

    

1. Create locale file: `src/locales/de-DE.json`
2. Add to locale configuration:

<div class="language-javascript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// src/main.js</span>
<span class="k">import</span> <span class="nx">deDE</span> <span class="k">from</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">./locales/de-DE.json</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="kd">const</span> <span class="nx">i18n</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="k">new</span> <span class="nc">VueI18n</span><span class="p">({</span>
  <span class="na">locale</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">en-US</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="na">messages</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">en-US</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">enUS</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">de-DE</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">deDE</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">});</span>
```

</div></div>

## Configuration Options

    

### Build Environment Variables

    

Set these in your build environment or `.env` file:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># .env.production</span>
<span class="nv">VUE_APP_COMPANY_NAME</span><span class="o">=</span>MyCompany
<span class="nv">VUE_APP_PRODUCT_NAME</span><span class="o">=</span>Server Manager
<span class="nv">VUE_APP_THEME</span><span class="o">=</span>custom
<span class="nv">VUE_APP_SERVER_ROOT</span><span class="o">=</span>
<span class="nv">VUE_APP_ROUTER_BASE</span><span class="o">=</span>/
```

</div></div>

### Feature Flags

    

Enable/disable features at build time:

<div class="language-javascript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// vue.config.js</span>
<span class="nx">module</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">exports</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="c1">// Enable/disable features</span>
  <span class="na">pluginOptions</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="na">features</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
      <span class="c1">// Show/hide features</span>
      <span class="na">kvm</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
      <span class="na">virtualMedia</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
      <span class="na">solConsole</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
      <span class="na">firmware</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
      <span class="na">network</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
      <span class="na">security</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">true</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">},</span>
  <span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">};</span>
```

</div></div>

### Custom Navigation

    

Add custom external links:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Environment variable (JSON format)</span>
<span class="nv">VUE_APP_INTERNAL_LINKS</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'[
  {"label":"Support","url":"https://support.mycompany.com"},
  {"label":"Documentation","url":"https://docs.mycompany.com"}
]'</span>
```

</div></div>

## Security Configuration

    

### Session Management

    

WebUI uses Redfish sessions:

<div class="language-javascript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// Login flow</span>
<span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">.</span> <span class="nx">User</span> <span class="nx">enters</span> <span class="nx">credentials</span>
<span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">.</span> <span class="nx">POST</span> <span class="nx">to</span> <span class="o">/</span><span class="nx">redfish</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="nx">v1</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="nx">SessionService</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="nx">Sessions</span>
<span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">.</span> <span class="nx">Store</span> <span class="nx">X</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="nx">Auth</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="nx">Token</span> <span class="k">in</span> <span class="nx">Vuex</span>
<span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">.</span> <span class="nx">Include</span> <span class="nx">token</span> <span class="k">in</span> <span class="nx">all</span> <span class="nx">API</span> <span class="nx">requests</span>
<span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">.</span> <span class="nx">Token</span> <span class="nx">stored</span> <span class="k">in</span> <span class="nf">memory </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">lost</span> <span class="nx">on</span> <span class="nx">refresh</span><span class="p">)</span>
```

</div></div>

### HTTPS Requirements

    

bmcweb enforces HTTPS for WebUI:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Certificate location</span>
/etc/ssl/certs/https/server.pem

<span class="c"># Generate new certificate</span>
openssl req <span class="nt">-x509</span> <span class="nt">-newkey</span> rsa:2048 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-keyout</span> /etc/ssl/private/server.pem <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-out</span> /etc/ssl/certs/server.pem <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-days</span> 365 <span class="nt">-nodes</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-subj</span> <span class="s2">"/CN=openbmc"</span>
```

</div></div>

### Content Security Policy

    

bmcweb sets CSP headers:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
Content-Security-Policy:
  default-src 'self';
  script-src 'self';
  style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
  img-src 'self' data:;
```

</div></div>
---

## Development Workflow

    

### Local Development

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Clone repository</span>
git clone https://github.com/openbmc/webui-vue.git
<span class="nb">cd </span>webui-vue

<span class="c"># Install dependencies</span>
npm <span class="nb">install</span>

<span class="c"># Run development server with proxy to BMC</span>
<span class="c"># Create vue.config.js:</span>
module.exports <span class="o">=</span> <span class="o">{</span>
  devServer: <span class="o">{</span>
    proxy: <span class="o">{</span>
      <span class="s1">'/redfish'</span>: <span class="o">{</span>
        target: <span class="s1">'https://192.168.1.100'</span>,
        secure: <span class="nb">false</span>,
        changeOrigin: <span class="nb">true</span>,
      <span class="o">}</span>,
    <span class="o">}</span>,
  <span class="o">}</span>,
<span class="o">}</span><span class="p">;</span>

<span class="c"># Start dev server</span>
npm run serve

<span class="c"># Access at http://localhost:8080</span>
```

</div></div>

### Building for Production

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Production build</span>
npm run build

<span class="c"># Output in dist/</span>
<span class="nb">ls </span>dist/

<span class="c"># Deploy to BMC</span>
scp <span class="nt">-r</span> dist/<span class="k">*</span> root@bmc-ip:/usr/share/www/
```

</div></div>

### Running Tests

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Unit tests</span>
npm run <span class="nb">test</span>:unit

<span class="c"># Linting</span>
npm run lint

<span class="c"># Fix linting issues</span>
npm run lint:fix
```

</div></div>

## Troubleshooting

    

### Login Failures

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check bmcweb is running</span>
systemctl status bmcweb

<span class="c"># Verify credentials via API</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc https://localhost/redfish/v1/

<span class="c"># Check session service</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/SessionService
```

</div></div>

### Page Not Loading

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check WebUI files exist</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> <span class="nt">-la</span> /usr/share/www/

<span class="c"># Check bmcweb logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> bmcweb <span class="nt">-f</span>

<span class="c"># Verify static file serving</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> https://localhost/index.html
```

</div></div>

### API Errors in Console

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check Redfish endpoint</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Systems/system

<span class="c"># Verify D-Bus services</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.ObjectMapper
```

</div></div>

### Browser Console Debug

    

Open browser Developer Tools (F12):

<div class="language-javascript highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// Check Vuex store state</span>
<span class="nx">$store</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">state</span>

<span class="c1">// Check authentication</span>
<span class="nx">$store</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">authentication</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">authToken</span>

<span class="c1">// Manually call API</span>
<span class="nf">fetch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">/redfish/v1/Systems/system</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="na">headers</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="s1">X-Auth-Token</span><span class="dl">'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nx">$store</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">state</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">authentication</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">authToken</span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">}).</span><span class="nf">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">r</span> <span class="o">=></span> <span class="nx">r</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nf">json</span><span class="p">()).</span><span class="nf">then</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nx">console</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="nx">log</span><span class="p">)</span>
```

</div></div>
---

## Enabling/Disabling WebUI

    

### Remove from Image

    

```bitbake
# Remove WebUI from build
IMAGE_INSTALL:remove = "webui-vue"

# Or create a minimal bmcweb without WebUI serving
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-bmcweb = " \
    -Dstatic-hosting=disabled \
"
```

### Disable at Runtime

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># WebUI is served by bmcweb, so stopping bmcweb disables both</span>
<span class="c"># WebUI and Redfish API</span>

<span class="c"># To keep Redfish but remove WebUI files:</span>
<span class="nb">rm</span> <span class="nt">-rf</span> /usr/share/www/<span class="k">*</span>

<span class="c"># Restart bmcweb</span>
systemctl restart bmcweb
```

</div></div>

## Deep Dive

    

This section provides detailed technical information for developers who want to understand the WebUI architecture and internals.

### WebUI Request Flow

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        WebUI Request Flow Architecture                      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                             │
│  Browser (webui-vue SPA)                                                    │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  1. User Action (e.g., click "Power On")                               │ │
│  │         │                                                              │ │
│  │         v                                                              │ │
│  │  Vue Component: PowerOperations.vue                                    │ │
│  │    methods: { powerOn() { this.$store.dispatch('controls/hostPowerOn') }} │
│  │         │                                                              │ │
│  │         v                                                              │ │
│  │  Vuex Store: ControlStore.js                                           │ │
│  │    async hostPowerOn({ dispatch }) {                                   │ │
│  │      return api.post('/redfish/v1/Systems/system/Actions/...');        │ │
│  │    }                                                                   │ │
│  │         │                                                              │ │
│  │         v                                                              │ │
│  │  Axios API Client: store/api.js                                        │ │
│  │    - Add X-Auth-Token header                                           │ │
│  │    - Handle response/errors                                            │ │
│  │    - CSRF token handling                                               │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│            │                                                                │
│            │  HTTPS POST /redfish/v1/Systems/system/Actions/...             │
│            │  Headers: X-Auth-Token: <session-token>                        │
│            │  Body: {"ResetType": "On"}                                     │
│            v                                                                │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │                           bmcweb                                       │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  1. TLS Termination (Boost.Beast SSL context)                          │ │
│  │         │                                                              │ │
│  │         v                                                              │ │
│  │  2. Session Validation                                                 │ │
│  │     - Check X-Auth-Token in SessionStore                               │ │
│  │     - Verify session not expired                                       │ │
│  │     - Get user privileges                                              │ │
│  │         │                                                              │ │
│  │         v                                                              │ │
│  │  3. Route Dispatch                                                     │ │
│  │     App::routing -> ComputerSystemReset handler                        │ │
│  │         │                                                              │ │
│  │         v                                                              │ │
│  │  4. Privilege Check                                                    │ │
│  │     Requires: ConfigureComponents privilege                            │ │
│  │         │                                                              │ │
│  │         v                                                              │ │
│  │  5. D-Bus Call                                                         │ │
│  │     crow::connections::systemBus->async_method_call(                   │ │
│  │       "xyz.openbmc_project.State.Host",                                │ │
│  │       "/xyz/openbmc_project/state/host0",                              │ │
│  │       "org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties", "Set",                        │ │
│  │       "xyz.openbmc_project.State.Host",                                │ │
│  │       "RequestedHostTransition",                                       │ │
│  │       variant("xyz.openbmc_project.State.Host.Transition.On")          │ │
│  │     );                                                                 │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│            │                                                                │
│            v                                                                │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │                 phosphor-state-manager                                 │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  Property Set Handler:                                                 │ │
│  │    - Validate transition request                                       │ │
│  │    - Trigger GPIO power sequence                                       │ │
│  │    - Update CurrentHostState asynchronously                            │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Vuex State Management Architecture

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Vuex Store Architecture                                │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                             │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │                        Root Store (store/index.js)                     │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  state: {                                                              │ │
│  │    // Global state only                                                │ │
│  │  }                                                                     │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  modules: {                                                            │ │
│  │    ┌─────────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────┐                    │ │
│  │    │ authentication      │  │ global              │                    │ │
│  │    │ ├─ authToken        │  │ ├─ serverStatus    │                    │ │
│  │    │ ├─ isAuthenticated  │  │ ├─ languagePrefs   │                    │ │
│  │    │ └─ sessionUri       │  │ └─ themeSettings   │                    │ │
│  │    └─────────────────────┘  └─────────────────────┘                    │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │    ┌─────────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────┐                    │ │
│  │    │ sensors             │  │ controls            │                    │ │
│  │    │ ├─ allSensors[]     │  │ ├─ hostState       │                    │ │
│  │    │ ├─ selectedSensor   │  │ ├─ chassisState    │                    │ │
│  │    │ └─ sensorHistory[]  │  │ └─ bootSettings    │                    │ │
│  │    └─────────────────────┘  └─────────────────────┘                    │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │    ┌─────────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────┐                    │ │
│  │    │ eventLog            │  │ serverLed           │                    │ │
│  │    │ ├─ allEvents[]      │  │ ├─ indicatorLed    │                    │ │
│  │    │ ├─ filteredEvents[] │  │ └─ locationLed     │                    │ │
│  │    │ └─ eventCount       │  └─────────────────────┘                    │ │
│  │    └─────────────────────┘                                             │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │    ... additional modules for firmware, network, users, etc.           │ │
│  │  }                                                                     │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                                             │
│  Data Flow Pattern:                                                         │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  Component ──dispatch──> Actions ──commit──> Mutations ──> State       │ │
│  │      │                      │                                │         │ │
│  │      │                      │ (async API calls)              │         │ │
│  │      │                      v                                │         │ │
│  │      │               api.get/post()                          │         │ │
│  │      │                      │                                │         │ │
│  │      │                      v                                │         │ │
│  │      │               Redfish Response                        │         │ │
│  │      │                      │                                │         │ │
│  │      │              commit('setData', response)              │         │ │
│  │      │                                                       │         │ │
│  │      <────────mapGetters/mapState────────────────────────────┘         │ │
│  │      (reactive updates via Vue reactivity system)                      │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Session Authentication Flow

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       Redfish Session Authentication                        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                             │
│  Login Flow:                                                                │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  1. User submits credentials via Login.vue                             │ │
│  │     ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │ │
│  │     │  POST /redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions                   │   │ │
│  │     │  Content-Type: application/json                             │   │ │
│  │     │  Body: { "UserName": "root", "Password": "0penBmc" }        │   │ │
│  │     └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │ │
│  │                              │                                         │ │
│  │                              v                                         │ │
│  │  2. bmcweb validates credentials via PAM                               │ │
│  │     ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │ │
│  │     │  pamAuthenticateUser(username, password)                    │   │ │
│  │     │    -> pam_unix.so checks /etc/shadow                        │   │ │
│  │     │    -> Returns PAM_SUCCESS or PAM_AUTH_ERR                   │   │ │
│  │     └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │ │
│  │                              │                                         │ │
│  │                              v                                         │ │
│  │  3. bmcweb creates session and returns token                           │ │
│  │     ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │ │
│  │     │  HTTP 201 Created                                           │   │ │
│  │     │  Location: /redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions/abc123       │   │ │
│  │     │  X-Auth-Token: <64-char-random-token>                       │   │ │
│  │     │                                                             │   │ │
│  │     │  Body: {                                                    │   │ │
│  │     │    "@odata.id": "/redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions/abc123",│   │ │
│  │     │    "UserName": "root"                                       │   │ │
│  │     │  }                                                          │   │ │
│  │     └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │ │
│  │                              │                                         │ │
│  │                              v                                         │ │
│  │  4. WebUI stores token in Vuex (memory only - not localStorage)        │ │
│  │     ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │ │
│  │     │  commit('setAuthToken', response.headers['x-auth-token']);  │   │ │
│  │     │  commit('setSessionUri', response.headers['location']);     │   │ │
│  │     └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                                             │
│  Session Storage in bmcweb:                                                 │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  SessionStore (in-memory map):                                         │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  sessions_["abc123"] = {                                               │ │
│  │    uniqueId: "abc123",                                                 │ │
│  │    sessionToken: "<64-char-token>",                                    │ │
│  │    username: "root",                                                   │ │
│  │    csrfToken: "<csrf-token>",                                          │ │
│  │    clientIp: "192.168.1.100",                                          │ │
│  │    createdTime: <timestamp>,                                           │ │
│  │    lastUpdatedTime: <timestamp>,                                       │ │
│  │    userRole: "Administrator"                                           │ │
│  │  }                                                                     │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  Session Timeout: 30 minutes (configurable)                            │ │
│  │  Max Sessions: 10 per user (configurable)                              │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                                             │
│  Authenticated Request:                                                     │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  GET /redfish/v1/Systems/system                                        │ │
│  │  X-Auth-Token: <session-token>                                         │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  bmcweb validation:                                                    │ │
│  │  1. Extract token from X-Auth-Token header                             │ │
│  │  2. Look up session by token in SessionStore                           │ │
│  │  3. Check session not expired                                          │ │
│  │  4. Update lastUpdatedTime (session keep-alive)                        │ │
│  │  5. Attach user privileges to request context                          │ │
│  │  6. Process request with user's RBAC privileges                        │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### WebSocket Event Streaming

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Server-Sent Events (SSE) Architecture                   │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                             │
│  WebUI uses SSE for real-time updates (sensors, logs, state changes):      │
│                                                                             │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  Browser                              bmcweb                            │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  │  EventSource('/redfish/v1/SSE')  ──> SSE Handler                       │ │
│  │        │                                   │                           │ │
│  │        │ HTTP/1.1 200 OK                   │                           │ │
│  │        │ Content-Type: text/event-stream   │                           │ │
│  │        │ Cache-Control: no-cache           │                           │ │
│  │        │ Connection: keep-alive            │                           │ │
│  │        │                                   │                           │ │
│  │        │<────── Keep connection open ──────│                           │ │
│  │        │                                   │                           │ │
│  │        │                            ┌──────┴──────┐                    │ │
│  │        │                            │ D-Bus Match │                    │ │
│  │        │                            │ Subscriptions│                    │ │
│  │        │                            └──────┬──────┘                    │ │
│  │        │                                   │                           │ │
│  │        │                            PropertiesChanged signal           │ │
│  │        │                                   │                           │ │
│  │        │<──── data: {"...sensor update..."}                            │ │
│  │        │                                   │                           │ │
│  │        v                                   │                           │ │
│  │  onmessage(event) {                        │                           │ │
│  │    const data = JSON.parse(event.data);    │                           │ │
│  │    store.commit('sensors/update', data);   │                           │ │
│  │  }                                         │                           │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                                             │
│  SSE Message Format:                                                        │
│  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│  │  event: ResourceChanged                                                │ │
│  │  id: 12345                                                             │ │
│  │  data: {                                                               │ │
│  │    "@odata.type": "#Event.v1_0_0.Event",                               │ │
│  │    "Events": [{                                                        │ │
│  │      "EventType": "ResourceChanged",                                   │ │
│  │      "MessageId": "ResourceEvent.1.0.ResourceChanged",                 │ │
│  │      "OriginOfCondition": {                                            │ │
│  │        "@odata.id": "/redfish/v1/Chassis/chassis/Sensors/CPU_Temp"     │ │
│  │      },                                                                │ │
│  │      "Message": "Sensor reading changed"                               │ │
│  │    }]                                                                  │ │
│  │  }                                                                     │ │
│  │                                                                        │ │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │
│                                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

| Session Management | [openbmc/bmcweb](https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb) | `include/sessions.hpp`, `redfish-core/lib/redfish_sessions.hpp` |
| SSE Implementation | [openbmc/bmcweb](https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb) | `include/server_sent_events.hpp` |

</div>

## Overview

    

**KVM (Keyboard, Video, Mouse)** provides remote graphical console access to the host system, allowing operators to interact with the system as if they were physically present. OpenBMC implements KVM through **obmc-ikvm**.

```mermaid
---
title: KVM Architecture
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph client["Browser/Client"]
        direction LR
        subgraph novnc["noVNC (JavaScript VNC Client)"]
            direction LR
            video["Video Display"]
            keyboard["Keyboard Input"]
            mouse["Mouse Input"]
        end
    end

    client -->|"WebSocket / TCP:5900"| bmcweb

    subgraph bmcweb["bmcweb (WebSocket proxy)"]
    end

    bmcweb --> ikvm

    subgraph ikvm["obmc-ikvm"]
        direction LR
        capture["Video Capture  
(JPEG/ASTC)"]
        hid["USB HID Gadget  
(Keyboard/Mouse)"]
    end

    capture --> videohw["Video Capture HW  
(ASPEED/Nuvoton)"]
    hid --> usbctrl["USB Device Controller"]

    videohw --> host
    usbctrl --> host

    subgraph host["Host System"]
        direction LR
        vga["VGA output"]
        usb["USB ports"]
    end
```

## Hardware Requirements

    

### Video Capture

    

KVM requires hardware video capture capability:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| BMC SoC | Video Capture | Compression |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ASPEED AST2500/2600 | VGA capture engine | JPEG, ASPEED proprietary |
| Nuvoton NPCM7xx | GFX capture | JPEG |

</div>

### USB Device Controller

    

For keyboard/mouse input:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| BMC SoC | USB Controller | Gadget Support |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ASPEED AST2500/2600 | USB 2.0 device | HID gadget |
| Nuvoton NPCM7xx | USB device | HID gadget |

</div>
---

## Setup & Configuration

    

### Build-Time Configuration (Yocto)

    

```bitbake
# In your machine .conf or local.conf

# Include KVM support
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " obmc-ikvm"

# Enable KVM in bmcweb
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-bmcweb = " \
    -Dkvm=enabled \
"

# For ASPEED-based systems
PREFERRED_PROVIDER_virtual/obmc-host-ipmi-hw = "phosphor-ipmi-kcs"
MACHINE_FEATURES:append = " obmc-ikvm"
```

### bmcweb KVM Options

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kvm` | enabled | Enable KVM WebSocket support |
| `insecure-kvm-auth` | disabled | Allow unauthenticated KVM (testing only) |

</div>

### Device Tree Configuration

    

ASPEED systems require video capture configuration:

```dts
// Device tree snippet for AST2500/2600
&video {
    status = "okay";
    memory-region = <&video_memory>;
};

&gfx {
    status = "okay";
    memory-region = <&gfx_memory>;
};
```

### Runtime Configuration

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check obmc-ikvm service</span>
systemctl status obmc-ikvm

<span class="c"># View KVM logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> obmc-ikvm <span class="nt">-f</span>

<span class="c"># Restart KVM service</span>
systemctl restart obmc-ikvm
```

</div></div>
---

## Accessing KVM

    

### Via WebUI

    

1. Login to WebUI at `https:///`
2. Navigate to **Operations** → **KVM Console**
3. Click **Open in new tab** or use embedded viewer
4. Interact with host display, keyboard, and mouse

### Via Direct noVNC

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Access noVNC directly (if exposed)</span>
https://<bmc-ip>/kvm/0

<span class="c"># Or via Redfish link</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc
<span class="c"># Look for GraphicalConsole link</span>
```

</div></div>

### Via VNC Client

    

For direct VNC client access (if enabled):

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Connect with VNC viewer</span>
vncviewer bmc-ip:5900

<span class="c"># With password (if configured)</span>
vncviewer <span class="nt">-passwd</span> ~/.vnc/passwd bmc-ip:5900
```

</div></div>
---

### Video Quality Settings

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">

```
obmc-ikvm <span class="nt">--help</span>
```

Configure via bmcweb:

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c1">// In bmcweb configuration</span>
<span class="c1">// Maximum concurrent KVM sessions (typically 1-2)</span>
<span class="k">static</span> <span class="k">constexpr</span> <span class="kt">size_t</span> <span class="n">maxKvmSessions</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">;</span>
```

</div></div>

## Power State Considerations

    

### KVM Availability by State

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Host Power State | Video Capture | KVM Available |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Off | No output | Blank screen |
| On (POST) | BIOS output | Yes |
| On (OS) | OS display | Yes |
| Sleep | May blank | Limited |

</div>

### BIOS/UEFI Configuration

    

For best KVM experience, configure host BIOS:

1. **Set video output** to onboard/BMC VGA
2. **Disable** GPU priority if using external graphics
3. **Enable** legacy VGA for BIOS screens

---

## Input Handling

    

### Keyboard Mapping

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
Client Keyboard → noVNC → bmcweb WebSocket → obmc-ikvm → USB HID → Host
```

</div></div>

Common key mappings:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Client Key | Host Key | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ctrl+Alt+Del | Ctrl+Alt+Del | Captured by noVNC |
| F1-F12 | F1-F12 | Pass through |
| Alt+Tab | Alt+Tab | May be captured locally |
| Print Screen | Print Screen | Pass through |

</div>

### Special Key Combinations

    

Access via noVNC toolbar or keyboard shortcuts:

* **Ctrl+Alt+Delete**: Send to remote
* **Ctrl+Alt+F1-F6**: Virtual terminal switch (Linux)
* **Windows Key**: May need special handling

### Mouse Configuration

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Mouse is typically absolute positioning</span>
<span class="c"># If relative mode needed, configure in obmc-ikvm</span>

<span class="c"># Check mouse mode</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/usb_role/<span class="k">*</span>/role
```

</div></div>

## Troubleshooting

    

### No Video Display

```
<span class="c"># Check video capture hardware</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /dev/video<span class="k">*</span>

v4l2-ctl <span class="nt">--all</span>

<span class="c"># Check memory regions</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /proc/iomem | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> video
```

</div></div>

### Black Screen

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Verify host is powered on</span>
obmcutil state

<span class="c"># Check if host is generating video</span>

<span class="c"># Try resetting video capture</span>

```

</div></div>

### Keyboard/Mouse Not Working

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check USB HID gadget</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /dev/hidg<span class="k">*</span>

modprobe g_hid
```

```
<span class="c"># Verify KVM session count</span>

```

### Performance Issues

## Security Considerations

    

### Authentication

    

KVM access requires Redfish authentication:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># KVM WebSocket is authenticated via session token</span>
<span class="c"># Ensure strong passwords for KVM users</span>

<span class="c"># Create operator account for KVM</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "UserName": "kvmuser",
        "Password": "SecurePass123!",
        "RoleId": "Operator"
    }'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/AccountService/Accounts
```

</div></div>

### Session Management

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># View active sessions</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/SessionService/Sessions

<span class="c"># Terminate KVM session (close WebSocket)</span>
<span class="c"># Sessions auto-terminate on browser close</span>
```

</div></div>

### Encryption

    

All KVM traffic is encrypted via HTTPS/WSS:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
Browser ←→ bmcweb: TLS 1.2/1.3
```

</div></div>
---

## Enabling/Disabling KVM

    

### Build-Time Disable

    

```bitbake
# Remove KVM from build
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-bmcweb = " \
    -Dkvm=disabled \
"
IMAGE_INSTALL:remove = "obmc-ikvm"
```

### Runtime Disable

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Stop KVM service</span>
systemctl stop obmc-ikvm
systemctl disable obmc-ikvm

<span class="c"># Re-enable</span>
systemctl <span class="nb">enable </span>obmc-ikvm
systemctl start obmc-ikvm
```

</div></div>

## Deep Dive

    

Advanced implementation details for KVM developers.

### Video Capture Pipeline

    

```mermaid
---
title: Video Capture Processing Pipeline
---
flowchart TB
    vga["HOST VGA OUTPUT  
Analog VGA signals  
(R, G, B, HSync, VSync)"]

    subgraph aspeed["ASPEED Video Engine (AST2500/2600)"]
        direction TB
        adc["1. ADC Capture  
VGA signals → 10-bit ADC sampling  
Sync detection → resolution auto-detect"]
        fb["2. Frame Buffer  
Raw pixels → Video memory  
Format: RGB565 or RGB888"]
        jpeg["3. Hardware JPEG Encoder  
Full frame → DCT → Quantization → Huffman  
Or: Software via libjpeg-turbo"]
        adc --> fb --> jpeg
    end

    subgraph ikvm["obmc-ikvm Video Processing"]
        direction TB
        capture["Frame Capture Loop"]
        dequeue["1. Dequeue buffer from V4L2"]
        dirty["2. Check for frame changes  
(dirty detection)"]
        compress["3. Compress changed regions"]
        send["4. Send via RFB protocol"]
        requeue["5. Requeue buffer"]
        capture --> dequeue --> dirty --> compress --> send --> requeue
        requeue -.->|"loop"| dequeue
    end

    vga --> aspeed
    aspeed -->|"/dev/video0 (V4L2)"| ikvm

    options["Compression Options:  
• JPEG (quality 10-100)  
• Raw (high bandwidth)  
• Tight encoding with zlib"]
```

> **ASCII-art version (click to expand)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      Video Capture Processing Pipeline                     │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  HOST VGA OUTPUT                                                           │
│  ───────────────                                                           │
│        │                                                                   │
│        │ Analog VGA signals (R, G, B, HSync, VSync)                        │
│        v                                                                   │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  ASPEED Video Engine (AST2500/2600)                                 │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  1. ADC Capture                                                     │   │
│  │     ─────────────                                                   │   │
│  │     VGA signals → 10-bit ADC sampling                               │   │
│  │     Sync detection → resolution/timing auto-detect                  │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  2. Frame Buffer                                                    │   │
│  │     ────────────                                                    │   │
│  │     Raw pixels → Video memory (shared with ARM)                     │   │
│  │     Format: RGB565 or RGB888                                        │   │
│  │     Memory region: /dev/mem or videobuf2                            │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  3. Hardware JPEG Encoder (Optional)                                │   │
│  │     ────────────────────────────────                                │   │
│  │     Full frame → DCT → Quantization → Huffman → JPEG stream         │   │
│  │     Or: Software compression via libjpeg-turbo                      │   │
│  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────-┘   │
│        │                                                                   │
│        │ /dev/video0 (V4L2 interface)                                      │
│        v                                                                   │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐   │
│  │  obmc-ikvm Video Processing                                         │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  Frame Capture Loop:                                                │   │
│  │  ─────────────────────                                              │   │
│  │  while (running) {                                                  │   │
│  │      // 1. Dequeue buffer from V4L2                                 │   │
│  │      ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_DQBUF, &buf);                                 │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │      // 2. Check for frame changes (dirty detection)                │   │
│  │      if (memcmp(current_frame, last_frame, size) != 0) {            │   │
│  │          // 3. Compress changed regions                             │   │
│  │          jpeg_data = compress_jpeg(current_frame, quality);         │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │          // 4. Send via RFB protocol                                │   │
│  │          send_rfb_update(jpeg_data);                                │   │
│  │      }                                                              │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │      // 5. Requeue buffer                                           │   │
│  │      ioctl(fd, VIDIOC_QBUF, &buf);                                  │   │
│  │  }                                                                  │   │
│  │                                                                     │   │
│  │  Compression Options:                                               │   │
│  │    - JPEG (quality 10-100, typical 50-80)                           │   │
│  │    - Raw (no compression, high bandwidth)                           │   │
│  │    - Tight encoding with zlib                                       │   │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘   │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div>  </div>

### RFB (VNC) Protocol Frame Updates

    

```mermaid
---
title: RFB Protocol Frame Updates
---
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client as Client (noVNC)
    participant Server as Server (obmc-ikvm)

    Client->>Server: FramebufferUpdateRequest  
message-type: 3  
incremental: 1  
x: 0, y: 0  
width: 1920, height: 1080

    Note right of Server: Capture frame  
Detect changes  
Compress regions

    Server->>Client: FramebufferUpdate  
message-type: 0  
rectangles: 2

    Note left of Client: Rectangle 1: x:100 y:200  
400x300, JPEG encoding  
Rectangle 2: Cursor update
```

**Encoding Types Supported:**

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Encoding | ID | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Raw | 0 | Uncompressed pixels (RGB888/RGB565) |
| CopyRect | 1 | Copy from another screen region |
| RRE | 2 | Rise and Run length Encoding |
| Hextile | 5 | 16x16 tile-based compression |
| ZRLE | 16 | Zlib Run-Length Encoding |
| Tight | 7 | Tight compression with JPEG option |
| JPEG | 21 | JPEG-compressed rectangle |
| Cursor | -239 | Client-side cursor rendering |
| DesktopSize | -223 | Desktop size change notification |

</div>

**Tight Encoding Control Byte:**

* Bits 0-2: zlib stream reset flags
* Bits 3-4: fill mode / filter
* Bits 5-7: compression type (0x09 = JPEG, 0x00-0x07 = Basic)
* JPEG Quality: pseudo-encoding -23 to -32 sets quality 0-9 (maps to 5-95%)

### USB HID Gadget Protocol

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        USB HID Gadget Implementation                       │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  USB HID GADGET SETUP                                                      │
│  ────────────────────                                                      │
│                                                                            │
│  /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/kvm_gadget/                                 │
│  ├── idVendor              # 0x1d6b (Linux Foundation)                     │
│  ├── idProduct             # 0x0104 (Multifunction Composite Gadget)       │
│  ├── bcdDevice             # 0x0100                                        │
│  ├── bcdUSB                # 0x0200 (USB 2.0)                              │
│  ├── strings/0x409/                                                        │
│  │   ├── serialnumber      # BMC serial                                    │
│  │   ├── manufacturer      # OpenBMC                                       │
│  │   └── product           # Virtual KVM                                   │
│  ├── configs/c.1/                                                          │
│  │   ├── MaxPower          # 500 (mA)                                      │
│  │   ├── hid.keyboard -> functions/hid.keyboard                            │
│  │   └── hid.mouse -> functions/hid.mouse                                  │
│  └── functions/                                                            │
│      ├── hid.keyboard/                                                     │
│      │   ├── protocol      # 1 (Keyboard)                                  │
│      │   ├── subclass      # 1 (Boot Interface)                            │
│      │   ├── report_length # 8                                             │
│      │   └── report_desc   # HID Report Descriptor (binary)                │
│      └── hid.mouse/                                                        │
│          ├── protocol      # 2 (Mouse)                                     │
│          ├── subclass      # 1 (Boot Interface)                            │
│          ├── report_length # 6                                             │
│          └── report_desc   # HID Report Descriptor (binary)                │
│                                                                            │
│  KEYBOARD HID REPORT FORMAT (8 bytes):                                     │
│  ─────────────────────────────────────                                     │
│                                                                            │
│  ┌─────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┐
│  │ Byte 0  │ Byte 1  │ Byte 2 │ Byte 3 │ Byte 4 │ Byte 5 │ Byte 6 │ Byte 7 │
│  ├─────────┼─────────┼────────┼────────┼────────┼────────┼────────┼────────┤
│  │Modifier │Reserved │ Key 1  │ Key 2  │ Key 3  │ Key 4  │ Key 5  │ Key 6  │
│  │ Flags   │  (0x00) │        │        │        │        │        │        │
│  └─────────┴─────────┴────────┴────────┴────────┴────────┴────────┴────────┘
│                                                                            │
│  Modifier Flags (Byte 0):                                                  │
│    Bit 0: Left Ctrl     Bit 4: Right Ctrl                                  │
│    Bit 1: Left Shift    Bit 5: Right Shift                                 │
│    Bit 2: Left Alt      Bit 6: Right Alt                                   │
│    Bit 3: Left GUI      Bit 7: Right GUI (Windows key)                     │
│                                                                            │
│  Example: Ctrl+Alt+Delete                                                  │
│    [0x05, 0x00, 0x4C, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]                        │
│    0x05 = Left Ctrl (0x01) + Left Alt (0x04)                               │
│    0x4C = Delete key scancode                                              │
│                                                                            │
│  MOUSE HID REPORT FORMAT (6 bytes - Absolute):                             │
│  ────────────────────────────────────────────                              │
│                                                                            │
│  ┌─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┐             │
│  │ Byte 0  │ Byte 1  │ Byte 2  │ Byte 3  │ Byte 4  │ Byte 5  │             │
│  ├─────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────┼─────────┤             │
│  │ Buttons │  X Low  │ X High  │  Y Low  │ Y High  │ Wheel   │             │
│  └─────────┴─────────┴─────────┴─────────┴─────────┴─────────┘             │
│                                                                            │
│  Buttons (Byte 0):                                                         │
│    Bit 0: Left button    Bit 2: Middle button                              │
│    Bit 1: Right button   Bits 3-7: Reserved                                │
│                                                                            │
│  X/Y: 16-bit absolute position (0-32767 maps to screen)                    │
│  Wheel: Signed 8-bit scroll delta                                          │
│                                                                            │
│  WRITING TO HID DEVICE:                                                    │
│  ──────────────────────                                                    │
│                                                                            │
│  // Send keyboard report                                                   │
│  int fd = open("/dev/hidg0", O_WRONLY);                                    │
│  uint8_t report[8] = {0x05, 0, 0x4C, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0};  // Ctrl+Alt+Del      │
│  write(fd, report, sizeof(report));                                        │
│                                                                            │
│  // Key release                                                            │
│  memset(report, 0, sizeof(report));                                        │
│  write(fd, report, sizeof(report));                                        │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### WebSocket to VNC Bridge

    

```mermaid
---
title: WebSocket Connection Establishment
---
sequenceDiagram
    participant Browser
    participant bmcweb
    participant ikvm as obmc-ikvm

    Browser->>bmcweb: GET /kvm/0  
Upgrade: websocket  
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: binary
    bmcweb->>Browser: HTTP/1.1 101 Switching  
Connection: Upgrade  
Sec-WebSocket-Accept: [hash]

    Browser->>bmcweb: WebSocket Binary Frame
    bmcweb->>ikvm: Unix Socket  
/var/run/obmc-ikvm.sock
    ikvm->>bmcweb: RFB Protocol Version
    bmcweb->>Browser: WebSocket Binary Frame
```

```mermaid
---
title: KVM Data Flow
---
sequenceDiagram
    participant noVNC as noVNC (browser)
    participant bmcweb
    participant ikvm as obmc-ikvm
    participant Host

    noVNC->>bmcweb: KeyEvent (RFB msg)  
WebSocket binary frame
    bmcweb->>ikvm: Unix socket
    ikvm->>Host: write() /dev/hidg0  
USB HID report

    Host->>ikvm: Video capture  
V4L2 frame
    ikvm->>bmcweb: Unix socket (JPEG data)
    bmcweb->>noVNC: FramebufferUpdate  
WebSocket binary frame
```

**bmcweb KVM Handler (kvm.hpp):**

<div class="language-cpp highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="kt">void</span> <span class="nf">handleKvmWebSocket</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">crow</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">websocket</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">Connection</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">conn</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="c1">// 1. Connect to obmc-ikvm Unix socket</span>
    <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">sock</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">socket</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">AF_UNIX</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">SOCK_STREAM</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">);</span>
    <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="nc">sockaddr_un</span> <span class="n">addr</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="n">addr</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">sun_family</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">AF_UNIX</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="n">strncpy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">addr</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">sun_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"/var/run/obmc-ikvm.sock"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(...));</span>
    <span class="n">connect</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sock</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="nc">sockaddr</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">addr</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">addr</span><span class="p">));</span>

    <span class="c1">// 2. Bidirectional forwarding</span>
    <span class="c1">// WebSocket → Unix socket (client input)</span>
    <span class="n">conn</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">onMessage</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">sock</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="k">const</span> <span class="n">std</span><span class="o">::</span><span class="n">string</span><span class="o">&</span> <span class="n">msg</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="n">write</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sock</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">msg</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="p">(),</span> <span class="n">msg</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">size</span><span class="p">());</span>
    <span class="p">});</span>

    <span class="c1">// Unix socket → WebSocket (video/responses)</span>
    <span class="n">async_read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">sock</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">buffer</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="o">&</span><span class="n">conn</span><span class="p">](</span><span class="kt">size_t</span> <span class="n">bytes</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="n">conn</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">sendBinary</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">buffer</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">bytes</span><span class="p">);</span>
    <span class="p">});</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
```

</div></div>

## Overview

    

**Virtual Media** allows mounting remote disk images (ISO, IMG) to the host system over the network, appearing as local USB storage devices. This enables remote OS installation and recovery without physical media.

```mermaid
---
title: Virtual Media Architecture
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph sources["Remote Image Source"]
        direction LR
        https["HTTPS  
Server"]
        cifs["CIFS  
Share"]
        nfs["NFS  
Export"]
        upload["Upload  
(WebUI)"]
    end

    sources -->|Network| bmcweb

    subgraph bmcweb["bmcweb (WebSocket / Redfish)"]
    end

    bmcweb --> proxy["Proxy Mode  
(preferred)"]
    bmcweb --> legacy["Legacy Mode  
(USB Mass Storage)"]
    bmcweb --> nbd["NBD Proxy"]

    proxy --> gadget
    legacy --> gadget
    nbd --> gadget

    subgraph gadget["USB Gadget (Mass Storage Class)"]
    end

    gadget --> host

    subgraph host["Host System (USB disk device)"]
    end
```

## Modes of Operation

    

### Proxy Mode (Recommended)

    

* Image streams from remote server through BMC
* No local storage required on BMC
* Supports HTTPS, NFS, CIFS sources
* Lower latency for network-accessible images

### Legacy Mode

    

* Image stored locally on BMC filesystem
* Presented via USB mass storage
* Works offline once mounted
* Limited by BMC storage capacity

### NBD Proxy

    

* Network Block Device protocol
* Efficient streaming protocol
* Used with WebSocket connections

---

## Hardware Requirements

    

Virtual Media requires USB device controller:

<div class="table-wrapper">
| BMC SoC | USB Controller | Mass Storage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ASPEED AST2500/2600 | USB 2.0 device | Supported |
| Nuvoton NPCM7xx | USB 2.0 device | Supported |

</div>

## Setup & Configuration

    

### Build-Time Configuration (Yocto)

    

```bitbake
# In your machine .conf or local.conf

# Include virtual media support
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " virtual-media"

# Enable in bmcweb
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-bmcweb = " \
    -Dvm-websocket=enabled \
    -Dvm-nbdproxy=enabled \
"

# Include NBD client (for proxy mode)
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " nbd-client"
```

### bmcweb Virtual Media Options

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vm-websocket` | enabled | Virtual Media WebSocket support |
| `vm-nbdproxy` | enabled | NBD proxy for streaming |
| `insecure-vm-auth` | disabled | Unauthenticated VM (testing) |

</div>

### Runtime Configuration

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check virtual media service</span>
systemctl status virtual-media

<span class="c"># View logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> virtual-media <span class="nt">-f</span>

<span class="c"># Check USB gadget configuration</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> /sys/kernel/config/usb_gadget/
```

</div></div>
