## Firmware Image Format

    

### Tarball Structure

    

OpenBMC firmware images are packaged as tarballs with a specific structure:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
obmc-phosphor-image-<machine>.tar
├── MANIFEST                    # Metadata about the image
├── publickey                   # Public key for verification (optional)
├── image-kernel                # Linux kernel (FIT image or uImage)
├── image-rofs                  # Read-only root filesystem (squashfs)
├── image-rwfs                  # Read-write filesystem (ext4/ubifs)
├── image-u-boot                # U-Boot bootloader
├── image-bmc                   # Combined flash image (static.mtd)
└── *.sig                       # Signatures for each component
```

</div></div>

### MANIFEST File Format

    

The MANIFEST file contains critical metadata parsed during update:

<div class="language-ini highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Example MANIFEST file
</span><span class="py">purpose</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Version.VersionPurpose.BMC</span>
<span class="py">version</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">2.12.0-dev-123-gabcdef</span>
<span class="py">KeyType</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">OpenBMC</span>
<span class="py">HashType</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">RSA-SHA256</span>
<span class="py">MachineName</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">romulus</span>
<span class="w">
</span><span class="c"># Extended version information (optional)
</span><span class="py">extended_version</span><span class="p">=</span><span class="s">OpenBMC for Romulus - master branch build 123</span>
```

</div></div>

#### MANIFEST Fields

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `purpose` | Yes | `BMC`, `Host`, `System`, or custom |
| `version` | Yes | Semantic version string |
| `MachineName` | Recommended | Target machine (prevents wrong-machine updates) |
| `KeyType` | If signed | Signing key type (OpenBMC, ProductionKey, etc.) |
| `HashType` | If signed | Hash algorithm (RSA-SHA256, RSA-SHA512) |
| `extended_version` | No | Additional version details |

</div>

### Image File Types

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| File | Format | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image-kernel` | FIT/uImage | Linux kernel, often with DTB |
| `image-rofs` | SquashFS | Compressed read-only root filesystem |
| `image-rwfs` | ext4/UBIFS | Persistent writable data |
| `image-u-boot` | Binary | U-Boot bootloader image |
| `image-bmc` | static.mtd | Complete flash image for recovery |

</div>

### Creating Firmware Images

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Build produces images in deploy directory</span>
bitbake obmc-phosphor-image

<span class="c"># Find images</span>
<span class="nb">ls </span>tmp/deploy/images/<machine>/
<span class="c"># obmc-phosphor-image-<machine>.tar</span>
<span class="c"># obmc-phosphor-image-<machine>.static.mtd</span>
<span class="c"># obmc-phosphor-image-<machine>.ubi.mtd</span>

<span class="c"># Manual tarball creation (for testing)</span>
<span class="nb">cd </span>tmp/deploy/images/<machine>/
<span class="nb">tar</span> <span class="nt">-cvf</span> custom-image.tar <span class="se">\</span>
    MANIFEST <span class="se">\</span>
    image-kernel <span class="se">\</span>
    image-rofs <span class="se">\</span>
    image-rwfs <span class="se">\</span>
    image-u-boot
```

</div></div>

### Signing Images

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Generate signing keys (one-time setup)</span>
openssl genrsa <span class="nt">-out</span> private.pem 4096
openssl rsa <span class="nt">-in</span> private.pem <span class="nt">-pubout</span> <span class="nt">-out</span> publickey

<span class="c"># Sign each component</span>
<span class="k">for </span>file <span class="k">in </span>image-kernel image-rofs image-rwfs image-u-boot MANIFEST<span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">do
    </span>openssl dgst <span class="nt">-sha256</span> <span class="nt">-sign</span> private.pem <span class="nt">-out</span> <span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">file</span><span class="k">}</span>.sig <span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">file</span><span class="k">}</span>
<span class="k">done</span>

<span class="c"># Create signed tarball</span>
<span class="nb">tar</span> <span class="nt">-cvf</span> obmc-phosphor-image-signed.tar <span class="se">\</span>
    MANIFEST MANIFEST.sig <span class="se">\</span>
    publickey <span class="se">\</span>
    image-kernel image-kernel.sig <span class="se">\</span>
    image-rofs image-rofs.sig <span class="se">\</span>
    image-rwfs image-rwfs.sig <span class="se">\</span>
    image-u-boot image-u-boot.sig
```

</div></div>
---

## Flash Layout & Storage

    

Understanding flash layout is essential for firmware update operations.

### BMC Flash Layout (ASPEED)

    

Typical ASPEED AST2500/AST2600 flash layout:

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    BMC SPI Flash (32MB/64MB)                     │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Offset      │ Size    │ Name          │ Description              │
├─────────────┼─────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────────────┤
│ 0x00000000  │ 512KB   │ u-boot        │ Bootloader               │
│ 0x00080000  │ 64KB    │ u-boot-env    │ Environment variables    │
│ 0x00090000  │ 448KB   │ <reserved>    │ Future use               │
│ 0x00100000  │ 4MB     │ kernel-a      │ Kernel image A           │
│ 0x00500000  │ 20MB    │ rofs-a        │ Read-only rootfs A       │
│ 0x01900000  │ 4MB     │ kernel-b      │ Kernel image B           │
│ 0x01D00000  │ 20MB    │ rofs-b        │ Read-only rootfs B       │
│ 0x03100000  │ 4MB     │ rwfs          │ Persistent data          │
│ 0x03500000  │ 11MB    │ <reserved>    │ Future use               │
└─────────────┴─────────┴───────────────┴──────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### Static MTD vs UBI Layout

    

OpenBMC supports two flash management strategies:

#### Static MTD Layout

    

Traditional fixed-partition layout:

```bitbake
# In machine .conf
FLASH_SIZE = "32768"  # 32MB in KB

# Partition sizes (KB)
FLASH_UBOOT_OFFSET = "0"
FLASH_UBOOT_ENV_OFFSET = "512"
FLASH_KERNEL_OFFSET = "1024"
FLASH_ROFS_OFFSET = "5120"
FLASH_RWFS_OFFSET = "28160"
```

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># View MTD partitions on target</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /proc/mtd
<span class="c"># dev:    size   erasesize  name</span>
<span class="c"># mtd0: 00080000 00001000 "u-boot"</span>
<span class="c"># mtd1: 00010000 00001000 "u-boot-env"</span>
<span class="c"># mtd2: 00400000 00001000 "kernel"</span>
<span class="c"># mtd3: 01400000 00001000 "rofs"</span>
<span class="c"># mtd4: 00400000 00001000 "rwfs"</span>
```

</div></div>

#### UBI (Unsorted Block Images) Layout

    

Dynamic volume management with wear leveling:

```bitbake
# Enable UBI
IMAGE_FSTYPES += "ubi.mtd"
FLASH_UBI_OVERLAY_SIZE = "4096"  # KB
FLASH_UBI_RWFS_SIZE = "6144"     # KB
```

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># View UBI volumes</span>
ubinfo <span class="nt">-a</span>
<span class="c"># UBI version:                    1</span>
<span class="c"># Volumes count:                  4</span>
<span class="c"># Volume 0: kernel-a</span>
<span class="c"># Volume 1: kernel-b</span>
<span class="c"># Volume 2: rofs-a</span>
<span class="c"># Volume 3: rofs-b</span>

<span class="c"># Detailed volume info</span>
ubinfo /dev/ubi0 <span class="nt">-N</span> rofs-a
```

</div></div>

### Host Flash Layout (Intel/AMD BIOS)

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Host SPI Flash (16MB/32MB)                    │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Region      │ Size    │ Description                              │
├─────────────┼─────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Descriptor  │ 4KB     │ Flash descriptor (regions, permissions)  │
│ BIOS        │ 8-16MB  │ UEFI firmware                            │
│ ME/PSP      │ 2-4MB   │ Intel ME / AMD PSP firmware              │
│ GbE         │ 8KB     │ Ethernet controller config               │
│ Platform    │ Varies  │ Platform-specific data                   │
└─────────────┴─────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>

### OpenPOWER PNOR Layout

    

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    PNOR Flash (64MB/128MB)                       │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Partition   │ Size    │ Description                              │
├─────────────┼─────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ TOC         │ 32KB    │ Table of Contents                        │
│ HBB         │ 1MB     │ Hostboot Base                            │
│ HBI         │ 16MB    │ Hostboot Extended Image                  │
│ HBRT        │ 4MB     │ Hostboot Runtime                         │
│ PAYLOAD     │ 1MB     │ OPAL Skiboot                             │
│ BOOTKERNEL  │ 32MB    │ Linux kernel + initramfs                 │
│ NVRAM       │ 576KB   │ Non-volatile settings                    │
│ GUARD       │ 16KB    │ Hardware guard records                   │
│ RINGOVD     │ 256KB   │ Ring override partition                  │
└─────────────┴─────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div></div>
---

## Setup & Configuration

    

### Build-Time Configuration (Yocto)

    

```bitbake
# In your machine .conf or local.conf

# Include software management
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " \
    phosphor-software-manager \
    phosphor-image-signing \
"

# Configure update options
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt = " \
    -Dfwupd-script=enabled \
    -Dsync-bmc-files=enabled \
    -Dverify-signature=enabled \
    -Dhost-bios-upgrade=enabled \
    -Dusb-code-update=enabled \
"

# Enable image signing
INHERIT += "image_types_phosphor"
IMAGE_TYPES += "static.mtd ubi.mtd"

# Configure flash layout
FLASH_SIZE = "32768"
FLASH_UBOOT_ENV_OFFSET_KB = "512"
FLASH_KERNEL_OFFSET_KB = "1024"

# Dual image support
OBMC_PHOSPHOR_IMAGE_DUAL = "1"
```

### phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt Meson Options

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `verify-signature` | enabled | Require signed firmware |
| `sync-bmc-files` | enabled | Sync critical files between images |
| `fwupd-script` | disabled | Use external update script |
| `host-bios-upgrade` | disabled | Enable BIOS/UEFI updates |
| `usb-code-update` | disabled | Enable USB firmware update |
| `side-switch-on-boot` | disabled | Auto-switch on boot failure |
| `software-update-dbus-interface` | enabled | Expose D-Bus update interface |
| `delete-images` | enabled | Allow image deletion |

</div>

### Configuration Files and Paths

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| Config/Key File | Install Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Signing public key | `/etc/activationdata/OpenBMC/publickey` | Verify image signatures on the BMC |
| Hash type | `/etc/activationdata/OpenBMC/hashfunc` | Hash algorithm (e.g., `RSA-SHA256`) |
| MANIFEST | Inside firmware tarball | Image metadata (version, purpose, machine) |
| Field mode flag | `/var/lib/phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt/field-mode` | When present, restricts update to signed images |

</div>

### Deploying Signing Keys via Yocto

    

To enable signature verification, deploy your public key into the image:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># meta-myplatform/recipes-phosphor/flash/phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt/</span>
<span class="c"># └── files/</span>
<span class="c"># │   ├── publickey        # RSA public key</span>
<span class="c"># │   └── hashfunc         # Contains "RSA-SHA256"</span>
<span class="c"># └── phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt_%.bbappend</span>

<span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="o">></span> phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt_%.bbappend <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="sh">'</span><span class="no">EOF</span><span class="sh">'
FILESEXTRAPATHS:prepend := "</span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">THISDIR</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/files:"
SRC_URI += " </span><span class="se">\</span><span class="sh">
    file://publickey </span><span class="se">\</span><span class="sh">
    file://hashfunc </span><span class="se">\</span><span class="sh">
"

do_install:append() {
    install -d </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">D</span><span class="k">}${</span><span class="nv">sysconfdir</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/activationdata/OpenBMC
    install -m 0444 </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">WORKDIR</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/publickey </span><span class="se">\</span><span class="sh">
        </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">D</span><span class="k">}${</span><span class="nv">sysconfdir</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/activationdata/OpenBMC/
    install -m 0444 </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">WORKDIR</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/hashfunc </span><span class="se">\</span><span class="sh">
        </span><span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">D</span><span class="k">}${</span><span class="nv">sysconfdir</span><span class="k">}</span><span class="sh">/activationdata/OpenBMC/
}
</span><span class="no">EOF
</span>
```

</div></div>

Generate the key pair:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># One-time setup (keep private.pem secure!)</span>
openssl genrsa <span class="nt">-out</span> private.pem 4096
openssl rsa <span class="nt">-in</span> private.pem <span class="nt">-pubout</span> <span class="nt">-out</span> publickey
<span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"RSA-SHA256"</span> <span class="o">></span> hashfunc
```

</div></div>

### Enabling Field Mode

    

Field mode restricts the BMC to only accept signed firmware:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Enable field mode (persists across reboots)</span>
busctl set-property xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/software <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Control.FieldMode FieldModeEnabled b <span class="nb">true</span>

<span class="c"># Verify field mode</span>
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/software <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Control.FieldMode FieldModeEnabled
```

</div></div>

### Runtime Configuration

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check software manager status</span>
systemctl status phosphor-software-manager@bmc
systemctl status phosphor-version-software-manager

<span class="c"># View update logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> phosphor-software-manager@bmc <span class="nt">-f</span>

<span class="c"># Check current firmware versions</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater

<span class="c"># List all software objects</span>
busctl call xyz.openbmc_project.ObjectMapper <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/object_mapper <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.ObjectMapper <span class="se">\</span>
    GetSubTree sias <span class="s2">"/xyz/openbmc_project/software"</span> 0 1 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="s2">"xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Version"</span>
```

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">

<span class="c"># Key interfaces exposed by phosphor-software-manager:</span>

<span class="c"># Software.Activation - Activation state</span>

<span class="c"># Software.RedundancyPriority - Boot priority</span>

## Update Methods

    

OpenBMC supports multiple update interfaces, each with specific use cases.

### Redfish Update Service

    

The primary update method for modern deployments:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Upload firmware image via HttpPushUri</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/octet-stream"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--data-binary</span> @obmc-phosphor-image.tar <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService

<span class="c"># Check UpdateService status</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService

<span class="c"># Response shows update capabilities</span>
<span class="o">{</span>
    <span class="s2">"@odata.id"</span>: <span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/UpdateService"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"HttpPushUri"</span>: <span class="s2">"/redfish/v1/UpdateService"</span>,
    <span class="s2">"HttpPushUriOptions"</span>: <span class="o">{</span>
        <span class="s2">"HttpPushUriApplyTime"</span>: <span class="o">{</span>
            <span class="s2">"ApplyTime"</span>: <span class="s2">"OnReset"</span>
        <span class="o">}</span>
    <span class="o">}</span>,
    <span class="s2">"MaxImageSizeBytes"</span>: 33554432,
    <span class="s2">"ServiceEnabled"</span>: <span class="nb">true</span>
<span class="o">}</span>
```

</div></div>

### SimpleUpdate Action

    

For network-based updates:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Update from TFTP server</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "TransferProtocol": "TFTP",
        "ImageURI": "tftp://192.168.1.100/firmware.tar"
    }'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService/Actions/UpdateService.SimpleUpdate

<span class="c"># Update from HTTPS server</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "TransferProtocol": "HTTPS",
        "ImageURI": "https://server.example.com/firmware.tar"
    }'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService/Actions/UpdateService.SimpleUpdate

<span class="c"># Update from SCP (requires credentials)</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{
        "TransferProtocol": "SCP",
        "ImageURI": "scp://user@server.example.com/path/to/firmware.tar",
        "UserName": "user",
        "Password": "password"
    }'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService/Actions/UpdateService.SimpleUpdate
```

</div></div>

### IPMI OEM Firmware Update

    

Using phosphor-ipmi-flash for IPMI-based updates:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># IPMI OEM firmware update commands (host-side)</span>
<span class="c"># Uses OEM commands to transfer firmware via IPMI</span>

<span class="c"># Start firmware transfer session</span>
ipmitool raw 0x2e 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x01  <span class="c"># OEM start</span>

<span class="c"># Transfer data in chunks (simplified)</span>
ipmitool raw 0x2e 0x01 <offset> <data>  <span class="c"># OEM data</span>

<span class="c"># Finalize and verify</span>
ipmitool raw 0x2e 0x02  <span class="c"># OEM verify</span>

<span class="c"># Activate firmware</span>
ipmitool raw 0x2e 0x03  <span class="c"># OEM activate</span>
```

</div></div>

#### phosphor-ipmi-flash Configuration

    

```bitbake
# Enable IPMI flash support
IMAGE_INSTALL:append = " phosphor-ipmi-flash"

# Configure supported transports
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-phosphor-ipmi-flash = " \
    -Dlpc-type=nuvoton-lpc \
    -Dpci-bridge=true \
"
```

<div class="language-json highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="err">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="err">/usr/share/ipmi-flash/config/config.json</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"handlers"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"handler"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"static"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"path"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"/run/initramfs/image-bmc"</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">],</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="nl">"actions"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"type"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"systemd"</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
            </span><span class="nl">"unit"</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">"phosphor-ipmi-flash-bmc-update.target"</span><span class="w">
        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
    </span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span>
```

</div></div>

### PLDM Firmware Update (Type 5)

    

PLDM Type 5 firmware update for component updates:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Query firmware devices</span>
pldmtool fw_update GetFwParams <span class="nt">-m</span> <eid>

<span class="c"># Request firmware update</span>
pldmtool fw_update RequestUpdate <span class="nt">-m</span> <eid> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--max_transfer_size</span> 4096 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--num_comps</span> 1 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--max_outstanding_transfer_req</span> 2 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--pkg_data_len</span> 0 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_image_set_ver</span> <span class="s2">"1.0.0"</span>

<span class="c"># Pass component table</span>
pldmtool fw_update PassComponentTable <span class="nt">-m</span> <eid> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--transfer_flag</span> 0x05 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_classification</span> 0x0A <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_identifier</span> 0x0001 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_classification_index</span> 0 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_comparison_stamp</span> 0 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_ver</span> <span class="s2">"1.0.0"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_ver_str_type</span> 1 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_ver_str_len</span> 5

<span class="c"># Update component</span>
pldmtool fw_update UpdateComponent <span class="nt">-m</span> <eid> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_classification</span> 0x0A <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_identifier</span> 0x0001 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">--comp_classification_index</span> 0
```

</div></div>

#### PLDM Update Flow

    

```mermaid
---
title: PLDM Update Flow
---
sequenceDiagram
    participant BMC as BMC (pldmd)
    participant Host as Update Agent (Host)

    Host->>BMC: QueryDeviceIdentifiers
    BMC->>Host: DeviceIdentifiers

    Host->>BMC: GetFirmwareParameters
    BMC->>Host: FirmwareParameters

    Host->>BMC: RequestUpdate
    BMC->>Host: RequestUpdateResp (ACK)

    Host->>BMC: PassComponentTable
    BMC->>Host: PassComponentTableResp

    Host->>BMC: UpdateComponent
    BMC->>Host: UpdateComponentResp

    loop Data Transfer
        BMC->>Host: RequestFirmwareData
        Host->>BMC: FirmwareData
    end

    BMC->>Host: TransferComplete
    Host->>BMC: TransferCompleteResp

    BMC->>Host: VerifyComplete
    Host->>BMC: VerifyCompleteResp

    BMC->>Host: ApplyComplete
    Host->>BMC: ApplyCompleteResp

    Host->>BMC: ActivateFirmware
    BMC->>Host: ActivateFirmwareResp
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────┐                    ┌────────────────┐
│    BMC     │                    │  Update Agent  │
│  (pldmd)   │                    │    (Host)      │
└─────┬──────┘                    └───────┬────────┘
      │                                   │
      │      QueryDeviceIdentifiers       │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │      DeviceIdentifiers            │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
      │                                   │
      │      GetFirmwareParameters        │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │      FirmwareParameters           │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
      │                                   │
      │      RequestUpdate                │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │      RequestUpdateResp (ACK)      │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
      │                                   │
      │      PassComponentTable           │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │      PassComponentTableResp       │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
      │                                   │
      │      UpdateComponent              │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │      UpdateComponentResp          │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
      │                                   │
      │      RequestFirmwareData (loop)   │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
      │      FirmwareData                 │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │                                   │
      │      TransferComplete             │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
      │      TransferCompleteResp         │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │                                   │
      │      VerifyComplete               │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
      │      VerifyCompleteResp           │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │                                   │
      │      ApplyComplete                │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
      │      ApplyCompleteResp            │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │                                   │
      │      ActivateFirmware             │
      │<──────────────────────────────────│
      │      ActivateFirmwareResp         │
      │──────────────────────────────────>│
```

</div>  </div>

### WebUI Update

    

1. Login to WebUI at `https:///`
2. Navigate to **Operations** → **Firmware**
3. Click **Upload firmware**
4. Select firmware file (`.tar` format)
5. Wait for upload and verification
6. Click **Activate** when ready
7. Optionally select **Reboot BMC after activation**

### USB Code Update

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># USB code update directory structure:</span>
<span class="c"># /mnt/usb/<usb-device>/</span>
<span class="c"># └── firmware/</span>
<span class="c">#     └── image-bmc               # Firmware tarball (renamed)</span>

<span class="c"># BMC-side: Check for USB device</span>
lsblk
<span class="c"># NAME   MAJ:MIN RM  SIZE RO TYPE MOUNTPOINT</span>
<span class="c"># sda      8:0    1  7.5G  0 disk</span>
<span class="c"># └─sda1   8:1    1  7.5G  0 part /media/usb</span>

<span class="c"># Configuration in Yocto</span>
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt:append <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">" -Dusb-code-update=enabled"</span>

<span class="c"># USB monitor service watches for:</span>
<span class="c"># - USB insertion events</span>
<span class="c"># - Files matching firmware pattern</span>
<span class="c"># - Triggers automatic update if policy allows</span>
```

</div></div>

### Command-Line Update Tools

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Direct flash update (recovery only)</span>
<span class="c"># WARNING: Use only for recovery, bypasses safety checks</span>

<span class="c"># Backup current image first</span>
<span class="nb">dd </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="o">=</span>/dev/mtd0 <span class="nv">of</span><span class="o">=</span>/tmp/backup-kernel.bin
<span class="nb">dd </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="o">=</span>/dev/mtd1 <span class="nv">of</span><span class="o">=</span>/tmp/backup-rofs.bin

<span class="c"># Flash new image</span>
flashcp <span class="nt">-v</span> /tmp/image-kernel /dev/mtd0
flashcp <span class="nt">-v</span> /tmp/image-rofs /dev/mtd1

<span class="c"># For UBI volumes</span>
ubiupdatevol /dev/ubi0_0 /tmp/image-kernel
ubiupdatevol /dev/ubi0_1 /tmp/image-rofs
```

</div></div>

## Dual Image Support

    

OpenBMC implements A/B redundant boot for high availability.

Newer phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt builds ship a `side-switch` utility that compares
the running image’s priority against every available image; if a higher-priority
image exists it powers the host off, arms a one-time auto-power-on, and reboots
the BMC so it comes up on the preferred side. Image signature verification
(`Signature`, OpenSSL) can additionally enforce **post-quantum** algorithms and a
**Minimum Ship Level (MSL)** check that blocks flashing a version below a
configured baseline. (Verify against your phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt version.)

### Dual Image Architecture

    

```mermaid
---
title: Dual Image Architecture - BMC SPI Flash
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph shared["Shared"]
        direction LR
        uboot["U-Boot  
(shared)"]
        ubootenv["U-Boot Env  
(shared)"]
        rwfs["Persistent Data  
(rwfs)"]
    end

    subgraph images[" "]
        direction LR
        subgraph imageA["Image A (Active)"]
            kernelA["kernel-a  
(FIT image)"]
            rofsA["rofs-a  
(SquashFS)"]
            versionA["Version: 2.12.0  
Priority: 0 (boot)"]
        end
        subgraph imageB["Image B (Standby)"]
            kernelB["kernel-b  
(FIT image)"]
            rofsB["rofs-b  
(SquashFS)"]
            versionB["Version: 2.11.0  
Priority: 1 (standby)"]
        end
    end

    shared --- images

    style images fill:none,stroke:none
```

## U-Boot Environment & Boot Control

    

### Key U-Boot Environment Variables

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># View all U-Boot environment variables</span>
fw_printenv

<span class="c"># Key variables for firmware update:</span>

<span class="c"># bootside - Which image to boot (a or b)</span>
fw_printenv bootside
<span class="c"># bootside=a</span>

<span class="c"># bootcount - Boot attempt counter</span>
fw_printenv bootcount
<span class="c"># bootcount=0</span>

<span class="c"># bootlimit - Max boot attempts before fallback</span>
fw_printenv bootlimit
<span class="c"># bootlimit=3</span>

<span class="c"># kernelname - Kernel partition name</span>
fw_printenv kernelname
<span class="c"># kernelname=kernel-a</span>

<span class="c"># rofsname - Root filesystem partition</span>
fw_printenv rofsname
<span class="c"># rofsname=rofs-a</span>
```

</div></div>

### U-Boot Boot Logic

    

```mermaid
---
title: U-Boot Boot Flow
---
flowchart TB
    step1["1. Read bootside (a or b)"]
    step2["2. Increment bootcount"]
    step3{"3. bootcount > bootlimit?"}
    switch["Switch bootside  
Reset bootcount  
Retry boot"]
    step4["4. Load kernel from bootside"]
    step5["5. Boot Linux"]
    step6["6. User-space resets bootcount to 0  
(via init script or systemd service)"]

    step1 --> step2
    step2 --> step3
    step3 -->|Yes| switch
    switch --> step1
    step3 -->|No| step4
    step4 --> step5
    step5 --> step6
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    U-Boot Boot Flow                           │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                               │
│  1. Read bootside (a or b)                                    │
│           │                                                   │
│           ▼                                                   │
│  2. Increment bootcount                                       │
│           │                                                   │
│           ▼                                                   │
│  3. bootcount > bootlimit?  ───Yes──► Switch bootside         │
│           │                           Reset bootcount         │
│          No                           Retry boot              │
│           │                                                   │
│           ▼                                                   │
│  4. Load kernel from bootside                                 │
│           │                                                   │
│           ▼                                                   │
│  5. Boot Linux                                                │
│           │                                                   │
│           ▼                                                   │
│  6. User-space resets bootcount to 0                          │
│           (via init script or systemd service)                │
│                                                               │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div>  </div>

### Manual Boot Control

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Force boot from specific side</span>
fw_setenv bootside b
reboot

<span class="c"># Reset boot counter (call after successful boot)</span>
fw_setenv bootcount 0

<span class="c"># Increase boot limit for debugging</span>
fw_setenv bootlimit 5

<span class="c"># One-time boot override (doesn't change bootside)</span>
fw_setenv bootonce b
reboot

<span class="c"># View boot arguments</span>
fw_printenv bootargs
<span class="c"># bootargs=console=ttyS4,115200 root=/dev/mtdblock3 rootfstype=squashfs</span>
```

</div></div>

### Recovery via Serial Console

    

If boot fails and you have serial access:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># At U-Boot prompt (interrupt boot with key press)</span>
<span class="o">=></span> <span class="nb">printenv </span>bootside
<span class="nv">bootside</span><span class="o">=</span>a

<span class="c"># Switch to other image</span>
<span class="o">=></span> setenv bootside b
<span class="o">=></span> saveenv
<span class="o">=></span> reset

<span class="c"># Or boot directly without saving</span>
<span class="o">=></span> setenv bootside b
<span class="o">=></span> run bootcmd
```

</div></div>

## Failsafe Behavior

    

### Automatic Boot Fallback

    

```mermaid
---
title: Boot Failure Recovery
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph attempt1["Boot Attempt 1 (Image A)"]
        direction LR
        a1s["Success → bootcount = 0, run normally"]
        a1f["Fail → bootcount++"]
    end

    subgraph attempt2["Boot Attempt 2 (Image A)"]
        direction LR
        a2s["Success → bootcount = 0"]
        a2f["Fail → bootcount++ (now 2)"]
    end

    subgraph attempt3["Boot Attempt 3 (Image A)"]
        direction LR
        a3s["Success → bootcount = 0"]
        a3f["Fail → bootcount++ (now 3)  
Switch bootside to B  
Reset bootcount to 0"]
    end

    subgraph attempt4["Boot Attempt 4 (Image B)"]
        direction LR
        a4s["Success → bootcount = 0, run from backup"]
        a4f["Fail → bootcount++"]
    end

    cont["... continues alternating ..."]

    attempt1 --> attempt2 --> attempt3 --> attempt4 --> cont
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  Boot Failure Recovery                         │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                │
│  Boot Attempt 1 (Image A)                                      │
│     ├─ Success → bootcount = 0, run normally                   │
│     └─ Fail → bootcount++                                      │
│                                                                │
│  Boot Attempt 2 (Image A)                                      │
│     ├─ Success → bootcount = 0                                 │
│     └─ Fail → bootcount++ (now 2)                              │
│                                                                │
│  Boot Attempt 3 (Image A)                                      │
│     ├─ Success → bootcount = 0                                 │
│     └─ Fail → bootcount++ (now 3, equals bootlimit)            │
│               Switch bootside to B                             │
│               Reset bootcount to 0                             │
│                                                                │
│  Boot Attempt 4 (Image B)                                      │
│     ├─ Success → bootcount = 0, run from backup                │
│     └─ Fail → bootcount++                                      │
│                                                                │
│  ... continues alternating ...                                 │
│                                                                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div>  </div>

### Boot Health Check Service

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># phosphor-software-manager runs boot health check</span>
<span class="c"># On successful boot, clears boot counter</span>

<span class="c"># Check service status</span>
systemctl status obmc-flash-bmc-setenv@bootcount

<span class="c"># Manual reset</span>
fw_setenv bootcount 0

<span class="c"># View boot health log</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> obmc-flash-bmc-setenv@bootcount
```

</div></div>

### Recovery Mode

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Force recovery to backup image</span>
fw_setenv bootside b
reboot

<span class="c"># Emergency: Use U-Boot to load recovery image from TFTP</span>
<span class="c"># At U-Boot prompt:</span>
<span class="o">=></span> setenv serverip 192.168.1.100
<span class="o">=></span> setenv ipaddr 192.168.1.50
<span class="o">=></span> tftp 0x83000000 recovery-image.bin
<span class="o">=></span> bootm 0x83000000

<span class="c"># Full factory recovery via static.mtd image</span>
<span class="c"># At U-Boot prompt:</span>
<span class="o">=></span> sf probe
<span class="o">=></span> tftp 0x83000000 obmc-phosphor-image.static.mtd
<span class="o">=></span> sf update 0x83000000 0x0 <span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">filesize</span><span class="k">}</span>
<span class="o">=></span> reset
```

### Signing Infrastructure Overview

### Generate Signing Keys

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Create 4096-bit RSA keypair for production</span>
openssl genrsa <span class="nt">-out</span> private.pem 4096
openssl rsa <span class="nt">-in</span> private.pem <span class="nt">-pubout</span> <span class="nt">-out</span> publickey

<span class="c"># Create self-signed certificate (for key identification)</span>
openssl req <span class="nt">-new</span> <span class="nt">-x509</span> <span class="nt">-key</span> private.pem <span class="nt">-out</span> cert.pem <span class="nt">-days</span> 3650 <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-subj</span> <span class="s2">"/CN=OpenBMC Firmware Signing/O=My Organization"</span>

<span class="c"># View key information</span>
openssl rsa <span class="nt">-in</span> publickey <span class="nt">-pubin</span> <span class="nt">-text</span> <span class="nt">-noout</span>

<span class="c"># For development/testing (weaker key)</span>
openssl genrsa <span class="nt">-out</span> dev-private.pem 2048
openssl rsa <span class="nt">-in</span> dev-private.pem <span class="nt">-pubout</span> <span class="nt">-out</span> dev-publickey
```

</div></div>

### Sign Firmware Components

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Sign each component with SHA-256 RSA signature</span>
<span class="k">for </span>file <span class="k">in </span>MANIFEST image-kernel image-rofs image-rwfs image-u-boot<span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">do
    if</span> <span class="o">[</span> <span class="nt">-f</span> <span class="s2">"</span><span class="nv">$file</span><span class="s2">"</span> <span class="o">]</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">then
        </span>openssl dgst <span class="nt">-sha256</span> <span class="nt">-sign</span> private.pem <span class="nt">-out</span> <span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">file</span><span class="k">}</span>.sig <span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">file</span><span class="k">}</span>
        <span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"Signed: </span><span class="nv">$file</span><span class="s2">"</span>
    <span class="k">fi
done</span>

<span class="c"># Create MANIFEST with signature metadata</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> <span class="o">></span> MANIFEST <span class="o"><<</span> <span class="sh">'</span><span class="no">EOF</span><span class="sh">'
purpose=xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Version.VersionPurpose.BMC
version=2.12.0
MachineName=romulus
KeyType=OpenBMC
HashType=RSA-SHA256
</span><span class="no">EOF

</span><span class="c"># Sign the MANIFEST itself</span>
openssl dgst <span class="nt">-sha256</span> <span class="nt">-sign</span> private.pem <span class="nt">-out</span> MANIFEST.sig MANIFEST

<span class="c"># Create signed tarball</span>
<span class="nb">tar</span> <span class="nt">-cvf</span> obmc-phosphor-image-signed.tar <span class="se">\</span>
    MANIFEST MANIFEST.sig <span class="se">\</span>
    publickey <span class="se">\</span>
    image-kernel image-kernel.sig <span class="se">\</span>
    image-rofs image-rofs.sig <span class="se">\</span>
    image-rwfs image-rwfs.sig <span class="se">\</span>
    image-u-boot image-u-boot.sig
```

</div></div>

### Configure Verification in Yocto

    

```bitbake
# In your distro or local.conf

# Enable signature verification
EXTRA_OEMESON:pn-phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt:append = " -Dverify-signature=enabled"

# Configure public key provider
PREFERRED_PROVIDER_virtual/phosphor-software-manager-system-public-key = \
    "phosphor-software-manager-public-key-${MACHINE}"

# Key installation location
# Keys installed to: /etc/activationdata/

# Custom key type name
SIGNING_KEY_TYPE = "OpenBMC"
```

Create a recipe for your public key:

```bitbake
# meta-mymachine/recipes-phosphor/software/phosphor-software-manager-public-key-mymachine.bb

SUMMARY = "Public key for firmware verification"
LICENSE = "Apache-2.0"
LIC_FILES_CHKSUM = "file://${COREBASE}/meta/files/common-licenses/Apache-2.0;md5=..."

inherit allarch

SRC_URI = "file://publickey"

do_install() {
    install -d ${D}${sysconfdir}/activationdata
    install -m 0644 ${WORKDIR}/publickey \
        ${D}${sysconfdir}/activationdata/key-OpenBMC
}

FILES:${PN} = "${sysconfdir}/activationdata"

RPROVIDES:${PN} = "virtual/phosphor-software-manager-system-public-key"
```

### Verification Flow

    

```mermaid
---
title: Signature Verification Flow
---
flowchart TB
    step1["1. Upload firmware tarball"]
    step2["2. Extract to /tmp/images/random-id/"]
    step3["3. Parse MANIFEST  
- Read KeyType → OpenBMC  
- Read HashType → RSA-SHA256  
- Validate MachineName"]
    step4{"4. Load public key from  
/etc/activationdata/key-KeyType"}
    reject1["REJECT  
(unless verify-signature=disabled)"]
    step5["5. Verify MANIFEST signature  
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify"]
    step6["6. Verify each component signature  
- image-kernel  
- image-rofs  
- image-rwfs  
- image-u-boot"]
    step7{"7. All signatures valid?"}
    accept["Proceed with activation"]
    reject2["REJECT, log error,  
delete extracted files"]

    step1 --> step2 --> step3 --> step4
    step4 -->|Key not found| reject1
    step4 -->|Key found| step5
    step5 --> step6 --> step7
    step7 -->|Yes| accept
    step7 -->|No| reject2
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   Signature Verification Flow                            │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                          │
│  1. Upload firmware tarball                                              │
│           │                                                              │
│           ▼                                                              │
│  2. Extract to /tmp/images/<random-id>/                                  │
│           │                                                              │
│           ▼                                                              │
│  3. Parse MANIFEST                                                       │
│     ├─ Read KeyType → "OpenBMC"                                          │
│     ├─ Read HashType → "RSA-SHA256"                                      │
│     └─ Read MachineName → validate against current machine               │
│           │                                                              │
│           ▼                                                              │
│  4. Load public key from /etc/activationdata/key-<KeyType>               │
│     └─ If key not found → REJECT (unless verify-signature=disabled)      │
│           │                                                              │
│           ▼                                                              │
│  5. Verify MANIFEST signature                                            │
│     └─ openssl dgst -sha256 -verify 
-signature MANIFEST.sig     │
│           │                                                              │
│           ▼                                                              │
│  6. Verify each component signature                                      │
│     ├─ image-kernel.sig vs image-kernel                                  │
│     ├─ image-rofs.sig vs image-rofs                                      │
│     ├─ image-rwfs.sig vs image-rwfs                                      │
│     └─ image-u-boot.sig vs image-u-boot                                  │
│           │                                                              │
│           ▼                                                              │
│  7. All signatures valid?                                                │
│     ├─ Yes → Proceed with activation                                     │
│     └─ No → REJECT, log error, delete extracted files                    │
│                                                                          │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

  

### Manual Signature Verification

    

```
# On the BMC, manually verify an image

# Extract tarball
mkdir -p /tmp/verify-test
cd /tmp/verify-test
tar -xvf /tmp/firmware.tar

# Check MANIFEST
cat MANIFEST

# Verify MANIFEST signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify /etc/activationdata/key-OpenBMC \
    -signature MANIFEST.sig MANIFEST

# Verify component signatures
for file in image-kernel image-rofs image-rwfs image-u-boot; do
    if [ -f "$file" ] && [ -f "${file}.sig" ]; then
        echo -n "Verifying $file: "
        openssl dgst -sha256 -verify /etc/activationdata/key-OpenBMC \
            -signature ${file}.sig ${file}
    fi
done
```

### Signature Verification Logs

    

```
# Check verification results
journalctl -u phosphor-software-manager | grep -i -E "(signature|verify|key)"

# Example output for successful verification:
# phosphor-software-manager[1234]: Signature verification passed for image abc12345
# phosphor-software-manager[1234]: Image abc12345 is valid

# Example output for failed verification:
# phosphor-software-manager[1234]: Signature verification failed for MANIFEST
# phosphor-software-manager[1234]: Error: Invalid signature
# phosphor-software-manager[1234]: Rejecting image def67890
```

### Key Type Configuration

    

Support multiple key types for different environments:

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># /etc/activationdata/ structure</span>
/etc/activationdata/
├── key-OpenBMC           <span class="c"># Development keys</span>
├── key-ProductionKey     <span class="c"># Production keys</span>
└── key-TestKey           <span class="c"># Test/staging keys</span>

<span class="c"># MANIFEST selects which key to use:</span>
<span class="c"># KeyType=ProductionKey → uses /etc/activationdata/key-ProductionKey</span>
```

</div></div>

## Update Workflow Deep Dive

    

### Complete Update Sequence

    

```mermaid
---
title: Firmware Update Workflow
---
flowchart TB
    subgraph upload["1. UPLOAD"]
        u1["Receive via Redfish/IPMI/PLDM"]
        u2["Store in /tmp/images/random-id/"]
        u3["Create Software.Version D-Bus object"]
    end

    subgraph extract["2. EXTRACT & PARSE"]
        e1["Extract tarball contents"]
        e2["Parse MANIFEST file"]
        e3["Validate MachineName"]
        e4["Check version purpose"]
    end

    subgraph verify["3. VERIFY (if enabled)"]
        v1["Load public key"]
        v2["Verify MANIFEST signature"]
        v3["Verify component signatures"]
        v4["REJECT if any fails"]
    end

    subgraph ready["4. READY"]
        r1["Set Activation = Ready"]
        r2["Create RedundancyPriority"]
        r3["Wait for activation"]
    end

    subgraph activating["5. ACTIVATING"]
        a1["Set Activation = Activating"]
        a2["Erase standby partition"]
        a3["Write images to flash"]
        a4["Update U-Boot variables"]
    end

    subgraph active["6. ACTIVE"]
        ac1["Set Activation = Active"]
        ac2["Set Priority = 0"]
        ac3["Optional: trigger reboot"]
    end

    subgraph postverify["7. VERIFY (post-reboot)"]
        p1["Boot new image"]
        p2["Reset bootcount to 0"]
        p3["Log successful update"]
    end

    upload --> extract --> verify --> ready --> activating --> active --> postverify
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        Firmware Update Workflow                             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                             │
│  1. UPLOAD                                                                  │
│     ├─ Receive via Redfish/IPMI/PLDM                                        │
│     ├─ Store in /tmp/images/<random-id>/                                    │
│     └─ Create Software.Version D-Bus object                                 │
│                                                                             │
│  2. EXTRACT & PARSE                                                         │
│     ├─ Extract tarball contents                                             │
│     ├─ Parse MANIFEST file                                                  │
│     ├─ Validate MachineName against current machine                         │
│     └─ Check version purpose (BMC/Host/System)                              │
│                                                                             │
│  3. VERIFY (if signature verification enabled)                              │
│     ├─ Load public key from /etc/activationdata/key-<KeyType>               │
│     ├─ Verify MANIFEST signature                                            │
│     ├─ Verify each component signature                                      │
│     └─ REJECT if any verification fails                                     │
│                                                                             │
│  4. READY                                                                   │
│     ├─ Set Activation = Ready                                               │
│     ├─ Create RedundancyPriority interface                                  │
│     └─ Wait for activation request                                          │
│                                                                             │
│  5. ACTIVATING                                                              │
│     ├─ Set Activation = Activating                                          │
│     ├─ Lock flash access                                                    │
│     ├─ Erase standby partition                                              │
│     ├─ Write image-kernel to kernel partition                               │
│     ├─ Write image-rofs to rofs partition                                   │
│     ├─ Write image-rwfs to rwfs partition (if present)                      │
│     └─ Update U-Boot variables                                              │
│                                                                             │
│  6. ACTIVE                                                                  │
│     ├─ Set Activation = Active                                              │
│     ├─ Set Priority = 0 (primary)                                           │
│     ├─ Demote previous image priority                                       │
│     └─ Optional: trigger reboot                                             │
│                                                                             │
│  7. VERIFY (post-reboot)                                                    │
│     ├─ Boot new image                                                       │
│     ├─ Reset bootcount to 0                                                 │
│     └─ Log successful update                                                │
│                                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div>  </div>

### Activation States

    

<div class="table-wrapper">
| State | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NotReady` | Image uploaded but not yet processed |
| `Invalid` | Image validation failed |
| `Ready` | Image verified, waiting for activation |
| `Activating` | Write in progress to flash |
| `Active` | Image is installed and bootable |
| `Failed` | Activation failed |

</div>

## Troubleshooting

    

### Upload Fails

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check available space in /tmp</span>
<span class="nb">df</span> <span class="nt">-h</span> /tmp
<span class="c"># Minimum required: image size + extraction overhead (~2x image size)</span>

<span class="c"># Check bmcweb body size limit</span>
<span class="c"># Default is typically 30MB, configurable in bmcweb</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /etc/bmcweb_persistent_data.json | jq .http_body_limit

<span class="c"># Verify tarball integrity</span>
file firmware.tar
<span class="c"># firmware.tar: POSIX tar archive (GNU)</span>

<span class="nb">tar</span> <span class="nt">-tvf</span> firmware.tar
<span class="c"># -rw-r--r-- 0/0     123 2024-01-15 10:00 MANIFEST</span>
<span class="c"># -rw-r--r-- 0/0 4194304 2024-01-15 10:00 image-kernel</span>
<span class="c"># -rw-r--r-- 0/0 20971520 2024-01-15 10:00 image-rofs</span>

<span class="c"># Check for required files</span>
<span class="nb">tar</span> <span class="nt">-tf</span> firmware.tar | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-E</span> <span class="s2">"^(MANIFEST|image-)"</span>

<span class="c"># Common upload errors:</span>
<span class="c"># - "413 Request Entity Too Large" → Image too big</span>
<span class="c"># - "503 Service Unavailable" → Service overloaded</span>
<span class="c"># - Connection reset → Timeout or memory issue</span>
```

</div></div>

### Signature Verification Failed

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check installed public keys</span>
<span class="nb">ls</span> <span class="nt">-la</span> /etc/activationdata/
<span class="c"># -rw-r--r-- 1 root root 800 Jan 15 10:00 key-OpenBMC</span>

<span class="c"># Check MANIFEST KeyType matches installed key</span>
<span class="nb">tar</span> <span class="nt">-xOf</span> firmware.tar MANIFEST | <span class="nb">grep </span>KeyType
<span class="c"># KeyType=OpenBMC</span>
<span class="c"># → Needs /etc/activationdata/key-OpenBMC</span>

<span class="c"># Verify signature manually</span>
<span class="nb">cd</span> /tmp
<span class="nb">tar</span> <span class="nt">-xf</span> firmware.tar
openssl dgst <span class="nt">-sha256</span> <span class="nt">-verify</span> /etc/activationdata/key-OpenBMC <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-signature</span> MANIFEST.sig MANIFEST
<span class="c"># Verified OK  or  Verification Failure</span>

<span class="c"># Common signature errors:</span>
<span class="c"># - "Public key not found" → Missing key file</span>
<span class="c"># - "Verification Failure" → Wrong key or corrupted signature</span>
<span class="c"># - "HashType mismatch" → MANIFEST HashType doesn't match key</span>
```

</div></div>

### Machine Name Mismatch

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check current machine name</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /etc/os-release | <span class="nb">grep </span>OPENBMC_TARGET_MACHINE
<span class="c"># OPENBMC_TARGET_MACHINE=romulus</span>

<span class="c"># Check MANIFEST MachineName</span>
<span class="nb">tar</span> <span class="nt">-xOf</span> firmware.tar MANIFEST | <span class="nb">grep </span>MachineName
<span class="c"># MachineName=romulus</span>

<span class="c"># If mismatch, image is rejected</span>
<span class="c"># Error: "Machine name doesn't match"</span>
```

</div></div>

### Boot Fails After Update

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Via serial console, check for:</span>
<span class="c"># - Kernel panic</span>
<span class="c"># - Filesystem mount failure</span>
<span class="c"># - Init system failure</span>

<span class="c"># Check U-Boot boot counter</span>
fw_printenv bootcount
<span class="c"># If > 0, boot had issues</span>

<span class="c"># Force boot to backup image</span>
fw_setenv bootside b
fw_setenv bootcount 0
reboot

<span class="c"># Or at U-Boot prompt:</span>
<span class="o">=></span> setenv bootside b
<span class="o">=></span> saveenv
<span class="o">=></span> reset

<span class="c"># If both images fail, use TFTP recovery:</span>
<span class="o">=></span> setenv serverip 192.168.1.100
<span class="o">=></span> setenv ipaddr 192.168.1.50
<span class="o">=></span> tftp 0x80000000 obmc-phosphor-image.static.mtd
<span class="o">=></span> sf probe
<span class="o">=></span> sf update 0x80000000 0 <span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">filesize</span><span class="k">}</span>
<span class="o">=></span> reset
```

</div></div>

### Image Not Activating

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check activation state</span>
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/software/<<span class="nb">id</span><span class="o">></span> <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Activation Activation

<span class="c"># States:</span>
<span class="c"># NotReady - Still processing</span>
<span class="c"># Invalid - Validation failed</span>
<span class="c"># Ready - Can be activated</span>
<span class="c"># Activating - In progress</span>
<span class="c"># Active - Successfully activated</span>
<span class="c"># Failed - Activation failed</span>

<span class="c"># Check for activation blockers</span>
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/software/<<span class="nb">id</span><span class="o">></span> <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Activation RequestedActivation

<span class="c"># View detailed logs</span>
journalctl <span class="nt">-u</span> phosphor-software-manager@bmc <span class="nt">--since</span> <span class="s2">"5 minutes ago"</span>

<span class="c"># Common activation issues:</span>
<span class="c"># - Flash busy/locked</span>
<span class="c"># - Insufficient space</span>
<span class="c"># - Filesystem corruption</span>
<span class="c"># - Service crash during write</span>
```

</div></div>

### Flash Write Errors

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check MTD device status</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /proc/mtd
mtd_debug info /dev/mtd0

<span class="c"># Check for bad blocks (UBI)</span>
ubinfo <span class="nt">-a</span>
<span class="nb">cat</span> /sys/class/ubi/ubi0/bad_peb_count

<span class="c"># Manual flash test (DESTRUCTIVE)</span>
<span class="c"># flashcp -v /dev/zero /dev/mtd0  # DO NOT RUN in production</span>

<span class="c"># Check for flash busy</span>
flock <span class="nt">-n</span> /run/lock/bmc_flash.lock <span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"Flash not locked"</span>
<span class="c"># If no output, flash is locked by another process</span>

<span class="c"># View flash operations</span>
journalctl | <span class="nb">grep</span> <span class="nt">-i</span> <span class="s2">"mtd</span><span class="se">\|</span><span class="s2">flash</span><span class="se">\|</span><span class="s2">ubi"</span>
```

</div></div>

### Activation Progress Stuck

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Check if activation is stuck at specific percentage</span>
busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/software/<<span class="nb">id</span><span class="o">></span> <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Software.ActivationProgress Progress

<span class="c"># Stuck at 0%: MANIFEST parsing or signature verification</span>
<span class="c"># Stuck at 20%: Flash erase</span>
<span class="c"># Stuck at 50%: Flash write</span>
<span class="c"># Stuck at 90%: Finalization</span>

<span class="c"># Check for service crash</span>
systemctl status phosphor-software-manager@bmc
<span class="c"># If failed, restart and retry</span>

<span class="c"># Force cleanup and retry</span>
<span class="nb">rm</span> <span class="nt">-rf</span> /tmp/images/<span class="k">*</span>
systemctl restart phosphor-software-manager@bmc
```

</div></div>

### Delete Failed/Stale Images

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># List all software objects</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater

<span class="c"># Delete specific image via D-Bus</span>
busctl call xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/software/<<span class="nb">id</span><span class="o">></span> <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Object.Delete Delete

<span class="c"># Or via Redfish</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> DELETE <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory/<<span class="nb">id</span><span class="o">></span>

<span class="c"># Clean up /tmp/images manually if needed</span>
<span class="nb">rm</span> <span class="nt">-rf</span> /tmp/images/<<span class="nb">id</span><span class="o">></span>
```

### Network Update Issues

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">

## Rollback

    

### Rollback via D-Bus

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># List all images to find backup ID</span>
busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater

<span class="c"># Get version info for each image</span>
<span class="k">for </span>obj <span class="k">in</span> <span class="si">$(</span>busctl tree xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="nt">--list</span> | <span class="nb">grep </span>software/<span class="si">)</span><span class="p">;</span> <span class="k">do
    </span><span class="nb">echo</span> <span class="s2">"=== </span><span class="nv">$obj</span><span class="s2"> ==="</span>
    busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
        <span class="s2">"</span><span class="nv">$obj</span><span class="s2">"</span> xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Version Version 2>/dev/null
    busctl get-property xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
        <span class="s2">"</span><span class="nv">$obj</span><span class="s2">"</span> xyz.openbmc_project.Software.RedundancyPriority Priority 2>/dev/null
<span class="k">done</span>

<span class="c"># Activate backup image (set as primary)</span>
busctl call xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/software/<backup_id> <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Activation <span class="se">\</span>
    RequestedActivation s <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="s2">"xyz.openbmc_project.Software.Activation.RequestedActivations.Active"</span>

<span class="c"># Or set priority directly (0 = primary)</span>
busctl set-property xyz.openbmc_project.Software.BMC.Updater <span class="se">\</span>
    /xyz/openbmc_project/software/<backup_id> <span class="se">\</span>
    xyz.openbmc_project.Software.RedundancyPriority <span class="se">\</span>
    Priority u 0

<span class="c"># Reboot BMC to activate</span>
obmcutil bmcreboot
```

</div></div>

### Rollback via Redfish

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># List all firmware inventory</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory | jq

<span class="c"># Find backup image (non-active BMC image)</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory/<backup_id>

<span class="c"># Activate backup (method varies by implementation)</span>
<span class="c"># Some implementations use PATCH:</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> PATCH <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"Status": {"State": "Enabled"}}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory/<backup_id>

<span class="c"># Others use Actions:</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory/<backup_id>/Actions/SoftwareInventory.Activate

<span class="c"># Reboot via Redfish</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"ResetType": "GracefulRestart"}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/Actions/Manager.Reset
```

</div></div>

### Rollback via U-Boot

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># If Linux is accessible, use fw_setenv</span>
fw_setenv bootside b
reboot

<span class="c"># At U-Boot prompt (serial console)</span>
<span class="o">=></span> <span class="nb">printenv </span>bootside
<span class="nv">bootside</span><span class="o">=</span>a
<span class="o">=></span> setenv bootside b
<span class="o">=></span> saveenv
<span class="o">=></span> reset
```

</div></div>

## Factory Reset

    

### Reset BMC Configuration

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Via Redfish - reset to factory defaults</span>
curl <span class="nt">-k</span> <span class="nt">-u</span> root:0penBmc <span class="nt">-X</span> POST <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-H</span> <span class="s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    <span class="nt">-d</span> <span class="s1">'{"ResetType": "ResetAll"}'</span> <span class="se">\</span>
    https://localhost/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/Actions/Manager.ResetToDefaults

<span class="c"># Reset types:</span>
<span class="c"># - ResetAll: Reset all settings to factory defaults</span>
<span class="c"># - PreserveNetworkAndUsers: Keep network and user settings</span>
<span class="c"># - PreserveNetwork: Keep only network settings</span>
```

</div></div>

### Clear Persistent Data

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Clear read-write filesystem (preserves firmware)</span>
<span class="c"># WARNING: Loses all BMC configuration</span>

<span class="c"># Method 1: Via systemd</span>
systemctl start obmc-factory-reset.target

<span class="c"># Method 2: Manual (requires reboot)</span>
<span class="nb">rm</span> <span class="nt">-rf</span> /var/lib/<span class="k">*</span>
<span class="nb">rm</span> <span class="nt">-rf</span> /etc/machine-id
reboot

<span class="c"># Method 3: Via U-Boot (most thorough)</span>
<span class="c"># At U-Boot prompt:</span>
<span class="o">=></span> setenv openbmconce factory-reset
<span class="o">=></span> saveenv
<span class="o">=></span> reset
<span class="c"># BMC will clear rwfs on next boot</span>
```

</div></div>

### Full Flash Recovery

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># Complete flash re-image (via TFTP and U-Boot)</span>
<span class="c"># WARNING: Erases EVERYTHING</span>

<span class="c"># At U-Boot prompt:</span>
<span class="o">=></span> setenv serverip 192.168.1.100
<span class="o">=></span> setenv ipaddr 192.168.1.50
<span class="o">=></span> setenv netmask 255.255.255.0

<span class="c"># Download full image</span>
<span class="o">=></span> tftp 0x80000000 obmc-phosphor-image.static.mtd

<span class="c"># Probe SPI flash</span>
<span class="o">=></span> sf probe

<span class="c"># Erase and write entire flash</span>
<span class="o">=></span> sf erase 0 0x2000000  <span class="c"># Adjust size for your flash</span>
<span class="o">=></span> sf write 0x80000000 0 <span class="k">${</span><span class="nv">filesize</span><span class="k">}</span>

<span class="c"># Reset</span>
<span class="o">=></span> reset
```

</div></div>

## Security Considerations

    

### Secure Boot Chain

    

```mermaid
---
title: Secure Boot Chain
---
flowchart TB
    hw["1. Hardware Root of Trust  
SoC verifies U-Boot signature using OTP-fused key"]
    uboot["2. U-Boot (Verified Boot)  
Verifies FIT image signature (kernel + DTB + initramfs)"]
    kernel["3. Linux Kernel  
dm-verity protects read-only rootfs"]
    userspace["4. User Space  
phosphor-software-manager verifies update signatures"]

    hw --> uboot --> kernel --> userspace
```

> **ASCII-art version (for comparison)**

  <div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        Secure Boot Chain                                   │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                                            │
│  1. Hardware Root of Trust                                                 │
│     └─ SoC verifies U-Boot signature using OTP-fused key                   │
│                                                                            │
│  2. U-Boot (Verified Boot)                                                 │
│     └─ Verifies FIT image signature (kernel + DTB + initramfs)             │
│                                                                            │
│  3. Linux Kernel                                                           │
│     └─ dm-verity protects read-only rootfs                                 │
│                                                                            │
│  4. User Space                                                             │
│     └─ phosphor-software-manager verifies update signatures                │
│                                                                            │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

</div>  </div>

### U-Boot Verified Boot Configuration

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">
```
<span class="c"># In U-Boot config (defconfig)</span>
<span class="nv">CONFIG_FIT</span><span class="o">=</span>y
<span class="nv">CONFIG_FIT_SIGNATURE</span><span class="o">=</span>y
<span class="nv">CONFIG_RSA</span><span class="o">=</span>y

<span class="c"># FIT image with signature node</span>
/dts-v1/<span class="p">;</span>

/ <span class="o">{</span>
    images <span class="o">{</span>
        kernel <span class="o">{</span>
            data <span class="o">=</span> /incbin/<span class="o">(</span><span class="s2">"Image"</span><span class="o">)</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="nb">type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"kernel"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="nb">arch</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"arm"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            compression <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"none"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="nb">hash</span> <span class="o">{</span>
                algo <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"sha256"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="o">}</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="o">}</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="o">}</span><span class="p">;</span>
    configurations <span class="o">{</span>
        default <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"conf"</span><span class="p">;</span>
        conf <span class="o">{</span>
            kernel <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"kernel"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            signature <span class="o">{</span>
                algo <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"sha256,rsa4096"</span><span class="p">;</span>
                key-name-hint <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"dev-key"</span><span class="p">;</span>
                sign-images <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"kernel"</span>, <span class="s2">"fdt"</span><span class="p">;</span>
            <span class="o">}</span><span class="p">;</span>
        <span class="o">}</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="o">}</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="o">}</span><span class="p">;</span>
```

</div></div>

### Update Authentication

    

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight">

<span class="c"># Redfish authentication requirements</span>
